title: Telecalling Executive by Amisha Gupta
description:
Tele Calling Executive 
 Department: Sales & Customer Servicing
 Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru
 Position Type: Full-time
 Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components and based on relevant experience) 
 About NoBroker 
 NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free real estate platform, connecting property owners, buyers, and tenants directly without intermediaries. Founded in 2014, NoBroker has grown into a leading PropTech company with a strong presence across major Indian cities. Role Overview We are looking for Tele Calling Executives who can effectively communicate with customers, understand their requirements, provide relevant solutions, and contribute to sales and customer satisfaction. The role involves handling both inbound and outbound calls and may include customer servicing, relationship management, lead follow-ups, and sales conversion. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 34 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer interaction process. Understand customer requirements and provide suitable information, solutions, and assistance related to NoBroker's property and services. Build strong customer relationships through effective communication, regular follow-ups, and timely resolution of queries. For sales-related interactions, pitch relevant NoBroker services, negotiate effectively, and convert qualified leads into customers. For customer-service interactions, act as a relationship manager for customers and ensure a smooth and satisfactory service experience. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, follow-ups, and conversions using internal CRM and calling tools. Adhere to company processes, quality standards, and customer-service guidelines. Work towards individual and team performance goals and contribute to overall business objectives. Ensure a positive customer experience through professional communication and effective problem-solving. 
 Perks & Benefits 
 Performance Incentives: Up to 20,00025,000 per month, depending on role and performance. Health Insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company. Career Growth: Opportunity to progress to Assistant Manager roles based on performance and experience. Promotions: Performance-based promotions, with regular performance reviews. Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition for high-performing employees. Team Engagement: Regular team activities, parties, and Annual Day celebrations. Employee Referral Program: Referral incentives for successful hires. 
 Eligibility & Skill Requirements 
 Education: 10th, 12th, or Graduate candidates can apply. Candidates should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course. Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant customer service, telecalling, sales, or relationship-management experience can apply. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills . Customer-oriented approach with good listening and problem-solving abilities. For sales responsibilities, candidates should have good negotiation, persuasion, and target-oriented skills . Basic proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and calling tools . Languages: English is mandatory. Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi will be an added advantage. Candidates should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage . Candidates should be available for immediate joining . Age: 18 to 30 years. 
 Work Schedule 
 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days. One rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday. Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in emergencies. 
 Why Join NoBroker? Join a fast-growing PropTech company and gain experience across customer service, sales, relationship management, and real estate operations . The role offers performance-based incentives, structured career growth, employee recognition, and opportunities to take on greater responsibilities based on performance.

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Summary 
 The Procurement Operations Executive will support end-to-end procurement for workplace events, employee engagement programs, leadership visits, and office requirements. The role focuses on requirement validation, vendor coordination, quotation analysis, Purchase Order (PO) tracking, invoice support, budget reporting, and procurement compliance in partnership with the Workplace Experience (WEP), Procurement, and Finance teams. 
 
 Job Details 
 Job Location: Gurugram Designation: Workplace Experience Coordinator Educational Qualification: Graduate degree required, preferably in Commerce Experience Required: 2-5 years of experience Shift Timings: General Shift 8AM to 5PM, 9AM to 6PM, 10AM-7PM, 12PM to 9PM Work Schedule: 6 Days/week Specific Skills: Proficient in data analysis with core competencies in vendor management, price comparison analysis, numerical and data analytics, procurement pricing, and creating comparison spreadsheets. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Manage procurement requirements for workplace events, engagement programs, leadership visits, and office initiatives. Collect clear specifications, quantities, timelines, and budgets from internal stakeholders. Coordinate with approved vendors to obtain competitive quotations within defined timelines. Prepare commercial comparison statements and support vendor selection based on cost, quality, service, and compliance. Raise and track purchase requisitions and coordinate PO creation, approval, amendment, utilization, and closure. Validate quotations, POs, Statements of Work (SOWs), invoices, and supporting documents against approved scope and budget. Monitor event and operational spend, identify variances, and maintain accurate budget-utilization trackers. Coordinate vendor onboarding and ensure required due-diligence and compliance documents are complete. Follow up with vendors and internal teams for timely delivery, invoice submission, and payment processing. Maintain procurement records, approvals, quotations, POs, invoices, and closure documents for audit readiness. Prepare periodic MIS reports covering PO status, spend, savings, procurement turnaround time, and pending actions. Support cost optimization, vendor benchmarking, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives. Escalate procurement delays, documentation gaps, budget deviations, or policy non-compliance to the relevant stakeholders. Worked as back-up for WEP Ambassador for all day to day events and support. 
 
 Key Deliverables 
 Quotation and commercial comparison tracker Purchase requisition and PO status tracker Budget utilization and variance report Procurement savings and cost benchmark report Vendor onboarding and compliance tracker Invoice and payment follow-up tracker Vendor performance scorecard Monthly procurement MIS and leadership dashboard Complete procurement documentation and audit-ready repository 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Facility Management, or related field. 2 to 5 years of experience in procurement operations, workplace services, facilities, or event procurement. Experience in quotation analysis, vendor coordination, PO management, invoice processing, and budget tracking. Good working knowledge of procurement policies, approval of workflows, commercial terms, and financial processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel trackers, MIS reports, cost comparisons, and data analysis; knowledge of Power BI is an advantage. Exposure to SAP, ServiceNow, or similar procurement/ERP systems is preferred. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple requirements, meet timelines, and work independently with attention to detail. 
 
 Key Competencies 
 Procurement and commercial analysis Vendor and stakeholder coordination PO, invoice, and budget management MIS reporting and Excel proficiency Compliance and documentation control Cost optimization and problem-solving

title: Subject Matter Expert (Reinforcement & Detailing -BIM)
description:
Job Description 
 We are looking for an experienced Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Reinforcement and Detailing (BIM) to support the development of AI-powered reinforcement detailing solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in 3D rebar modelling, 2D reinforcement detailing, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) for reinforced concrete (RC) structures. 
 The role involves creating production-ready reinforcement models, reviewing AI-generated outputs, identifying detailing errors, and translating domain expertise into structured rules that can be implemented by the software development team. The candidate should have practical experience working with international reinforcement detailing standards, including UK, European, and Australian codes, and exposure to both precast and in-situ construction. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1 . 3D Reinforcement Modelling Develop accurate, fully reinforced 3D models from unreinforced IFC models, structural drawings, and engineering design briefs. Model reinforcement for walls, slabs, beams, columns, foundations, and structural connection zones. Handle complex detailing conditions, including openings, edge reinforcement, U-bars, trimmer bars, lap zones, hooks, anchorage, starter bars, embeds, and reinforcement congestion. Determine appropriate reinforcement arrangements, including mesh and loose-bar configurations, based on engineering requirements and constructability. Ensure reinforcement models comply with project specifications, applicable codes, and engineering intent. 
 2 . 2D Reinforcement Detailing Prepare reinforcement drawings, sections, callouts, dimensioned views, tags, and bar schedules. Generate accurate Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) and reinforcement details suitable for site execution or precast manufacturing. Apply BS 8666 shape codes and relevant reinforcement detailing conventions for other regions. Ensure consistency between 3D models, 2D drawings, and fabrication requirements. Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, and practical constructability. 
 3. AI Model Review and Validation Review AI-generated reinforcement models and drawings against manually detailed reference models. Identify incorrect bar placements, missing reinforcement, code deviations, and non-buildable detailing. Document discrepancies and provide clear technical explanations and corrective recommendations. Identify complex scenarios and edge cases that may affect automated reinforcement detailing. Establish quality benchmarks for AI-generated reinforcement models and detailing outputs. 
 4 . Rule Definition and Knowledge Transfer Translate reinforcement detailing expertise into structured rules, conditions, exceptions, and outcomes for implementation by the software team. Differentiate between mandatory code requirements and decisions that depend on engineering judgement or project-specific standards. Define the inputs required from structural engineers, including concrete cover, bar diameters, spacing, exposure conditions, openings, and connection requirements. Collaborate with software engineers and AI specialists to improve the accuracy and reliability of automated detailing. Maintain a structured library of detailing rules, correction logs, and technical edge cases. 
 5. Engineering Coordination Interpret structural drawings and design reports to understand reinforcement requirements and engineering intent. Identify inconsistencies between design reports, drawings, dimensions, and model geometry. Work closely with structural engineers and software development teams to resolve technical queries. Participate in regular technical reviews and provide feedback on automation workflows. Support continuous improvement of AI-powered BIM and reinforcement detailing processes. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in reinforcement detailing for reinforced concrete structures. Strong practical experience in 3D rebar modelling using at least one of the following tools:
 Autodesk Revit Tekla Structures Allplan CADS RC Experience preparing 2D reinforcement drawings, sections, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). 
 Knowledge of international reinforcement detailing standards, including:
 BS 8666 and UK National Annex Eurocode 2 (EC2) Australian Standard AS 3600 AS/NZS 4671 Relevant DIN and SIA standards Understanding of both precast and in-situ reinforced concrete construction. Strong knowledge of concrete cover, bar spacing, lap lengths, hooks, bend radii, anchorage, starter bars, edge reinforcement, and opening reinforcement. 
 Ability to read structural drawings and engineering design reports and translate design intent into practical reinforcement detailing. Strong understanding of reinforcement constructability, fabrication requirements, and site execution practices. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills. Ability to explain technical detailing decisions clearly to non-structural engineering teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience working on projects governed by UK, European, or Australian reinforcement detailing standards. Exposure to multiple reinforcement modelling platforms. Experience with IFC models and BIM model exchange workflows. Experience in precast factory detailing or in-situ construction projects. Previous experience in model checking, technical review, or quality assurance of reinforcement drawings. Familiarity with BIM automation, rule-based modelling, computational design, or AI-assisted engineering workflows. Experience identifying discrepancies in structural drawings, design reports, and model inputs. 
 Key Deliverables and Success Metrics Production-ready 3D reinforcement models and 2D detailing outputs. Accurate Bar Bending Schedules aligned with model geometry. Structured review reports documenting AI-generated detailing errors and corrections. A documented reinforcement detailing rules library for AI implementation. Identification and documentation of complex reinforcement detailing scenarios and edge cases. Improved accuracy, consistency, and constructability of AI-generated reinforcement models. Effective collaboration with structural and software engineering teams to continuously improve the automation process.

Key Skills: BIM,Reinforcement,REVIT Structure,Detailing,BIM Coordination,Management Skills,Leadership Skills,Strong Communication Skills

description:
Job description : Job Title: Mainframe z/OS Admin (Senior Systems Administrator L3 Support)
 Experience: 6-10+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad Position Description We are seeking an experienced Senior z/OS Systems Administrator (L3 Support) to join our Core Mainframe Infrastructure Services team. In this senior, escalated technical role, you will act as the highest level of internal technical escalation for operating system incidents, complex systems engineering, system migrations, and operational resilience across mission-critical enterprise IBM Z environments. You will lead complex problem resolution, drive major operating system upgrades — including migrations from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2 — oversee JES3 spool/batch subsystems, manage advanced MVS console alerting, and ensure robust disaster recovery and storage redundancy utilizing CSM (Copy Services Manager). This position works closely with architecture, storage, automation, and application infrastructure teams to guarantee non-stop system availability, strict SLA compliance, and continuous modernization of the mainframe landscape. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in IBM z/OS System Administration and L3 Production Engineering. Demonstrated background supporting high-volume, 24x7 mission-critical financial, enterprise, or government mainframe operations. Comprehensive mastery of z/OS architecture and administration, including z/OS 3.1 and release readiness for z/OS 3.2. Advanced SMP/E experience (RECEIVE, APPLY, ACCEPT, RESTORE, SMPPTS, and CSI management). Hands-on expertise in JES3 environments (JES3plex, spool management, initialization decks, Global/Local operations). Strong MVS console architecture knowledge: console operations, routing codes, command authority, message flood automation, and alert triage. Deep knowledge of PARMLIB/PROCLIB management, dynamic I/O configuration (HCD), and Workload Manager (WLM). Experience with IPCS dump reading, AMASPZAP, IDCAMS, DUMP/RESTORE (DFSMSdss), IEBCOPY, and DSNUTILS. Copy Services Manager (CSM) administration for multi-site replication, HyperSwap monitoring, and storage redundancy. Knowledge of Parallel Sysplex concepts: Sysplex Timers (STP), Coupling Facility (CF) structures, and CDS management. Experience with report and log archiving suites, specifically CA View and Flasher. description:
Job Summary 
 Introduction: A Career at Harman Automotive We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At Harman Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment 
 
 Role Overview 
 As an IOC Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, integrating, and validating software for automotive IO Controller (IOC) platforms based on automotive microcontrollers such as Renesas RH850, Infineon Aurix, or NXP S32. You will work on vehicle communication, AUTOSAR integration, CAN/CAN-FD signal management, and MCU-to-SoC communication for next-generation cockpit and infotainment systems. This is an individual contributor role involving development, debugging, and system integration activities across multiple automotive domains. 
 
 What You Will Do 
 Develop and maintain embedded software for IOC applications. Integrate and validate automotive CAN/CAN-FD signals. Analyze customer DBC files and implement signal mapping. Configure AUTOSAR Basic Software modules and generate configurations. Develop and debug low-level drivers for SPI, UART, I2C, GPIO, ADC, and PWM interfaces. Support IOC and SoC communication interfaces. Perform root cause analysis of software and integration issues. Support flashing, bring-up, testing, and production releases. Collaborate with platform, middleware, HMI, and vehicle integration teams. Participate in code reviews and support software quality and process compliance activities. 
 
 What You Need to Be Successful 
 3-8 years of experience in Automotive Embedded Software Development. Strong knowledge of Embedded C programming and real-time embedded systems. Hands-on experience with CAN and CAN-FD protocols. Strong understanding of DBC-based signal integration and vehicle communication. Experience with AUTOSAR modules Hands-on experience with Vector DaVinci Configurator. Experience using Vector CANoe and/or CANalyzer. Experience with MCU platforms such as: Renesas RH850 Infineon Aurix NXP S32 STM32 Strong debugging skills in embedded and automotive environments. Experience with communication interfaces: SPI, UART, I2C, GPIO, ADC, PWM 
 
 Bonus Points if You Have 
 Knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety concepts. Experience with UDS diagnostics and DTC handling. Experience with Automotive Ethernet protocols. Knowledge of Bootloader development and firmware update mechanisms. Experience with MCU-to-SoC communication architectures. Experience working on Automotive Cockpit, Infotainment, Cluster, or Vehicle Integration programs. Familiarity with Qualcomm automotive platforms. Experience in A2B audio systems and display control interfaces. Experience with Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, and CI/CD environments. 
 
 What Makes You Eligible 
 BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively in global and cross-functional teams. Willingness to work with global stakeholders and support integration activities across multiple domains. Flexibility to work with distributed teams across different time zones when required.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
 
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Team 
 Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service. FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models. 

 About the role 
 We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language. This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery 

 Responsibilities 
 Set the direction: Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team. Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you. Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar. Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate. Be the voice of developer experience across FGA : partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it. Own the Platform: Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from. Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting. Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute. 

 Requirements 
 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title. Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several. Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling. A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority Nice to have Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects. title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 At HyPrix, we're building attritable payload delivery systems for autonomy. Things that fly fast, we're enabling them with conscious software. Replicating the capabilities of expensive conventional frontline systems, we're building the cheapest micro and cruise missile systems on the planet. Built for a war of attrition, built for the era of software-defined warfare, built to cater to the front lines of battlefields where no man should stand in the future. Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India 

 Job Type 
 Full time 

 Responsibilities 
 Code. Write embedded C and C++ code for microcontrollers to the design and the coding standard. Drivers and interfaces. Write and test drivers for peripherals and buses, for example UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, ADC, PWM and timers. Board bring-up. Help with the bring-up of new boards. Load the firmware, check each interface and record the results. Unit tests. Write unit tests for each function that you write. Fix each defect that a test or a review finds. Code review. Submit each change for code review, and update it to the review comments. Debug. Find faults with a debugger, an oscilloscope and a logic analyser. Record each fault and its cause. Test tools. Write simple Python tools for test, data logs and firmware download. Integration and trial support. Support HIL tests, system integration and field trials. Download and check the logs after each test. Documentation. Write the design notes, interface descriptions and release notes for each change. Version control. Use Git for each change, and link each change to its task or requirement. 

 Requirements 
 Minimum Experience (Years): 0-2 years of embedded software work. Internships and project work on real hardware count. HyPrix prefers this experience, but it is not mandatory. Demonstrated capability is more important than years. 

 Required Skills 
 C programming. Good C for microcontrollers, and basic C++. Microcontrollers. Knowledge of MCU architecture, registers, interrupts and timers, for example on ARM Cortex-M. Interfaces. Knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C and CAN. Debug tools. Ability to use a debugger, a multimeter and an oscilloscope. Electronics basics. Ability to read a simple schematic and a datasheet. Version control. Basic use of Git. A bachelors degree in electronics, electrical, computer engineering, computer science or instrumentation. Eligibility for background verification and security clearance. This position handles export-controlled and commercially confidential information. 

 Advantageous Skills/Qualifications 
 Project or internship work on drones, robots, satellites or automotive ECUs. Experience with an RTOS, for example FreeRTOS or Zephyr. Experience with Python for test scripts. Membership of a student team, for example a drone, rocketry, satellite or Formula Student. Knowledge of MISRA C.

description:
Job Summary 
 Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, ML ADAS Perception Years of Experience: 2-3 Years Location: Belagavi/Bangalore The world of ADAS and AV is undergoing a sea-change. OEMs, tier-1s, and regulators are all demanding measurable and quantifiable metrics of ADAS/AV safety. Data-driven simulation-based validation of ADAS/AV stacks is fast becoming the cornerstone of generating and verifying these metrics. Tools and Technologies based on the concept of Data-to-Simulation are driving this simulation-based validation approach. Vayavya is working on developing such tools, where every vehicle, pedestrian and cyclist in the recorded videos and sensor data are enumerated and tracked and every actor trajectory is located accurately on a world digital twin that can then be played in any simulator of choice. 

 Responsibilities 
 Train and tune learning models to extract actor behaviour from a set of recorded ADAS/AV data Apply ADAS tracking and filtering algorithms to aid the learning models Build an automated simulation artefact generation ML pipeline. Check that what the pipeline produces is correct Build the tests, metrics, and review tools that measure each stage of the pipeline, and feed the corrections back into model training. 

 Technical Skills 
 Good programming skills in Python. C++ is a plus. Hands-on with a deep learning framework, PyTorch preferred. Working knowledge of computer vision: object detection, multi-object tracking, segmentation, depth estimation. Understanding of camera geometry: intrinsics, extrinsics, lens distortion and projection. Training and fine-tuning models: datasets, labelling, evaluation metrics. Comfortable with linear algebra, probability, and basic state estimation such as Kalman filters. Exposure to Linux OS, Linux tools, and Git. 

 Good to Have (Non-mandatory) 
 Handling large datasets of video and logs with NumPy, pandas and plotting tools. Writing test suites and regression checks, using pytest or similar. Understanding of evaluation metrics for detection and tracking: precision, recall, IoU, and tracking scores such as MOTA (Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy) or HOTA (Higher Order Tracking Accuracy). Exposure to ADAS simulation standards like ASAM OpenDRIVE, ASAM OpenSCENARIO, and simulators like esmini or CARLA 

 Non-Technical Skills 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Good debugging skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Self-managed and able to learn and adapt

description:
Job Summary 
 Own the architecture. Set the technical direction for multi-tenant, globally distributed systems that process billions of security events. Make the one-way-door calls on data models, service boundaries, and platform primitives. Solve the unsolved. Take ambiguous, high-stakes problems real-time correlation at petabyte scale, sub-second graph queries, zero-downtime multi-region failover from whiteboard to production. Raise the engineering bar. Set the standard for design reviews, code quality, observability, and on-call excellence. Mentor senior engineers into principal-caliber thinkers. Build AI-native. Treat LLMs and agents as first-class citizens of the stack both in the product (agentic SOAR, threat reasoning, copilots) and in how we build (AI-assisted development, vibe coding, eval-driven iteration). Ship 10x faster without shipping 10x bugs. Master the data. Model complex security telemetry across relational, document, graph, vector, and time-series stores. Tune the queries nobody else can tune.  10+ years building production software, with meaningful time as a tech lead, staff, or principal in a high-growth startup or a team that behaves like one. Architects mindset. You zoom from a CRD controller to a customer SLO to a board slide in the same meeting. You design for 10x, not for today. Deep distributed systems chops. Consistency trade-offs, backpressure, idempotency, partitioning, and failure modes are your native language. Kubernetes at real scale. title: Senior Tech Consultant/Salesforce Developer (Agentforce Exp mandatory)
description:
Job Description Overview of the Role 


We're looking for a highly accomplished and Senior Technical Consultant with 5+ years of experience to lead the charge on complex AI agentic deployments. This role demands a seasoned technologist and strategic partner who can not only design and develop bespoke solutions leveraging our Agentforce platform and other cutting-edge technologies but also lead technical engagements and mentor junior peers. You'll be the primary driver of transformative AI solutions, operating with deep technical mastery, unparalleled problem-solving prowess, and a relentless focus on delivering tangible value in dynamic, real-world environments, from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimization.


As a Senior Technical Consultant, you'll be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI solutions to our most strategic clients. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond. You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.


 Responsibilities 
• Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation: Be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of complex AI solutions, personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues, while also guiding and reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.
• Build Transformative AI Solutions: Take primary ownership of designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.
• Engineer Bespoke Agentic AI Solutions: Work directly with customers to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Agentforce platform, ensuring they precisely meet unique business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing customer ecosystems.
• Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimized, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.
• Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, from intricate data integration to sophisticated model deployment and advanced agent orchestration. You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.
• Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become a foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, pushing its capabilities to the limit. You'll lead the development of bespoke intelligent agents, automate intricate business processes, and craft intuitive user experiences. Your insights from the field will directly influence future product enhancements and help shape the strategic direction of our platform, often representing the voice of the customer in product discussions.
• Become a Trusted Strategic Partner: Embed yourself deeply with client teams to truly grasp their operational challenges and strategic goals. You'll translate these nuanced needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and solution designs, building strong relationships as their primary technical advisor and leading technical discussions.
• Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.
• Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.
• Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelize engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.
 Required Qualifications 
• 5+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment
• Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline
• Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with Agentforce, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks
• Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
• Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development
• Demonstrated entrepreneurship, a "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives
• Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects
• Ability to travel upto 60% of the time, as needed to customer sites



 Preferred Qualifications 
 Extensive experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions within highly regulated industries Expert-level experience with Apex and LWC coding languages in a professional setting Prior experience in a customer-facing, hands-on technical lead or architect role Advanced Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, Application Architect, System Architect) Deep knowledge across Salesforce CRM (Service, Sales, and Marketing Clouds) Extensive experience with Salesforce Flows and Lightning Web Components (LWC), including complex custom development Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or libraries

title: IH Salesforce Production Support
description:
Technical Support Analyst Position Information Job Title: Technical Support Analyst Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support Employment Type: Full-time Location: Bangalore Reports To: Cloud Support Manager Role Purpose The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health . 
 The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud , including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support. The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy , prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate , controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes. Key Responsibilities Salesforce Administration and User Access Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures. Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms. Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues. Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews. Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security , identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource. Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes. 
 Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, clicks-not-code capabilities . Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations . Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role s approved administrative scope. Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures. Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities. Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions. 
 Data Maintenance and Reporting Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities. Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures. Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes. Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality. Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements. Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity. Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required . Incident and Application Support Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow. Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue. Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group. Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors. Reproduce issues where appropriate , review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path. Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs. Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes. Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields. Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required , documenting the reason for reassignment. Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket. Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures. 
 Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles. Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation. Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions. Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability. 
 Collaboration and Customer Service Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams. Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy , balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments. Provide accurate , professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents. Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role s authority or technical scope. Required Skills and Experience Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator. Practical administration experience across: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Experience Cloud Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups. Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards. Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting. Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities. Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues. Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails. Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required . Preferred or Desirable Skills Working knowledge of ServiceNow , including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness. Salesforce Certified Administrator credential . Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment. Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes. Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing. Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk. Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities. Behaviors and Competencies Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate , and professional support. Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries. Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions. Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately. Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records. Security and risk aware : Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity. Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently. Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements. Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences. Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations. 
 Scope of the Role This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position , not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team . Measures of Success Success in the position will be demonstrated through: Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests. Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs. High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records. Secure, accurate , and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance. Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence. Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope. Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles. Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts .

title: Front Desk Manager
description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals - Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis. - Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work. - Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others. - Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met. - Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results. - Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals. Supporting Management of Front Desk Team - Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example. - Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. - Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors. - Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence. - Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team. - Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager. Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service - Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention. - Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed. - Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints. - Sets a positive example for guest relations. - Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. - Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals. - Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction. - Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters. - Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. - Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement. Managing Projects and Policies - Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process. - Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates. - Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy. - Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures. - Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process. Additional Responsibilities - Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person. - Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems. - Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner. - Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary. - Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary. - Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results. description:
Role : Customer Retention & Telecalling Executive Company: Distacart
 Location: Pune
 Working Days: 6 days a week
 Working Hours: 9 hours per day 
 Rotational Shifts 
 Job Description: 
 Distacart is looking for confident, customer-focused, and result-oriented Customer Retention & Telecalling Executives to join our Pune team. The role involves connecting with international customers who have shown interest in purchasing from Distacart, including customers with abandoned carts, previous customers, and other retention opportunities. The ideal candidate should have excellent spoken English, strong communication skills, active listening abilities, and the confidence to interact professionally with international customers over calls. This role is not limited to telecalling. The executive will also be responsible for maintaining customer data, updating Excel/CRM trackers, documenting customer feedback, supporting sales conversions, and sharing customer insights with the Team Lead and management. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Calling & Cart Recovery Contact customers who have added products to their cart but have not completed their purchase. Understand the reasons behind cart abandonment or purchase hesitation. Assist customers with product availability, pricing, payment, delivery, and ordering-related queries. Guide interested customers toward completing their purchases. Follow up with potential customers as required. Maintain a professional, polite, and consultative approach during every interaction. 2. Customer Retention & Engagement Connect with existing and previous Distacart customers to encourage repeat purchases. Understand customer requirements, preferences, and buying behavior. Build positive customer relationships through regular and meaningful communication. Identify opportunities for future purchases. Re-engage dormant or inactive customers as assigned. Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the interaction. 3. Sales & Conversion Work toward defined daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets. Identify genuine purchase opportunities during customer conversations. Encourage customers to complete purchases without using aggressive sales techniques. Follow up systematically with interested customers. Maintain accurate records of converted, interested, follow-up, and non-converted customers. 4. Customer Feedback & Issue Identification Understand and accurately document customer concerns and feedback. Identify common reasons for cart abandonment and incomplete purchases. Highlight recurring issues related to products, payments, delivery, website experience, or customer service. Escalate important concerns to the Team Lead or relevant internal teams. Share customer insights that can help improve customer experience and conversion rates. 5. Data & Excel/CRM Management Maintain daily calling and customer interaction records. Update customer status, call outcomes, follow-up dates, and remarks accurately. Maintain customer data hygiene and ensure records are updated regularly. Update daily and weekly performance trackers. Document customer conversations and outcomes properly. Avoid duplicate, incorrect, or incomplete customer records. 6. Reporting & Management Updates Regularly share updates with the Team Lead and management on: Calls completed and customers connected. Follow-ups generated and orders converted. Customer retention opportunities. Common customer concerns and product-related queries. Reasons for cart abandonment. Customer insights and recurring trends. Coordinate with relevant internal teams to support faster issue resolution and improve customer satisfaction. Required Skills & Qualifications Excellent spoken English and strong verbal communication skills. Clear pronunciation and professional telephone etiquette. Confidence in communicating with international customers. Strong listening and comprehension skills. Customer-focused approach with a positive attitude. Good persuasion, negotiation, and sales conversion skills. Ability to build customer relationships and handle objections professionally. Basic to intermediate knowledge of MS Excel and CRM tools. Good data management, documentation, and reporting skills. Ability to work toward daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets. Prior experience in international voice process, telecalling, telesales, customer retention, or customer support is preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with experience handling international customers over calls. Candidates with excellent English communication and strong customer-handling skills. Candidates who are comfortable with outbound calling, follow-ups, and sales conversion. Candidates who can manage customer records and maintain accurate Excel/CRM trackers. Candidates who demonstrate confidence, patience, ownership, and a result-oriented approach. Excellent English Communication is mandatory for this role.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Associate Analyst, Insights & Enablement Mastercard Overview
Mastercard is a global technology company powering the world s fastest payments network. We connect individuals, businesses, and economies-enabling secure, seamless, and accessible commerce. Beyond payments, we drive innovation, expand financial inclusion, and empower our people to make a meaningful impact. At Mastercard, growth is shared-when the company succeeds, so do our employees.

Services at Mastercard
The Services organization is a key differentiator for Mastercard, delivering advanced solutions that help customers grow and optimize performance. This team operates with speed, scale, and agility-building end-to-end capabilities for a diverse, global client base.

Insights & Enablement (I&E) within Services
The Services Business Development Insights & Enablement (BD I&E) team powers the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable sales teams to operate efficiently and scale effectively.
We partner closely with multiple business teams to:

-Drive operational excellence
-Improve productivity through automation
-Deliver actionable insights
-Simplify sales workflows

Our mission is simple: enable BD teams to focus on selling, while we build the systems and processes that unlock growth.

Role Overview
Reporting to the Director, Services BD Insights & Enablement, the Analyst will play a key role in supporting the implementation and ongoing evolution of the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform for the Services organization.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that sits at the intersection of sales enablement, product management (internally facing), and process transformation.

Key Responsibilities:
-Support the design, preparation, and optimization of Services contracting workflows within the CLM platform
-Assist in translating business requirements into structured workflows, rules, and templates within CLM
-Work closely with stakeholders (Legal, Sales, Operations) to map and migrate contractual constructs into systemized processes
-Participate in testing of new CLM features, including identifying issues, validating outputs, and supporting remediation efforts
-Leverage tools such as Ironclad, Salesforce, Signavio, CPQ, and other enablement platforms to enhance execution and efficiency
-Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, standardization, and simplification of contracting processes
-Ensure accuracy, consistency, and governance across workflows and system outputs

All About You:
-Should possess a high degree of problem-solving ability and be a strong and effective communicator
-Strong exposure in one or the other data analysis tools (Excel/SQL/Python), PowerPoint, and Word; ability to create structured analyses, clear presentations, and professional documentation
-Experience or interest in Sales Enablement, Process Transformation, or Product Management
-Exposure to process mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Signavio) or workflow design concepts
-Ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams
-Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to listen, align, and influence
-Structured problem-solver with attention to detail and a bias for execution
-Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
-Strong verbal and written communication skills
-Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements
-Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, enable effective multitasking, and operate at a high pace in a demanding environment
-Flexible to collaborate across global time zones

Important Note:
-This role is focused on Sales Enablement, Contract Lifecycle Management, and Process Optimization, and is not a Data Science or core Data Analytics role
-While analytical skills are valuable, the primary focus is on workflow design, systems enablement, -and business transformation Corporate Security Responsibility

title: Manager Finance
description:
Job Summary 
 The Commercial and Retail Finance Manager is responsible for comprehensive financial management of commercial and retail real estate portfolios, including financial planning, analysis, reporting, invoice generation, CAM reconciliations, and budgeting. This role provides strategic financial insight to support business decisions, optimize portfolio performance, and ensure accurate financial operations across property management. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Invoice Generation Accounts Receivable Management Generate and issue monthly tenant invoices for base rent, CAM charges, property taxes, insurance, and other recoverable expenses. Prepare and distribute quarterly or annual CAM estimate bills and reconciliation statements. Process lease escalations, percentage rent calculations, and special billing requirements. Monitor accounts receivable aging and coordinate collection efforts with property management teams. Reconcile tenant payments and resolve billing discrepancies. Maintain accurate tenant billing records and ensure compliance with lease terms. CAM (Common Area Maintenance) Management Administer CAM programs including calculation of tenant pro-rata shares based on lease terms and square footage. Prepare annual CAM budgets and estimate bills for distribution to tenants. Conduct detailed annual CAM reconciliations comparing actual expenses to billed estimates. Generate tenant-specific reconciliation statements showing overages or refunds due. Review and allocate operating expenses to appropriate CAM pools (common area, HVAC, parking, etc.). Ensure compliance with lease-specific CAM provisions, caps, and exclusions. Handle tenant CAM audits and respond to inquiries regarding expense allocations. Track and manage CAM over/under collections and adjust future billings accordingly. Budgeting Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting process for assigned commercial and retail properties, collaborating with property management teams. Develop detailed operating and capital budgets including revenue projections, operating expenses, CAM recoveries, and capital expenditures. Create quarterly reforecasts reflecting current market conditions, leasing activity, and operational changes. Analyze historical trends and market data to establish realistic budget assumptions. Present budget proposals to senior management and property owners for approval. Monitor budget performance throughout the year and provide variance explanations. Prepare rolling 12-month forecasts to support cash flow planning and strategic decision-making. Financial Planning Analysis Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance to budgets, forecasts, and prior periods. Prepare financial models to evaluate investment opportunities, lease transactions, and capital projects. Monitor key performance indicators including NOI, occupancy rates, rent collections, operating expense ratios, and recovery percentages. Analyze lease structures and their financial impact on property cash flow. Identify opportunities to improve revenue collection and expense management. Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for property portfolios. Generate management reports highlighting financial performance, trends, and actionable insights. Produce owner reports with detailed variance explanations and supporting schedules. Present financial results to senior leadership, property owners, and stakeholders. Track and report on tenant rent rolls, lease expirations, and renewal activity. Ensure timely and accurate reporting in compliance with GAAP and company policies. Property Operations Support Partner with property management teams to optimize revenue and control operating expenses. Review and approve operating expense invoices and code to appropriate accounts. Support vendor contract negotiations by analyzing cost structures and payment terms. Analyze lease agreements for billing requirements, escalations, and recovery provisions. Coordinate with leasing teams on financial aspects of lease negotiations and tenant concessions. Support capital project planning with financial analysis and budget tracking. Team Collaboration Work cross-functionally with asset management, leasing, property management, and corporate finance teams. Mentor junior finance staff on billing processes, CAM procedures, and financial analysis. Build strong relationships with property teams to understand operational drivers of financial performance. Collaborate with accounts payable teams to ensure proper expense coding and allocation. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Required: Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or related field. 5-7 years of progressive finance experience in commercial real estate property management. Strong knowledge of commercial lease structures, CAM calculations, and recovery methodologies. Demonstrated expertise in tenant billing, invoice generation, and accounts receivable management. Proven experience managing annual budgeting and CAM reconciliation processes. Advanced Excel skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and complex formulas. Proficiency with property management systems (Yardi, MRI, or similar) and accounting software. Understanding of GAAP, real estate accounting principles, and lease accounting standards. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills for tenant and stakeholder interactions. Ability to manage multiple properties and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines. Preferred: CPA, CFA, or relevant professional certification. Experience with both commercial office and retail property types. Knowledge of percentage rent calculations and gross-up provisions. Familiarity with tenant improvement allowances and lease incentive accounting. Experience supporting acquisitions, dispositions, or property transitions. Background in lease administration and critical date tracking. 
 
 Technical Competencies 
 Expert knowledge of CAM allocation methodologies and industry best practices. Proficiency in lease abstract interpretation and billing requirement identification. Strong understanding of operating expense categories and allocation principles. Experience with recoverable versus non-recoverable expense classification. Ability to prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation. Knowledge of tenant audit processes and documentation requirements. 
 
 Core Competencies 
 Strategic thinking with ability to translate financial data into business insights. Results-oriented with focus on driving portfolio performance and maximizing recoveries. Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to resolve complex billing issues. Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across departments. Detail-oriented with commitment to accuracy in financial reporting and tenant billing. Customer service mindset when dealing with tenant inquiries and concerns. Adaptability to changing business needs, lease requirements, and regulatory standards. 
 
 Working Conditions 
 Office-based role with potential for hybrid arrangements. May require occasional property site visits. Peak workload during month-end close, annual budgeting, and CAM reconciliation season. 
 
 Reporting Structure 
 This role typically reports to a Director of Finance, Portfolio Controller, or Senior Finance Manager and plays a critical function in bridging financial management with property operations to maximize asset value, ensure accurate tenant billing, and optimize expense recoveries. ;

Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Maintain accurate records relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages, overtime, and other statutory obligations. Coordinate with compliance consultants and government authorities whenever required. Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and records required for inspections and audits. Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements. Support implementation of applicable occupational health, safety, and welfare requirements. 5. Factory Discipline & HR Administration Ensure adherence to factory rules, reporting timings, shift schedules, and workplace policies. Conduct regular shop-floor visits to understand workforce concerns and monitor discipline. Coordinate with production managers and supervisors on manpower utilization and productivity. Monitor employee movement, unauthorized absenteeism, and workplace conduct. Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation. Support smooth employee exits, handovers, and Full & Final Settlements. 6. Contractor & Manpower Vendor Management Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies. Monitor contractual manpower deployment, attendance, and performance. Verify contractor bills against approved attendance and agreed commercial terms. Ensure availability of backup manpower during peak production periods. Monitor contractor compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies. 7. Performance Management & HR Reporting Coordinate performance reviews for factory employees and supervisors. Identify recurring attendance, productivity, and behavioural concerns. Maintain HR dashboards covering manpower strength, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, and recruitment. Share daily and weekly manpower reports with management. Support initiatives to improve employee retention, discipline, and workforce productivity. 
 Candidate Requirements Education Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in HR or a related qualification preferred. Experience 47 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant. Strong experience handling blue-collar and contractual workforces. Practical understanding of factory HR operations and labour law compliance. Experience in printing, packaging, fabrication, engineering, or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred. Essential Skills Strong blue-collar recruitment capabilities. Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and labour compliance. Experience managing factory attendance, overtime, and payroll coordination. Strong interpersonal skills and conflict-resolution abilities. Ability to handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters independently. Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and attendance management systems. Good communication skills in Hindi and working knowledge of English. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Plant HR will be evaluated on: Manpower Availability: Ensuring adequate workforce availability as per production requirements. Recruitment TAT: Timely closure of blue-collar and factory-level vacancies. Attendance & Absenteeism: Improvement in workforce attendance and reduction in unplanned absenteeism. Employee Retention: Reduction in avoidable blue-collar attrition. Payroll Accuracy: Accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs. Statutory Compliance: Timely compliance with applicable labour laws and documentation requirements. Factory Discipline: Effective management of employee grievances and disciplinary matters. HR Reporting: Timely and accurate submission of manpower and HR reports. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is not limited to desk-based HR operations . The ideal candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, interacting directly with workers, resolving workforce issues, and coordinating closely with production teams. title: Sr IT Engineer
description:
Job Details 
 Job Title: Senior IT Engineer - Virtualization Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Organization: NEC Corporation of India Ltd. 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a System Administrator who will lead the day-to-day administration, optimization, and automation of our enterprise virtualization platforms, datacenter infrastructure, and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, and disaster readiness of mission-critical workloads, and will support large-scale datacenter projects for government and enterprise customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage and maintain enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), and Nutanix AHV clusters (Prism Central/Element). Configure and tune vSphere HA, DRS, vMotion, vSAN, and Distributed Switches, and monitor cluster and host health using VMware Aria Operations. Design, implement, and test replication, failover clustering, and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., VMware SRM) for mission-critical workloads. Administer hybrid cloud environments on Google Cloud Platform and AWS, including landing zones, IAM policies, and network architecture. Administer Windows Server and Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux) environments for performance, security, and uptime. Manage Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and Group Policy Objects, including user and resource provisioning. Plan and execute patching of servers, ESXi hosts, and workstations using WSUS, ensuring compliance with organizational policies. Execute VM migrations across platforms (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Proxmox VE) using tools such as Nutanix Move. Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment. Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker. Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers). Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams. 
 
 Prerequisites 
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, IT, or a related discipline. Ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in system administration, virtualization, and datacenter management. Desirable qualities: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (or equivalent AWS/Azure certification); VMware (VCP) or Nutanix (NCP) certification is an added advantage. Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis. Experience in large-scale datacenter or government/public-sector projects. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure. 
 
 Base Location 
 Noida, but flexible to travel (as per project and customer requirements). 
 
 Specialization Description 
 General IT Applications Development includes analysis, programming, and configuration of end user applications and/or systems software including: Analyzing detailed business/functional/technical requirements and specifications for the application Coding internally developed applications and/or configuring commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using programming, scripting, and database languages Supporting application testing, deployment, maintenance, and evolution activities by correcting programming errors, responding to scope changes, and coding application enhancements 
 
 Level Description 
 Entry to developing level professional with little or no prior experience required. Applies a broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. Work is closely supervised. Works to deliver day-to-day objectives with limited impact on achievement of results for the job area. Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex.

 The future of HR Operations is being redefined at Baxter. Across the company, HR is unlocking new ways to deliver value - not just through processes, but through experiences that empower people and build confidence. Drive HR process standardization, simplification, and automation initiatives. Support system enhancements, including UAT and change management. Maintain Knowledge Articles and SOPs to strengthen operational clarity. Train and mentor junior team members on HR transactions.

 Several years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or GBS. Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, payroll inputs). Advanced Excel skills; Power BI experience is an advantage. Excellent communication skills in English. 

 Your Background

The role ensures alignment between customer demand, production capabilities, material availability, and business objectives while leading initiatives that improve service, cost, inventory, and productivity performance.
