title: IT SUPPORT/DESKTOP SUPPORT EXECUTIVE
description:
Job Summary 
 Broad Function: As a Fresher IT Executive, you will support day-to-day IT operations in Chennai and help employees use their laptops, desktops, software, printers, and network connections effectively. You will work with the IT team to resolve routine issues and escalate problems that require specialist support. The role includes device setup, IT asset records, user onboarding and offboarding support, ticket tracking, and clear documentation. You will develop practical support skills while following approved procedures, access permissions, and information-security requirements. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 End-user IT Support: Receive user queries, identify symptoms, perform basic troubleshooting, and communicate progress in clear language. Laptop and Desktop Setup: Prepare and configure laptops and desktops, install approved software, check peripherals and connectivity, and verify readiness before handover. IT Asset Management: Maintain accurate inventory records, record asset assignments and returns, and coordinate stock checks and device movements. User Onboarding Support: Assist with device allocation, approved account and access requests, application setup, and employee IT orientation. User Offboarding Support: Coordinate device returns, update inventory, and support approved access removal and data handover with the authorised IT team. Network and Printer Troubleshooting: Check basic connectivity, cables, Wi-Fi, printer status, and print queues; escalate unresolved or wider outages. Software Troubleshooting: Support routine installation and application issues using approved methods; avoid unauthorised software and security changes. IT Ticket Management: Record incidents and requests, capture troubleshooting steps, track status, prioritise using impact and urgency, and confirm resolution. Documentation and Team Coordination: Maintain support records and checklists, coordinate routine IT activities, and escalate risks or unresolved issues with relevant evidence. 
 
 Requirements 
 Fresher; prior full-time IT support experience is not required. Relevant IT or computer-related education or training is preferred. Specific qualification requirements are to be confirmed. Basic understanding of laptop and desktop hardware, operating systems, and common office applications. Basic knowledge of network connectivity, Wi-Fi, IP addresses, and printers. Ability to follow a logical troubleshooting process and recognise when escalation is needed. Clear verbal and written communication and a patient, service-oriented approach. Willingness to learn, follow IT procedures, and work collaboratively with the IT team. Basic spreadsheet skills for maintaining asset inventories and support records. Ability to support IT operations in Chennai; work mode to be confirmed. Awareness of password confidentiality, approved access, and safe handling of company devices and data. Internships, academic projects, or practical exposure to device setup and user support are preferred, not mandatory. 
 
 Skills 
 End-user IT Support Laptop and Desktop Setup IT Asset Management User Onboarding Support User Offboarding Support Network and Printer Troubleshooting Software Troubleshooting IT Ticket Management Documentation and Team Coordination

description:
Mechanical Maintenance Incharge 
 Title Mechanical Maintenance Incharge 
 Preferred Companies from Automobile or Engineering Industry 
 Job Location Coimbatore Tamilnadu 
 Essential Languages Tamil (Read, Write, Speak); English (Read, Write, Speak) 

 Organisation Chart: 
 Plant Head
 
Mechanical Maintenance Incharge
 
Shift Supervisors
 
Helper 
 Job Purpose The Mechanical Maintenance Incharge is responsible for leading and managing the mechanical maintenance function at Unit-IV, Karumathampatti, Coimbatore. The role ensures maximum equipment availability, reliability, and performance through effective people management, manufacturing improvements, system implementation, cost effectiveness, and a relentless focus on achieving zero accidents. The incumbent will drive preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance strategies while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, safety, and operational excellence. 
 Key Responsibilities People Management 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the mechanical maintenance team, including Shift Supervisors and Helpers. Allocate manpower effectively across shifts to ensure uninterrupted maintenance coverage. Conduct regular training needs analysis and skill development programs for team members. Foster a positive work culture, discipline, and high morale within the maintenance function. Set clear performance expectations, conduct periodic reviews, and provide constructive feedback. 
 Manufacturing Improvements 
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and overall plant efficiency. Analyse recurring breakdowns and implement root cause corrective and preventive actions (RCCPA). Optimise maintenance schedules, spares consumption, and repair methodologies to reduce downtime. Collaborate with production and quality teams to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). Implement reliability-centred maintenance (RCM) and total productive maintenance (TPM) practices. 
 System Implementation 
 Establish and maintain robust maintenance management systems, including CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management System). Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and maintenance checklists. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment history, and spares inventory. Implement and sustain 5S, Kaizen, and other lean manufacturing systems within the maintenance function. Ensure compliance with statutory, environmental, and safety management systems. 
 Cost Effectiveness 
 Prepare and manage the mechanical maintenance budget, ensuring optimal utilisation of resources. Control spares and consumables inventory to minimise carrying costs while ensuring availability. Identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities without compromising equipment reliability or safety. Evaluate vendor performance and negotiate contracts for external maintenance services. Monitor and report key maintenance KPIs, including MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance cost per tonne. 
 Zero Accident 
 Champion a strong safety culture with the goal of zero accidents and zero harm. Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, permit-to-work systems, and lockout/tagout procedures. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst
 Company: Prospect Infosystem LLP
Location: Gachibowli
Employment Type: Full-Time
Shift Timing: 2:00 PM 11:00 PM (Evening Shift)
Working Days: Monday to Friday
Experience Required: 2 Years
Salary: 30,000 per month
 About the Role
 Prospect Infosystem is looking for a versatile Business Analyst cum QA Analyst to join our evening shift team. This is a hybrid role suited to someone who enjoys owning a feature end-to-end — from understanding what the client needs, to defining it clearly for the team, to making sure what gets built actually works as intended. You'll be the thread connecting requirements to delivery, translating business needs into specifications and then validating that the final product meets them.
 This role is ideal for a candidate who wants broader ownership of the product lifecycle rather than working in a narrow, siloed function.
 Key Responsibilities
 Requirement Ownership
 Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from clients and internal stakeholders
Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Create process flows, wireframes, and documentation (BRD/FRD/SRS)
Liaise with clients — including international clients — during evening/overlapping time zones
 Delivery Collaboration
 Work closely with project managers and developers to ensure requirements are correctly understood and implemented
Identify gaps, risks, and process improvement opportunities throughout the project lifecycle
Participate in sprint planning and reviews, representing both the business and quality perspective
 Quality Validation
 Design test cases and scenarios directly from the requirements you've defined, ensuring nothing is lost in translation
Execute functional, regression, and UAT to confirm the delivered product matches the original business intent
Log, track, and manage defects through to closure using tools like JIRA
Own traceability between requirements, test cases, and final deliverables
Sign off on releases with confidence that both the "what was asked" and "what was built" are aligned
What Makes This Role Different
 Because you'll define the requirements and validate the outcome, you'll have full visibility and accountability across the project — reducing handoff gaps between business and QA teams and giving you a real say in what "done" means.
 Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, Computer Science, or related field
Minimum 2 years of experience in a Business Analyst, QA, or hybrid BA/QA role
Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies
Proficiency with tools like MS Excel, JIRA, Confluence, or similar
Solid grasp of manual testing concepts and structured test documentation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration

description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Hybrid Mobile App Developer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying high-performance cross-platform mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms . A key focus of this position is the deep integration of cloud backends, real-time push notification infrastructures, and advanced user engagement tracking tools to build metrics-driven, production-grade mobile solutions. 
 Role & responsibilities Core Cross-Platform Development: Design, code, and maintain robust, scalable hybrid applications using React Native or Flutter ecosystems. Firebase Backend Integration: Implement and manage Firebase services including Firestore, Realtime Database, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Functions, and remote configurations. Notification Infrastructure: Architect, implement, and maintain secure local and remote push notification lifecycles via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs). Google Analytics & Data Tracking: Integrate Google Analytics (GA4 / Firebase Analytics) to track custom events, user properties, screen views, and conversion funnels, ensuring high-fidelity data reporting for product decision-making. Performance Tuning & Monitoring: Proactively diagnose performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and application crashes using Firebase Crashlytics and performance monitoring tools. UI/UX Implementation: Collaborate directly with product design teams to transform high-fidelity Figma/Adobe XD wireframes into pixel-perfect, highly responsive mobile layouts with fluid animations. Deployment Pipelines: Own the entire mobile app deployment workflow, handling provisioning profiles, code signing, and binary submissions to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. 
 Preferred candidate profile Experience: 2 to 5 years of professional, hands-on experience in cross-platform/hybrid mobile application development. Technical Expertise: Proficient command over JavaScript/TypeScript (for React Native) or Dart (for Flutter). Analytics & Backend Skills: Proven track record of setting up custom event logging in Google Analytics (GA4) and configuring data architectures inside Firebase. Notification Mastery: Strong understanding of notification delivery mechanisms, background data payloads, and handling system-level push permissions across iOS and Android variations. State Management: Solid experience with modern architecture and state management solutions (e.g., Redux, Context API, Bloc, or Provider). Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, MCA, IT, or a related technical discipline.

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

title: AT&T Databricks - Lead
description:
Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks . The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills . The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 
Responsibilities
 
 

 1. Technical Leadership Solution Design 
 Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions . Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost . Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 

 2. Palantir Foundry Databricks Migration 
 Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks . Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. Develop migration plans covering: Data ingestion Data transformation Data quality Data comparison/reconciliation Data models APIs/integrations Downstream analytics and applications Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 

 3. Databricks Engineering 
 Provide hands-on technical leadership using: Databricks Apache Spark PySpark Spark SQL Python Delta Lake Unity Catalog Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Workflows Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 

 4. Data Architecture Governance 
 Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture . Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. Establish data modelling and data integration standards. Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 

 5. Team Leadership Mentoring 
 Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. Conduct design and code reviews. Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management 
 Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 

 7. Delivery Program Execution 
 Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. Track progress against technical deliverables. Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards . Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 

 8. DevOps Production Engineering 
 Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads. 
Requirements

 We are seeking a Principal Data Lead to set the technical direction of our Reference Data Platform - the system of record that masters, governs, and distributes the firm's core reference data (parties, instruments, portfolios, and accounts). This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform - spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer - and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. The ideal candidate is an expert Python engineer and data architect with deep experience in master data management (MDM) and reference data within the financial industry - including market data and vendor feeds - combined with hands-on experience applying Generative AI to data platforms, distributed data processing, and building reusable, independently scalable platform components. 

 Roles Responsibilities 
 Own the architecture of a layered reference-data platform, defining the contracts between sourcing, ingestion, mastering, golden-copy, and distribution layers so each is independently buildable, deployable, and scalable. Set technical direction for entity mastering - standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage - designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution. Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration. Define the event-driven backbone and cadence model (start-of-day, intraday, end-of-day, and on-demand) enabling batch today and real-time streaming (CDC / Kafka) without re-architecture. Design the API-first, self-documenting distribution surface (REST, curated data products, subscriptions) governed by data contracts and consumable by applications, analytics, and AI/agents. Drive the platform's storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation. Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains. Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm's data strategy. Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform. Mentor senior and staff engineers, grow technical depth across the team, and set the bar for engineering excellence. Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap. 

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms. Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks. Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems - entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage. Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale. Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, CDC). Strong command of modern data storage - relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) - and SQL. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD). Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry - parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts - and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it. Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling. A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers. Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 

 Preferred Qualifications

Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) and lakehouse catalogs (e.g., Polaris, Nessie, Glue). title: AT&T Databricks - Lead
description:
Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks . The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills . The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 
Responsibilities
 
 

 1. Technical Leadership Solution Design 
 Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions . Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost . Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 

 2. Palantir Foundry Databricks Migration 
 Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks . Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. Develop migration plans covering: Data ingestion Data transformation Data quality Data comparison/reconciliation Data models APIs/integrations Downstream analytics and applications Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 

 3. Databricks Engineering 
 Provide hands-on technical leadership using: Databricks Apache Spark PySpark Spark SQL Python Delta Lake Unity Catalog Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Workflows Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 

 4. Data Architecture Governance 
 Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture . Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. Establish data modelling and data integration standards. Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 

 5. Team Leadership Mentoring 
 Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. Conduct design and code reviews. Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management 
 Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 

 7. Delivery Program Execution 
 Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. Track progress against technical deliverables. Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards . Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 

 8. DevOps Production Engineering 
 Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads.

Job Summary 
 At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 
 
 Role Overview 
 Introduction to team: Distribution Supply Technology (DST) powers the platform that lets travelers search, book, and experience travel across Expedia Groups brands, including Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. DST owns Pricing, Inventory, Content, and Marketplace Trust Safety. Together, these teams source high-quality supply, price it competitively, enrich it with trusted content, and keep our two-sided marketplace safe for travelers and partners. Machine learning is central to all of it. Our Content systems manage hundreds of millions of digital assets, using ML and LLMs to enrich listings, summarize reviews, and moderate text. Our Pricing models optimize real-time prices across millions of products. Our Trust Safety models detect policy violations, fraud, and safety risks before they become traveler-facing failures. Youll work closely with Machine Learning Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product partners in a fast-paced Agile environment to build, deploy, and operate production ML and GenAI systems at scale. That includes batch and real-time inference pipelines, model evaluation and monitoring, and platform capabilities that cut duplicated effort across teams.

Contribute to low-level system design, API design, data modeling, and technical decisions that support maintainable, resilient, and operationally reliable applications. Own machine learning features or components through design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement. Collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and other technical teams to deliver outcomes and apply your expertise across multiple problem spaces. Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions, using foundational AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, and customer outcomes.

Experience owning machine learning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support. Proficiency in software development, machine learning solution development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and production support. Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions.

Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of machine learning applications. Experience contributing to architecture and design decisions across multiple services or technical domains while collaborating effectively with partner teams. Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, or customer outcomes. description:
Job Details 
 Job Title: Senior IT Engineer - Virtualization Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Organization: NEC Corporation of India Ltd. 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a System Administrator who will lead the day-to-day administration, optimization, and automation of our enterprise virtualization platforms, datacenter infrastructure, and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, and disaster readiness of mission-critical workloads, and will support large-scale datacenter projects for government and enterprise customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage and maintain enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), and Nutanix AHV clusters (Prism Central/Element). Configure and tune vSphere HA, DRS, vMotion, vSAN, and Distributed Switches, and monitor cluster and host health using VMware Aria Operations. Design, implement, and test replication, failover clustering, and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., VMware SRM) for mission-critical workloads. Administer hybrid cloud environments on Google Cloud Platform and AWS, including landing zones, IAM policies, and network architecture. Administer Windows Server and Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux) environments for performance, security, and uptime. Manage Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and Group Policy Objects, including user and resource provisioning. Plan and execute patching of servers, ESXi hosts, and workstations using WSUS, ensuring compliance with organizational policies. Execute VM migrations across platforms (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Proxmox VE) using tools such as Nutanix Move. Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment. Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker. Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers). Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams. 
 
 Prerequisites 
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, IT, or a related discipline. Ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in system administration, virtualization, and datacenter management. Desirable qualities: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (or equivalent AWS/Azure certification); VMware (VCP) or Nutanix (NCP) certification is an added advantage. Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis. Experience in large-scale datacenter or government/public-sector projects. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure. 
 
 Base Location

title: AT&T Databricks - Lead
description:
Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks . The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills . The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 
Responsibilities
 
 

 1. Technical Leadership Solution Design 
 Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions . Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost . Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 

 2. Palantir Foundry Databricks Migration 
 Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks . Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. Develop migration plans covering: Data ingestion Data transformation Data quality Data comparison/reconciliation Data models APIs/integrations Downstream analytics and applications Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 

 3. Databricks Engineering 
 Provide hands-on technical leadership using: Databricks Apache Spark PySpark Spark SQL Python Delta Lake Unity Catalog Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Workflows Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 

 4. Data Architecture Governance 
 Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture . Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. Establish data modelling and data integration standards. Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 

 5. Team Leadership Mentoring 
 Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. Conduct design and code reviews. Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management 
 Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 

 7. Delivery Program Execution 
 Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. Track progress against technical deliverables. Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards . Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 

 8. DevOps Production Engineering 
 Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads. 
Requirements
 
 

 Databricks - Mandatory 
 Strong hands-on experience with Databricks Apache Spark / PySpark Spark SQL Delta Lake Unity Catalog Databricks Workflows / Jobs Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Asset Bundles Databricks performance optimization Medallion Architecture 

 Data Engineering 
 Large-scale data processing ETL/ELT architecture Data modelling Batch and incremental processing CDC SCD Type 1 / Type 2 Data quality and reconciliation Data integration Structured and unstructured data processing 

 Programming 
 Strong Python Strong SQL Good understanding of software engineering principles Experience developing reusable and production-grade frameworks 

 Cloud 
 Strong experience in Azure Cloud Experience with cloud storage, networking, security and cloud data services is preferred. 

 DevOps 
 Git CI/CD Automated testing Databricks deployment automation Infrastructure-as-code concepts Production monitoring and operational support Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry will be strongly preferred because the project involves migration of existing Foundry capabilities.

Key Skills: ai,cloud data,cdc,business requirements,automated testing,data architecture,data engineering,azure cloud

 4. Data Architecture Governance

Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability.  5. Team Leadership Mentoring

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management

Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. title: PC-1451-QA Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to join the engineering team at Softobiz supporting the Pickles web transformation project. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies that span manual, automation, API, regression, and release validation testing across the platform. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with both manual testing practices and modern test automation frameworks, with a solid understanding of CI/CD integration, API testing, and end-to-end quality assurance across web applications. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the highest levels of product quality and a reliable, release-ready codebase throughout the development lifecycle. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Manual Testing 
 Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications. Perform cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing to ensure consistent user experiences. Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders. Identify, document, and track defects using issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira), ensuring clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and timely resolution. Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process. 
 
 Automation Testing 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent. Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript. Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build. Monitor and analyse automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys. Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate. 
 
 API Testing 
 Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent. Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts. Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation. Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation. 
 
 Regression Testing 
 Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality. Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status. Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and prioritise automation coverage accordingly. Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement. 
 
 Release Validation 
 Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production). Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness. Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness. Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks. 
 
 Quality Engineering Collaboration 
 Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done. Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback. Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices. Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing. 
 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Manual Testing - Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing Automation Framework - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; Page Object Model (POM); reusable test architecture Languages - TypeScript, JavaScript API Testing - Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing CI/CD Integration - GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines Defect Management - Jira or equivalent; defect lifecycle, severity classification, reporting Test Management - TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting Regression Testing - Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles Release Validation - Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off 
 
 Qualifications Certifications 
 Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 4-7 years of hands-on QA experience covering both manual and automation testing in production web application environments.

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

 We are seeking a highly technical and innovative Lead Engineer, Authentication Engineering to lead the design, implementation, and advancement of enterprise authentication platforms. Multiple Managing Engineers for authentication teams will report to this role. This role will provide technical leadership for authentication solutions, including directory infrastructure, multi-factor authentication (MFA), PKI, privileged access management and vaulting solutions and an in-house developed application for password and MFA management. Drive increased automation and Infrastructure as Code including test driven development practices for validation and control testing Lead large-scale authentication migrations and technology transformations , while continuously improving platforms to reduce user friction and increase adoption. Partner with security, infrastructure, cloud, application, and AI teams to deliver scalable, resilient authentication services and support security integration into application d automation, AI workflows, agentic AI capabilities. Provide technical leadership and people development by coaching Managing Engineers, leading technical product design reviews, and providing direction for engineering best practices. Influence clients and partners to prioritize for enterprise benefit and risk reduction and assist in driving the adoption of technology solutions that leverage existing patterns, practices, and reference architectures. Strengthen the organization's security posture by implementing and enhancing controls to address gaps and vulnerabilities identified through audits, assessments, red team, penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and proactive threat modeling. gaps identified through Own the reliability, resiliency, and operational excellence of authentication services by defining and achieving SLOs, improving service availability and performance, instrumenting and enhancing observability, and leading incident response efforts to reduce MTTR. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends , establish engineering standards and best practices, and provide technical leadership across authentication domains. 

 Essential Skills 
 10+ years of Information Technology or Engineering experience with authentication, identity or security engineering accountabilities. 4+ years management experience. Experience leading enterprise large-scale projects.

 Strong technical expertise and enterprise experience with majority of the following: Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Kerberos, LDAP, certificate based authentication, etc.).  Understanding of authentication attack techniques, threat actors, and exploitation methods and controls to mitigate. Understanding security standards and compliance requirements (NIST, ISO, PCI, HIPPA, Sox, etc.). Understanding of Full Stack Java development.

 This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

title: Subject Matter Expert (Reinforcement & Detailing -BIM)
description:
Job Description 
 We are looking for an experienced Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Reinforcement and Detailing (BIM) to support the development of AI-powered reinforcement detailing solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in 3D rebar modelling, 2D reinforcement detailing, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) for reinforced concrete (RC) structures. 
 The role involves creating production-ready reinforcement models, reviewing AI-generated outputs, identifying detailing errors, and translating domain expertise into structured rules that can be implemented by the software development team. The candidate should have practical experience working with international reinforcement detailing standards, including UK, European, and Australian codes, and exposure to both precast and in-situ construction. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1 . 3D Reinforcement Modelling Develop accurate, fully reinforced 3D models from unreinforced IFC models, structural drawings, and engineering design briefs. Model reinforcement for walls, slabs, beams, columns, foundations, and structural connection zones. Handle complex detailing conditions, including openings, edge reinforcement, U-bars, trimmer bars, lap zones, hooks, anchorage, starter bars, embeds, and reinforcement congestion. Determine appropriate reinforcement arrangements, including mesh and loose-bar configurations, based on engineering requirements and constructability. Ensure reinforcement models comply with project specifications, applicable codes, and engineering intent. 
 2 . 2D Reinforcement Detailing Prepare reinforcement drawings, sections, callouts, dimensioned views, tags, and bar schedules. Generate accurate Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) and reinforcement details suitable for site execution or precast manufacturing. Apply BS 8666 shape codes and relevant reinforcement detailing conventions for other regions. Ensure consistency between 3D models, 2D drawings, and fabrication requirements. Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, and practical constructability. 
 3. AI Model Review and Validation Review AI-generated reinforcement models and drawings against manually detailed reference models. Identify incorrect bar placements, missing reinforcement, code deviations, and non-buildable detailing. Document discrepancies and provide clear technical explanations and corrective recommendations. Identify complex scenarios and edge cases that may affect automated reinforcement detailing. Establish quality benchmarks for AI-generated reinforcement models and detailing outputs. 
 4 . Rule Definition and Knowledge Transfer Translate reinforcement detailing expertise into structured rules, conditions, exceptions, and outcomes for implementation by the software team. Differentiate between mandatory code requirements and decisions that depend on engineering judgement or project-specific standards. Define the inputs required from structural engineers, including concrete cover, bar diameters, spacing, exposure conditions, openings, and connection requirements. Collaborate with software engineers and AI specialists to improve the accuracy and reliability of automated detailing. Maintain a structured library of detailing rules, correction logs, and technical edge cases. 
 5. Engineering Coordination Interpret structural drawings and design reports to understand reinforcement requirements and engineering intent. Identify inconsistencies between design reports, drawings, dimensions, and model geometry. Work closely with structural engineers and software development teams to resolve technical queries. Participate in regular technical reviews and provide feedback on automation workflows. Support continuous improvement of AI-powered BIM and reinforcement detailing processes. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in reinforcement detailing for reinforced concrete structures. Strong practical experience in 3D rebar modelling using at least one of the following tools:
 Autodesk Revit Tekla Structures Allplan CADS RC Experience preparing 2D reinforcement drawings, sections, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). 
 Knowledge of international reinforcement detailing standards, including:
 BS 8666 and UK National Annex Eurocode 2 (EC2) Australian Standard AS 3600 AS/NZS 4671 Relevant DIN and SIA standards Understanding of both precast and in-situ reinforced concrete construction. Strong knowledge of concrete cover, bar spacing, lap lengths, hooks, bend radii, anchorage, starter bars, edge reinforcement, and opening reinforcement. 
 Ability to read structural drawings and engineering design reports and translate design intent into practical reinforcement detailing. Strong understanding of reinforcement constructability, fabrication requirements, and site execution practices. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills. Ability to explain technical detailing decisions clearly to non-structural engineering teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience working on projects governed by UK, European, or Australian reinforcement detailing standards. Exposure to multiple reinforcement modelling platforms. Experience with IFC models and BIM model exchange workflows. Experience in precast factory detailing or in-situ construction projects. Previous experience in model checking, technical review, or quality assurance of reinforcement drawings. Familiarity with BIM automation, rule-based modelling, computational design, or AI-assisted engineering workflows. Experience identifying discrepancies in structural drawings, design reports, and model inputs. 
 Key Deliverables and Success Metrics Production-ready 3D reinforcement models and 2D detailing outputs. Accurate Bar Bending Schedules aligned with model geometry. Structured review reports documenting AI-generated detailing errors and corrections. A documented reinforcement detailing rules library for AI implementation. Identification and documentation of complex reinforcement detailing scenarios and edge cases. Improved accuracy, consistency, and constructability of AI-generated reinforcement models. Effective collaboration with structural and software engineering teams to continuously improve the automation process.

title: Principal ServiceNow Architect - ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards. 
 The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support. 
 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership. 
 Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture 
 Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines. Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making. Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible. Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches. Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records. Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification. 
 2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture 
 Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog. Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies. Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management. Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization. Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration. Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives. Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value. 
 3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development 
 Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements. Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer. Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic. Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities. Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards. Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior. Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation. 
 4. Integration and Data Architecture 
 Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms. Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency. Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications. Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards. Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable. Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints. 
 5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance 
 Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates. Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls. Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls. Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations. Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts. Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt. Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards. 
 6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM 
 Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls. Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure. Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope. Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data. Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives. 
 7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy 
 Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs. Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value. Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions. Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities. Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices. 
 8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management 
 Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities. Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations. Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners. Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans. Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization. Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
 12-15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience. Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures. Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred. Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews. Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting. Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills. Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification. Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable. ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role. Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction. Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs. 
 Expected Outcomes 
 A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture. Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles. Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness. Reduced unnecessary customization, technical debt, recurring defects, and avoidable production incidents. Stronger code quality, security controls, documentation, and deployment governance. A prioritized platform improvement roadmap tied to measurable business and operational outcomes.
