title: Cards Product Management
description:
Role Purpose Own the lifecycle, strategic direction and commercial performance of consumer and business/corporate card products. Lead product design, feasibility, delivery and optimization of prepaid, debit, payroll/WPS, virtual and commercial card programs and associated electronic money services, subject to applicable authorization. Product Strategy & Portfolio Development Set and implement multi-year product strategies and roadmaps for Consumer Cards and Business / Corporate Cards, aligning customer propositions with commercial and regulatory objectives. Design, enhance and launch card products and features from concept through feasibility, requirements, testing, commercialization and post-launch review. Lead customer and market segmentation, competitor benchmarking, product positioning and prioritization of product enhancements. Develop products and propositions for prepaid cards, debit cards, virtual cards, payroll/WPS cards, corporate expense cards and electronic money-linked payment solutions. Design and improve cashback, loyalty, rewards, benefits, digital servicing and other value-added programs, including their financial viability. Pricing, Planning & Financial Performance Develop and periodically update business plans, card portfolio strategy, product budgets and annual financial targets. Prepare feasibility studies, business cases, cost and revenue models, transaction forecasts and commercial recommendations for new initiatives. Own product-level pricing, fee structures, unit economics, revenue optimization and profitability analysis in coordination with Finance. Monitor card issuance, activation, active usage, load values, transaction volumes, portfolio mix, cost-to-serve and retention for both segments. Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports, product P&L reviews, budgets, forecasts and management presentations; recommend corrective actions. Visa, Mastercard & Product Governance Work directly with BOTH Visa and Mastercard product and scheme teams on product eligibility, market initiatives, product rules, new programs and feature rollouts. Own product requirements and coordinate scheme approvals, product configuration, BIN/product setup, certifications and mandate-driven changes with Operations and Technology. Coordinate product-related scheme reporting, portfolio analysis and periodic Visa / Mastercard submissions with accountable operational and compliance teams. Support product-related regulatory applications, feasibility submissions, explanatory letters and launch approvals through the Compliance / Regulatory Affairs function. Partner with Risk, AML/CFT, Finance, Operations, Security and Technology to embed controls, customer disclosures and scheme/regulatory requirements in product design. Go-to-Market & Customer Experience Work with Business Development and Marketing on propositions, campaigns, cardholder activation, retention and portfolio engagement. Own the product customer journey for both consumer and business cardholders, including digital onboarding, card controls, servicing and user experience. Review customer feedback, complaints themes, analytics and service-performance data to improve products and eliminate friction. Coordinate with partners, processors and internal delivery teams to meet product launch milestones and improve existing services. Mandatory Qualifications & Experience Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in card issuing, banking card businesses, or issuer-side payment services. This is a non-negotiable requirement. Documented, direct, hands-on working experience with BOTH Visa and Mastercard, with demonstrable engagement with their respective scheme teams (not solely through third-party providers). Proven experience across BOTH Consumer Cards and Business / Corporate Cards, with an understanding of the distinct product, operational, servicing, and commercial needs of each segment. Previous hands-on experience at an issuing bank, licensed issuer, or directly responsible issuer-side payment institution. Proven ownership of card product strategy, financial feasibility, pricing, launches and portfolio management in both consumer and commercial card products; practical knowledge of scheme product frameworks. Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Technology, or a relevant discipline (aligned to the role). Candidates whose experience is limited to merchant acquiring, POS, or payment gateways, without issuer-side card experience, do not meet the minimum criteria. Preferred Experience & Skills Direct involvement in Visa and Mastercard card program launches, product upgrades, BIN/product configurations and regional scheme initiatives. Knowledge of GCC card markets, Qatars regulatory environment, payroll products, prepaid programs and card-linked digital services. Strong business-case modelling, analytical, stakeholder management, communication and product governance skills. Key Performance Indicators On-time, compliant card product launches and enhancements. Consumer and corporate portfolio growth, card activation and transaction usage. Product revenue, contribution margin, pricing performance and budget achievement. Product adoption, retention and customer experience improvements. Role Boundaries & Governance Accountable for product strategy and economics; not the approver of AML/KYC decisions, transaction monitoring alerts, operational settlement release, or independent control exceptions.

description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Role Summary:
Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 6075% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross-functional teams product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret requirements for project components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solution fixes. Translate business requirements by verifying assumptions and escalating potential design issues to appropriate stakeholders. Participate in system design and architecture, refining code plans and contributing to design documentation. Contribute to project estimation and escalate issues that may cause delays. Develop, implement, and maintain code for products, services, or components, applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. Apply debugging tools to verify assumptions and proactively flag issues before they occur. Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed and address routine pull requests. Create test plans and configure testing procedures to identify and resolve defects for multiple features. Respond to support requests during on-call rotations, troubleshooting issues and deploying fixes under guidance. Leverage and build knowledge of software developer tools to create, debug, and maintain code for components. Remain current in skills by investing time in training resources to improve product availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance. 
 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience. Experience in one of the technologies/software systems Java, dotnet, C Sharp.(minimum two years). Experience in developing and/or implementing web-based or mobile applications (minimum two years). Good to have experience in system design and architecture for product components. Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues. Experience in code review and applying coding standards. Experience in test planning and execution for software features. Experience in responding to support requests and deploying fixes. Experience in using software developer tools for code creation and maintenance. 
Preferred Qualifications: 3 or more years of work experience with a bachelors degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD). Experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services (minimum one year). Experience working on client-facing project or technical teams (minimum one year). Experience in integrating feedback into design and solution fixes. Experience in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams.  Position Overview: 
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager with a proven track record in creating exceptional B2C digital products. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 7 years of direct experience as a Product Manager, with a total work experience of 10 years or more. The candidate should possess exceptional problem-solving skills and a strong ability to execute releases effectively.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to define product requirements and priorities.
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and gather customer feedback to inform product decisions.
Develop and maintain product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives.
Define and prioritize features based on business value and customer impact.
Work closely with UX/UI designers to create intuitive and engaging user experiences.
Drive product launches, including coordinating with stakeholders and managing timelines to ensure successful releases.
Monitor key performance metrics and use data-driven insights to iterate on product features and enhance user experience.
Act as a product evangelist, effectively communicating product vision, strategy, and roadmap to internal teams and stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

Proven track record of successfully launching and managing B2C digital products from conception to launch.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex challenges and find innovative solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Experience working in Agile development environments and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Proficiency in using product management tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, draw insights, and make data-driven decisions.
Passion for technology and digital innovation, with a customer-centric mindset.

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff SMTS
description:
Position Summary 
 Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business problems at scale. The Senior Member of Technical Staff will design, develop, and maintain backend services and distributed systems that support high-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and deliver reliable product capabilities for internal and external stakeholders. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will work across engineering and product partners to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions using modern software engineering practices and cloud technologies. This position reports to the Manager, Engineering. 

 About the Team 
 Our Collector R&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad range of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. This work requires the ability to design and implement workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity while supporting both manual and automated execution paths. The team develops systems that help organize, route, track, and process work across the revenue cycle. These services are designed to improve consistency, visibility, and throughput while reducing friction in operational workflows. Because the work spans multiple stakeholders and systems, engineers on the team regularly balance business rules, scale, resiliency, maintainability, and integration needs. As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes to backend platform and service development that powers these workflows. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience with distributed systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Success in this role comes from building practical, reliable solutions that support customers, internal users, and operational teams while helping improve system performance and long-term maintainability. 

 Essential Job Responsibilities 
 Design and develop backend applications and services using Java and Spring Boot to support business-critical workflows and platform capabilities. Build scalable and maintainable microservices that integrate with internal platforms, data stores, and dependent services. Deploy and enhance cloud-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, observability, and performance. Collaborate with product managers, architects, and engineers to translate business requirements into technical designs and high-quality software solutions. Implement APIs, service integrations, and asynchronous processing patterns that support high-volume transactional workflows. Troubleshoot production issues, analyze root causes, and deliver fixes or improvements that strengthen stability and service quality. Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and engineering standards that improve maintainability, testability, and team consistency. Optimize service performance, application behavior, and system interactions to improve scalability and operational efficiency. Guide implementation decisions by sharing technical knowledge, identifying tradeoffs, and supporting sound engineering approaches within the team. Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve day-to-day engineering work such as exploring implementation options, summarizing technical context, generating test ideas, or accelerating code understanding, while validating outputs carefully before applying them. 

 Additional Job Responsibilities 
 Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-release monitoring for assigned services and features. Document technical designs, service dependencies, and implementation details to improve shared understanding across teams. Participate in backlog refinement, estimation, and sprint planning activities. Contribute to CI/CD improvements and development workflow enhancements that increase engineering efficiency. Assist in strengthening monitoring, alerting, and operational readiness across services. Partner with adjacent teams to align on service contracts, interfaces, and dependency management. Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, peer collaboration, and technical documentation. Evaluate opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual effort through automation and service enhancements. 

 Expected Education & Experience 
 4 to 9 years of software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or related application development. Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building and maintaining production applications and services. Experience designing, developing, and supporting microservices architectures in production environments. Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native deployment patterns. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with service-based systems. Understanding of software design principles, object-oriented programming, testing practices, debugging, and version control. Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross-functional teams. Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical, maintainable solutions. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Key Skills: agile,bpo,business requirements,ai,backend development,cloud technologies,application development,cloud

title: Embedded SW Quality Test Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary You will be a part of a global, matrixed design and testing team, working in new product introduction and existing product sustaining / support. You will be responsible for validating GE hardware and software functionalities.

Define develop test strategies and perform extensive tests to test every hardware and software component of the control platform of GE PC drives ensure that products are bug-free while delivered. 
 
This role requires, in addition to closely interacting with internal external customers, strong inclusive team player with outcome focus willing to work in Agile methodology of execution. As a key member, you will be responsible for software development of core system, libraries, drivers and other modules. Develop software by using secure design practices.
 
You will be responsible for multiple aspects of product development ranging from requirements analysis, feature development, prototype generation and testing, to final design validation, documentation, and product release. Job Description Essential Responsibilities Define validation strategies for testing the control platform of GE Power Conversion drives. Develop test application and automated test scripts using generic scripting tools to perform the testing. Create test scenarios for hardware modules supporting different communication protocols namely EtherCAT, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Canbus, IEC 61850, etc. Validate remote monitoring systems, KPIs, loggers, GE VISOR systems. Prepare test plans, test cases, bug reports and other documents to meet the quality standards. Prepare test rigs for validation and should be able to decide on the hardware and software required for the tests. Manage test laboratory, plan hardware and tools required for upcoming tests, keep inventory and track component movements. Perform extensive regression tests and tests on new features. Develop automated test scripts using Python. Collaborate with Product Managers, Team Leads, and Developers to understand technically the product features and new implementations. description:

You will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Architects, and Engineering Managers supporting Contact Center and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications. You will provide technical leadership across the software delivery lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, observability, and production support. You will promote modern engineering practices including Extreme Programming (XP), pair programming, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), DevSecOps, and automated testing. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Java engineering capabilities with cloud architecture expertise and the ability to guide teams through complex technical decisions. Define and evolve the technical roadmap and architecture for scalable, highly available digital platforms. Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Framework, and microservices architectures . Design cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Memorystore/Redis. Build and maintain RESTful APIs and create API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent standards . Design API integration solutions using Apigee and Java/Spring Boot. Conduct technical discovery to identify business requirements, technical constraints, current-state challenges, and target-state solutions. Evaluate solution alternatives against architecture, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost requirements. Partner with enterprise and solution architects and follow established architecture governance processes. Contribute hands-on production-quality code and conduct code and architecture reviews. Establish and promote engineering quality practices using tools such as SonarQube, Cycode, and 42Crunch , where applicable. Develop automated unit, integration, contract, and performance tests. Apply TDD practices using technologies such as JUnit and Mockito and conduct performance testing using tools such as JMeter. Build and maintain CI/CD processes using technologies such as Google Cloud Build, Tekton, and Terraform . Integrate security practices, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) , into the software delivery lifecycle. Establish application observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and automated failure notifications using platforms such as Splunk and Dynatrace . Participate in and promote collaborative engineering practices including XP, pair programming, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Collaborate in Agile activities including stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews/demos, retrospectives, and journey mapping. Experience designing scalable, resilient, and highly available distributed systems. 3+ years of experience with public cloud platforms , with strong practical experience in GCP preferred. Practical knowledge of GCP services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Redis/Memorystore , or equivalent services on other major cloud platforms. Experience with automated testing using tools/frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito . Experience implementing automated CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code , preferably Terraform. Understanding of API management concepts and platforms such as Apigee . Understanding of application security, secure coding, and automated security testing practices. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, and production observability. Strong understanding of software engineering practices including clean code, code reviews, automated testing, TDD, and continuous integration. Ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and communicate complex technical decisions to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Preferred Deep hands-on experience architecting solutions on GCP. Experience with reactive programming and event-driven architecture. Experience with asynchronous messaging and streaming/data pipeline patterns. Experience implementing multiple distributed caching strategies. Experience with Apigee API management. Experience with SonarQube, Cycode, 42Crunch, Splunk, and/or Dynatrace. Experience with Tekton and Google Cloud Build. Experience working in an Extreme Programming (XP) environment, including pair programming and TDD. Experience supporting large-scale customer-facing or Contact Center/CRM platforms.

 Job Summary 
 The role will drive RuPay Acceptance, Affordability on UPI, Merchant Growth, AI-led Payments Innovation, Ecosystem Expansion, and Product Delivery across domestic and international payment acceptance ecosystems. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Product Innovation Delivery 
 Build a comprehensive RuPay acceptance strategy for domestic and international POS/E-commerce. Define segment-specific playbooks for micro-merchants, MSMEs, organized retail, travel, hospitality, and cross-border clusters. Build and scale EMI and installment constructs at checkout, working with issuers, PAs, and merchants on offer design, funding models, and seamless customer journeys. Expand affordability acceptance into high-ticket and aspirational categories such as electronics, travel, education, healthcare, and home improvement. Work with TPAPs, banks, and internal teams to remove friction in credit-on-UPI discovery, eligibility, and checkout experience. 
 
 AI-led Acceptance Growth 
 Apply AI/ML models for merchant segmentation and targeting, identifying high-potential merchants and categories for acceptance and affordability expansion. Use AI-driven insights to predict and reduce transaction declines, improve approval rates, and optimise routing. Partner with risk and technology teams on AI-based fraud and risk management for credit on UPI and card acceptance. Explore AI-native payment experiences, including conversational and agentic commerce use cases, and define how RuPay and credit on UPI are accepted in these new journeys. Build AI-powered personalisation for merchant offers and affordability propositions at scale. 
 
 Ecosystem Stakeholder Management 
 Build strong relationships with banks, PAs, POS OEMs, gateways, TPAPs, and international partners to accelerate adoption. 
 
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 
 Experience 
 4+ years of experience in payments, cards, UPI, fintech or merchant acquiring. Strong expertise in settlement and payment journeys. Experience in Credit Card on UPI, Credit Line on UPI, EMI and affordability solutions. Strong product strategy and execution skills, from proposition design to launch and scale. Proven experience managing banks, PAs, TPAPs, merchants, gateways and other ecosystem partners. Strong data and analytical orientation, with understanding of TPV, approval rates, declines, conversion and merchant activation. Exposure to international acceptance/cross-border payments and AI-led payment solutions is preferred. 
 
 AI Experience Required

Exposure to AI-led payment solutions, conversational commerce, agentic commerce and AI-powered customer payment journeys is highly preferred. 
 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 
 Merchant Acceptance Growth 
 Domestic POS/E-commerce activation and retention. Expand acceptance across micro-merchants, MSMEs, organized retail, travel, hospitality, and other strategic segments. 
 
 Affordability on UPI 
 Merchant acceptance and TPV growth for Credit Card on UPI, Credit Line on UPI, and EMI transactions. Drive adoption across high-value categories such as electronics, education, healthcare, travel, and home improvement. 
 
 Usage Revenue 
 TPV growth across domestic and international acceptance. Deliver sustained growth in transaction count and merchant-acquiring revenue. 
 
 AI Impact 
 Measurable uplift in approval rates, decline reduction, and merchant targeting efficiency from AI-led initiatives. Improve merchant acquisition and targeting through AI/ML-driven segmentation. Drive adoption of AI-powered payment and commerce experiences. 
 
 Coverage 
 BIN enablement and compliance certifications. Increase BIN enablement across acquiring partners and acceptance infrastructure. Ensure timely completion of certifications, compliance requirements, and ecosystem readiness for new products and payment capabilities. 
 
 Quality Metrics 
 Approval rates and dispute SLA adherence. Improve transaction success and customer experience through higher approval rates. Maintain dispute resolution and chargeback management within defined SLA timelines. Ensure seamless onboarding, settlement, and merchant servicing processes. 
 
 Success Metrics 
 Merchant Activation Retention RuPay Acceptance Growth Credit on UPI TPV Growth EMI Transaction Growth Domestic Cross-Border TPV Approval Rate Improvement Transaction Decline Reduction AI-Driven Merchant Conversion BIN Enablement Coverage Dispute SLA Compliance Partner Ecosystem Expansion (Banks, PAs, TPAPs, Gateways, POS OEMs)

title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description Company Description Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather and analyse data in ways others cant. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and succeed, lenders lend more responsibly, and organisations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, weve helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish - and were not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. Were investing in new technologies, experienced people and new ideas so we can help create a better tomorrow. Job Description As a Sales Manager you will evaluate sales opportunities in multiple domains like BFSI, Telecom etc. Your exposure to Solution Sales/ Consulting environment or financial services will differentiate you from the rest. You will sit within our Consumer services business, one of our four Global Business Lines. We create credit reports by collecting and analysing credit histories - sorting through data about the credit people applied for, whether their applications were successful, and how they paid the credit back. We share this information with businesses so they can calculate a credit decision, usually using a credit score. This score predicts how likely people are to pay back what they owe. This combination of data, scores and software allow businesses to make accurate, fair and quick credit decisions. What you ll do (Job responsibilities for this role) 1. Business Development & Sales: Identify and target prospective banking and NBFC clients, including digital lending platforms, housing finance companies, small finance banks, and other financial lending institutes Increase sales of Experians products and services, such as Bureau Solutions, credit risk solutions, fraud prevention tools, analytics platforms, and decisioning systems. Develop a strategic sales plan to achieve revenue targets and expand our client base within the BFSI segment. 2. Client Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with important decision-makers at client organizations. Be a trusted advisor by understanding client needs and recommending appropriate solutions. Collaborate with clients to address challenges related to risk management, regulatory compliance, and customer acquisition. 3. Solution Selling: Present Experian s offerings in a compelling manner, showcasing how they address specific client challenges. Customise proposals, presentations, and pricing strategies to align with client goals Partner with our teams (example- product, analytics, and implementation) to ensure delivery of solutions. 4. Market Intelligence & Strategy: Monitor trends and developments in the BFSI industry to identify opportunities. Provide feedback to the product development team on market demands and latest technologies. Represent Experian at industry events, conferences, and forums to enhance brand visibility and network with potential clients. 5. Reporting & Performance Management: Maintain accurate records of sales activities, opportunities, and forecasts in the CRM system Track and report on main performance metrics, including revenue growth, client acquisition, and customer satisfaction Identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to increase sales processes. Qualifications What you ll need to bring along (Your prior experience) You have about 4+ years of experience of in the solution sales / consulting environment or a financial services environment Experience with the BFSI ecosystem, including HFCs, SFBs and related domains. Experience with B2B sales in financial services, technology, or related industries. Ability to engage with senior partners. Demonstrated expertise in solution-based selling and account management. Ability to interpret data and drive insights for decision-making. Strong negotiation skills. Additional Information Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experians recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers . Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together Qualifications Qualifications MBA

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life . This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Delhi & Rajasthan. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory. The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success. 

 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions. Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders. Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies. Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption. Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios. Partner with key implant centers to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency. Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems. 

 Required Knowledge and Experience: High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience OR Associate s Degree AND 6+ years experience OR Bachelor s Degree AND 4+ years experience 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies. Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology. Masters degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration. Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams. Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India. 
 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: 
The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Physical Job Requirements

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient AI architecture. You will also be responsible for leading the implementation and deployment of AI models and systems Lead the design of architecture for generative AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem. Collaborate with project managers, data scientists, software engineers, and other stakeholders to understand business goals and determine AI requirements. Design and develop AI architectures, frameworks, and algorithms that can support large-scale and complex AI solutions. Evaluate and select appropriate AI technologies, tools, and frameworks to achieve desired performance, accuracy, and scalability. Lead the development and implementation of AI models, ensuring adherence to best practices in machine learning and deep learning. Develop and maintain AI pipelines, incorporating data cleaning, pre-processing, feature engineering, model training, and validation processes. Optimize AI models and systems for performance, scalability, and efficiency. Conduct regular code reviews and provide technical guidance to junior members of the team. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI technologies, frameworks, and algorithms, and identify opportunities for their application in the organization. Document AI architectures, design decisions, and technical specifications for reference and knowledge sharing. Leadership and Collaboration: Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive architectural decisions. Proven experience in mentoring junior team members, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration. Problem-solving and Innovation: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of proposing innovative solutions to complex technical challenges. Ability to stay updated on emerging AI technologies, best practices, and industry trends to drive continuous improvement.

title: Sales Manager
description:
1. Job Purpose To drive room revenue, corporate business, banquet and conference bookings, and overall hotel occupancy through effective sales strategies, corporate tie-ups, client relationship management, and business development activities. The role is responsible for achieving revenue targets and strengthening the hotel's market presence. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Corporate Sales & Business Development Identify and acquire new corporate clients, companies, travel agencies, and business partners. Develop corporate accounts to generate room bookings, long-stay business, and recurring revenue. Build relationships with corporate decision-makers, travel desks, HR teams, and administrative departments. Conduct sales calls, client meetings, property visits, and presentations. Explore new business opportunities in IT parks, industrial areas, business hubs, and nearby commercial establishments. Develop and maintain corporate tie-ups and negotiated rate agreements. B. Room Revenue & Occupancy Drive room bookings and improve hotel occupancy through proactive sales initiatives. Generate business through corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, and other relevant channels. Coordinate with the Revenue Manager and Front Office team to optimize room rates and revenue. Monitor competitor pricing, market demand, and local business opportunities. Work towards achieving monthly and annual room revenue targets. C. Banquet & Event Sales Generate leads for meetings, conferences, corporate events, social gatherings, and other hotel facilities, where applicable. Coordinate site inspections, client meetings, quotations, and event proposals. Follow up on inquiries and convert them into confirmed bookings. Coordinate with Operations and Food & Beverage teams to ensure smooth event execution. D. Client Relationship Management Maintain strong relationships with existing corporate clients and key accounts. Ensure timely follow-up on inquiries, proposals, and business commitments. Gather client feedback and resolve sales-related concerns in coordination with the concerned departments. Maintain an updated database of prospects, clients, and business partners. E. Sales Planning & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity reports. Develop sales plans to achieve assigned revenue targets. Maintain a sales pipeline covering leads, meetings, proposals, conversions, and lost business. Track account-wise production and revenue contribution. Submit periodic competitor analysis and market intelligence reports to management. F. Online & Travel Trade Business Develop business through travel agents, tour operators, online travel agencies (OTAs), and other relevant distribution channels. Coordinate with the Revenue and Reservations teams to improve booking conversions. Identify opportunities to increase direct bookings and reduce dependency on high-cost channels. Support promotional campaigns and sales initiatives to improve business generation. G. Internal Coordination Coordinate with the General Manager, Revenue, Front Office, Reservations, and Operations teams. Ensure accurate communication of corporate rates, booking terms, and client requirements. Follow up on outstanding payments and coordinate with Finance for timely collection. Ensure compliance with approved pricing, credit, and sales policies.

title: Sr Virtual Designer
description:
vConstruct is seeking an experienced Senior Modeler with strong structural steel detailing expertise and advanced knowledge of Tekla Structures and AISC standards. This role is responsible for independently delivering complex modelling and detailing work while providing technical guidance and support to other modelling resources.The role combines hands-on technical delivery, design interpretation, constructability, coordination, quality ownership, and team mentoring. The Senior Modeller works closely with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to develop accurate, coordinated, and fabrication-ready models and drawings in accordance with project requirements, client requirements, fabrication standards, and applicable codes. 
 Key Responsibilities:      Support project initiation, project setup, preparation of estimates, model readiness, and project kickoff. Review client detailing manuals, project standards, details and specifications to help establish necessary documentation for effective 3D modelling and detailing. Thoroughly Interpret structural drawings, specifications, addendum, reference models, RFIs and other design information to understand and apply design intent. Support project delivery planning by coordinating modelling tasks, internal schedules, planned hours, and milestone requirements. Model primary and secondary structural steel for critical items, complex connections, miscellaneous items such as embeds, stairs, handrails, ladders etc. Review design documents for missing information, discrepancies, conflicts, and potential constructability issues and raise RFIs for technical queries. Coordinate with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues timely. Provide day-to-day technical guidance to Junior Modelers and Modelers. Support project teams in monitoring modelling progress, productivity, and delivery readiness and proactively communicate technical risks, schedule risks, challenges, and potential impacts to project leadership timely. Incorporate approved design revisions, RFIs, and client comments into models and deliverables in a controlled manner and track the COR’s. Support the review and release of final deliverables in accordance with established project quality processes and client requirements. Collaborate with checkers to identify opportunities to improve modelling quality, productivity, consistency, and delivery efficiency. Maintain a strong focus on first-pass quality and minimizing downstream rework. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support coordinated project delivery. Support effective information management, maintain consistency in model standards, numbering, templates, reports, and project-specific workflows. Contribute to the development and improvement of modelling standards, procedures, checklists, templates, and workflows. Support the development and use of Tekla custom components, auto connections, templates, reports, and other productivity tools. Share knowledge, best practices, workflows, and lessons learned with the broader team. Support technical training, skill development, and onboarding of new team members as required. 
 What Success Looks Like Success in this role means consistently delivering: Independent ownership of complex technical assignments from interpretation through delivery. High-quality deliverables with strong first-pass quality and minimal downstream rework. Effective resolution of complex modelling, coordination, and constructability challenges. Accurate, coordinated, constructible, and fabrication-ready structural steel models and drawings. Strong collaboration with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, and other project stakeholders. Effective technical guidance and mentoring of Junior and intermediate modelling resources. Consistent application and improvement of project standards, workflows, and detailing practices. Proactive communication of technical risks, challenges, and delivery impacts. Improved modelling productivity, quality, consistency, and digital delivery capabilities. 
 Required Qualifications Diploma or bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered. 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing, with significant experience in 3D steel modelling. Strong hands-on experience with Tekla Structures, preferably on U.S.-based structural steel projects. Strong knowledge of structural steel detailing, fabrication, and erection practices. Good working knowledge of AISC standards and U.S. structural steel detailing practices. Experience working with engineers, fabricators, Project Managers, Checkers, and multidisciplinary project teams. Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance or mentoring to Junior and intermediate modelling resources. 
 Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Tekla Structures. Strong structural steel 3D modelling and detailing skills. Complex steel connections and constructability. Miscellaneous steel modelling and detailing. Strong understanding of AISC, OSHA and relevant U.S. detailing practices. Working knowledge of Tekla Power-Fab and Trimble connect. Proficiency in Bluebeam or similar review/markup tools. Understanding of BIM/VDC coordination and multidisciplinary workflows. 
 Preferred Skills Experience with U.S. structural steel projects. Experience with Tekla automation, custom components, templates, reports, and workflow optimization. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to technical quality. Knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, or other BIM/VDC platforms. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop other team members. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and delivery commitments. A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in innovation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.

description:
Project Manager Projects & Business Development (Airport Asset Tracking) Job Location: India (airport project location)
 Department: Projects & Business Development (Operations)
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Experience: 610 Years
 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 Working Hours: 9:00 AM6:00 PM, with flexibility during project installations
 Work Mode: Hybrid, with extensive onsite project responsibilities
 Preferred Joining: Immediate to 30 days; notice period up to 60 days may be considered 
 About the Company The company provides technology solutions for asset tracking and operational visibility. The company is expanding its airside asset tracking portfolio in India and is seeking an experienced professional to lead project delivery, airport operations coordination and business development. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Project Manager Projects & Business Development to lead end-to-end execution of airport asset tracking projects in India. The role will oversee site readiness, installation, testing, commissioning, operational handover and post-deployment support. 
 In addition to project delivery, the candidate will support business development, pre-sales, customer engagement and expansion opportunities across Indian airports. The position reports to the Country Head and offers an opportunity to contribute to the growth of the company's airport technology business. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Project Planning & Delivery Manage end-to-end project execution, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource allocation and risk management. Lead site readiness, installation, testing, commissioning and operational handover. Track project progress, quality, costs, timelines and deliverables. Maintain project plans, risk registers, issue logs and management reports. Resolve onsite challenges and ensure timely project completion. 2. Vendor & Contract Management Manage outsourced installation contractors, subcontractors, vendors and onsite resources. Monitor vendor performance, contractual commitments, service-level agreements and work completion. Coordinate procurement, device requirements, material planning, logistics and inventory. Ensure adherence to project scope, quality standards and contractual obligations. 3. Airport Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for airport operators, airlines, ground handlers, concessionaires and technology partners. Coordinate site access, work permits, installation schedules and airside work windows. Manage project meetings, stakeholder communication, change requests and escalations. Support airport entry permits, security clearances and BCAS-related documentation and compliance requirements. 4. Installation, Safety & Compliance Oversee onsite installation and commissioning of airport asset tracking solutions. Coordinate with airport operations and security teams to facilitate safe project execution. Ensure compliance with applicable airport safety, security and HSE requirements. Support post-go-live operations, technical issue resolution, spare parts planning and service continuity. 5. Business Development & Pre-Sales Support business development, pre-sales, customer presentations and solution discussions. Identify new opportunities and business expansion potential across Indian airports. Contribute to proposals, tenders, bids, RFP responses, site surveys, solution scoping and cost estimates. Build and maintain relationships with airport operators, airlines, ground handlers and technology partners. Support commercial discussions and contribute to the company's growth strategy. 
 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Electronics, Electrical, Telecommunications, Mechanical, Computer Science or a related discipline. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Operations, Project Management or Aviation Management is preferred. Experience & Industry Requirements 610 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years managing end-to-end project delivery. Proven experience in aviation projects, airport systems or IoT/technology deployments. Experience managing field installations, commissioning, contractors, vendors and onsite teams. Exposure to airport operations, airport IT, ground handling, airport systems integration, asset tracking, telematics or real-time location systems (RTLS). Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, customers, technology partners and external agencies. Exposure to pre-sales, B2B business development, proposals, tenders or solution selling is highly desirable. 
 Experience in ports and logistics technology may also be considered where the candidate has relevant field deployment and project management expertise. 
 Preferred Certifications PMP, PRINCE2 or CAPM. Aviation Security Awareness (AvSec) training. Airside safety, HSE or IATA ground operations training. 
 Key Skills End-to-end project management and execution. Project planning, scheduling, budgeting and risk management. Airport stakeholder coordination and operational planning. Vendor, contractor, subcontractor and contract management. Airport security procedures, site-access approvals and compliance coordination. Installation, testing, commissioning and operational handover. Knowledge of GPS, BLE, RFID, LoRaWAN, cellular connectivity, gateways and IoT tracking technologies. Pre-sales, business development, proposal preparation and RFP/tender management. Customer relationship management and commercial awareness. MS Project, MS Excel, reporting and project documentation. Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. 
 Additional Requirements Candidates must be based in India and willing to travel frequently across Indian airports, with occasional international travel. Willingness to work onsite and airside, including night shifts, weekends or flexible hours during installations when required. Must be eligible to obtain an Airport Entry Permit (AEP), subject to applicable verification and security requirements. A valid driving licence is required; eligibility for an airside driving permit is an advantage. Strong English communication skills are essential; Hindi or a regional language is an advantage. Immediate joiners and candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days are preferred. Candidates with up to 60 days' notice may be considered.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Job Description Project Engineer Our current projects are engineering-led landscaping projects with steel framing, anchoring, access and MEP coordination 
 Location: Mumbai | Experience: 6 years | Department: Projects | Employment: Full Time, Permanent 
 About Vertvista Vertvista Eco Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a biophilic design and commercial landscaping company operating across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Gujarat. We design, engineer and install green walls, green facades, planter systems, FRP planters and irrigation infrastructure for corporate offices, developers and institutional campuses. 
 Role Purpose Own the end-to-end execution of assigned projects from drawing and BOQ handover through fabrication, installation, testing, handover and final billing — delivered on time, within budget and to specification. This is an engineering and execution role. Plant selection, plant health and all horticulture inputs are handled by Vertvista’s in-house agriculture and horticulture team. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Study drawings, BOQs and work orders; prepare material take-offs, measurement sheets and quantity reconciliation. 2. Plan and drive site execution — manpower deployment, daily progress, and sequencing with the main contractor, PMC and interior fit-out agencies. 3. Supervise fabrication and installation of MS/SS structures, anchoring and fixing systems, cable-net and trellis facade systems, FRP and metal planters, and green wall framing and panels. 4. Verify site dimensions before fabrication; coordinate shop drawings and mark-ups with the design team and consultant. 5. Coordinate procurement with the purchase team; inspect all incoming material against specification, dimension and quantity before acceptance. 6. Execute, test and commission irrigation and allied plumbing infrastructure — tanks, pumps, pipelines, drip lines, drainage, waterproofing and liners — and hand over automation controls in working condition. 7. Prepare and submit client documentation: method statements, ITP, HIRA, material approval requests, progress reports and site MoM. 8. Track project cost against budget; identify deviations, extra items and variations and raise them in time. 9. Prepare RA bills and the final bill with the QS team; close snag lists and complete handover documentation. 10. Update Zoho Projects daily with tasks, progress, photographs and issues. 11. Enforce site safety, EHS compliance and housekeeping as per client site requirements. 
 Requirements 6 years of site execution experience in interior fit-out, civil, facade, MEP or fabrication-led contracting. B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering. Ability to read and mark up AutoCAD drawings; strong Excel skills for BOQ, measurement and reconciliation. Practical knowledge of MS/SS fabrication, welding and anchoring details, waterproofing, and plumbing pipework. Proven ability to handle corporate clients, PMCs and general contractors independently. Strong billing, documentation and site record discipline. Based in Mumbai, willing to travel to sites daily and outstation when required. title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 We're seeking an experienced technical project manager to join our team at Sarvagram. In this role, you will manage end-to-end project lifecycles, ensuring alignment with business and technical goals. You will work closely with engineering, product, and executive teams to deliver high-impact projects while managing timelines, risks, and dependencies. You will also ensure technical feasibility and alignment with business objectives. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background, excellent project management skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams to drive projects from initiation to completion. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working on technical projects, we encourage you to apply. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Planning, executing, and managing technical projects from initiation to completion. Developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation. Collaborating with engineering, product, and IT teams to define project scope, goals, and deliverables. Identifying and overseeing risks, dependencies, and technical challenges to ensure project success. Acting as a bridge between technical teams and stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions. Implementing and enforcing agile methodologies, Scrum, or other project management procedures for efficient workflow. Monitoring project progress, tracking key metrics, and ensuring timely delivery of milestones. Overseeing technical documentation, system requirements, and quality assurance processes. Ensuring compliance with security policies, data governance, and industry best practices in India and internationally. Fostering collaboration, communication, and problem-solving among team members and stakeholders. Define and document project scope, objectives, and success criteria. Manage and prioritise technology-driven projects, ensuring on-time and high-quality delivery. Coordinate with development teams to ensure smooth software deployment and integration. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies. Track and report project progress, milestones, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Communicate project updates and potential blockers to leadership and stakeholders. Ensure technical teams follow best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines. Utilise Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies for efficient project execution. Work closely with quality assurance (QA) teams to guarantee high-quality project deliverables. Track and optimise project costs, timelines, and resource utilisation. Support post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Work with vendors and external partners on technology implementations. Implement best practices in project management, DevOps, and software development.

Senior Manager- Transformation Management Office (TMO) About the Role
The Transformation Management Office (TMO) is a dedicated enterprise transformation function within IndiGo's Strategy Office, responsible for driving and coordinating the organization's strategic transformation agenda.
The TMO serves as the central catalyst for execution, governance across cross-functional initiatives that are critical to IndiGo's long-term growth, operational resilience, and strategic priorities. The team works closely with senior leadership, functional heads, and initiative owners across the organization to accelerate delivery, resolve interdependencies, drive accountability, and ensure sustainable adoption of change.
This role offers significant exposure to leadership and opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical transformation programs across the airline. Key Responsibilities
1.    Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery
•    Support the execution and delivery of strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across multiple business functions
•    Act as a thought partner to initiative owners by applying structured problem-solving and an outside-in perspective to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and strengthen project outcomes
•    Track progress against plans, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and resource constraints that may impact delivery 
•    Assess continuity post-implementation and monitor realization of planned benefits and business outcomes
2.    Governance & Performance Management
•    Maintain a single source of truth for transformation initiatives through structured governance, reporting, and portfolio tracking 
•    Develop and manage dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor program performance
•    Run periodic transformation review cadence with initiative owners and ensure timely escalation of risks and decisions
•    Support governance forums including Transformation Steering Committee reviews, Executive Committee updates, and Board-level reporting
3.    Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
•    Coordinate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Network Planning, Engineering, Commercial, Digital, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Safety, and other business functions
•    Facilitate workshops, reviews, decision forums, and governance meetings to drive alignment and execution
•    Manage interdependencies across initiatives and support resolution of competing priorities and execution challenges
4.    Executive Reviews & Change Management
•    Support preparation of leadership presentations, strategic reviews, and decision-making materials for senior executives
•    Synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into concise, executive-ready recommendations and reporting
•    Support change-management, communication, and stakeholder engagement activities necessary for successful transformation adoption
•    Drive a culture of execution excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement across the transformation portfolio Qualifications & Experience
•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Aviation, Business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred
•    8-10 years of relevant professional experience
•    Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, program management, or PMO/TMO environments preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions
•    Exposure to aviation or other complex, operations-intensive industries is advantageous
•    Experience working with senior leadership in fast-paced, high-visibility environments

•    Executive communication and presentation skills
•    Governance, reporting, risk management, and project tracking expertise
•    Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while maintaining attention to detail and accountability
Technical Skills
•    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
•    Experience with project management, reporting, and portfolio-tracking tools
•    Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent platforms is an advantage

The role will be part of the Transformation Management Office and report directly to the Head of TMO, who in turn reports to the Chief Strategy Officer. title: India Financial Controller
description:
Summary 
 Directs the financial affairs of the India organization and prepares financial analyses of operations, including interim and annual financial statements with supporting schedules, for the guidance of management. The India Financial Controller is responsible for the company's financial reporting, accounting policies, internal controls, tax compliance, statutory reporting, audit coordination, fixed asset management, budgeting, and forecasting activities. The position provides leadership to the accounting function while serving as a key business partner to plant leadership and corporate finance. 
 Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities 
 The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to business needs. Serve as a business partner to the Plant Manager and leadership team. Oversee the Accounting Department to ensure the accurate and timely dissemination of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. Direct the monthly close process and ensure compliance with corporate reporting requirements. Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and financial analyses prepared by accounting staff. Establish and maintain systems and controls that verify the integrity of accounting systems, processes, and financial data. Maintain the integrity of the company's accounting records and financial reporting systems. Coordinate and direct the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections. Analyze operating results and communicate significant variances and business trends to management. Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalization policies, depreciation calculations, and asset verification activities. Lead statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits, and corporate audit requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and regulatory agencies. Ensure compliance with all applicable accounting standards and company policies. Support management with financial modeling, profitability analysis, and strategic decision-making. Participate in special projects and prepare financial analyses as requested by management. 
 India-Specific Statutory and Compliance Responsibilities 
 Ensure compliance with Companies Act requirements applicable to the India entity. Oversee GST compliance, filings, reconciliations, assessments, and refund processes. Ensure timely filing of direct tax returns and compliance with income tax regulations. Review and oversee TDS calculations, filings, payments, and reconciliations. Coordinate transfer pricing documentation and compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with RBI requirements related to foreign transactions, intercompany transactions, and remittances, when applicable. Oversee statutory payroll compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other applicable regulations. Coordinate annual statutory financial statement preparation and local regulatory filings. Monitor changes in Indian tax, labor, and corporate regulations and implement necessary process updates. Maintain relationships with external consultants, auditors, and government authorities. Other Duties and Responsibilities Accomplish all tasks as appropriately assigned or requested. Supervisory Responsibilities Direct and manage the Accounting Department. Directly supervise the Senior Staff Accountant. Provide oversight and support to the Accounts Receivable Accountant. Develop and mentor finance team members. 
 Position Type and Required Hours of Work This is a full-time position. Occasional travel may be required. The position requires regular on-site presence at the assigned facility. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience. Strong knowledge of financial reporting and internal controls. Strong knowledge of Indian direct and indirect tax regulations. Experience managing audits and statutory compliance. Manufacturing accounting experience. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities. 
 Preferred Qualifications Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification. NetSuite experience. Prior experience in a manufacturing environment. Experience working within a multinational organization.

Key Skills: Financial Controllership,Finance Control,Plant Accounting,Cost Analysis,Profitability Analysis,Budgeting,Variance Analysis,Forecasting

description:
Job Summary 
 As a Senior Financial Analyst within Advanced Srgery FPA team, you will support financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and decision support for the business. You will partner with regional, local and corporate finance teams to consolidate financial outlooks, identify performance drivers and risks, and translate complex financial information into clear insights for senior leadership. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Consolidate financial and business insights and prepare high-quality materials for monthly business reviews, forecasts and the annual operating plan, enabling effective discussions and decisions by the leadership team. Coordinate and consolidate monthly sales outlooks from all commercial regions across the Mid-month, WD-4 and PNS cycles; challenge assumptions, identify changes and ensure a clear, aligned global view. Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the monthly reports, forecasts, and the annual budget / strategic plan preparation. Partner with regional, local and corporate FPA teams, as well as commercial, manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders, to translate financial analysis into actionable recommendations and support decisions aligned with strategic objectives. Identify, assess and escalate material business and operational risks and opportunities, providing Finance leadership with timely analysis and recommended actions. Perform strategic and ad hoc financial analysis to evaluate business performance, investigate key drivers and develop recommendations that support management decision-making. Update process flows, operating manuals, training guides, and standard operating procedures, as needed. Drive continuous improvement across FPA reporting and planning processes by simplifying workflows, strengthening controls, improving data quality and supporting the implementation of finance systems, processes and policies. Liaise with the FPA Global Delivery Center (GDC) and other cross-functional leads to support the creation of budgets, forecasts and management reports, while ensuring compliance with all quality / control requirements. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics or related field required. Demonstration of key finance competencies and qualifications and typically 5 + years of relevant experience with financial planning and reporting. Expert in technical and financial knowledge, including understanding of internal control requirements and accounting principles as well as understanding of relevant business environment. Excellent analytical skills with familiarity with accounting, financial analysis and reporting. Excellent financial modeling skills preferred, experience in statistical modeling techniques is a plus. Experience with JD Edwards (JDE), Hyperion Planning, and Cognos preferred. Self-starter with excellent analytical skills and decision-making capabilities. description:
Job Description: Senior Manager Finance & Accounts 
 Position: Senior Manager Finance & Accounts
 Experience: 12+ Years, including a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience
 Location: New Delhi (Head Office)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 . Role Overview We are seeking a highly accomplished and result-oriented Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts to lead the Finance & Accounts function at our Head Office in New Delhi. The role will be responsible for driving financial strategy, overseeing accounting operations, ensuring statutory and regulatory compliance, strengthening internal controls, managing treasury and working capital, and supporting senior management in financial planning and business decision-making across the Group. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership capabilities, sound commercial acumen, and extensive experience in financial management, taxation, audit, budgeting, and ERP systems. The candidate must also be capable of leading a high-performing finance team while effectively coordinating with auditors, consultants, bankers, statutory authorities, and senior business stakeholders. . Qualifications Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification commercial experience. Commerce background at Senior Secondary and Graduation levels from recognized regular institutions. Candidates educated through English-medium institutions will be preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong exposure to GST, Income Tax, Costing, Financial Reporting, and Corporate Finance. Working knowledge of AI tools and their practical application in finance, accounting, reporting, and business processes will be preferred. Demonstrated experience in leading and mentoring a team of 7–10 Accounts Officers/Accountants. . Experience Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in manufacturing and/or service industries. Proven experience in independently handling finance and accounting functions of medium to large business organizations. . Desired Skill Set Strong expertise in financial accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and business finance. Thorough knowledge of the Companies Act, Accounting Standards, GST, Income Tax, TDS, Costing, and other statutory compliances. Strong exposure to treasury management, banking operations, cash flow management, and working capital optimization. Experience in ERP-based financial systems, with advanced proficiency in MS Excel and MIS reporting. Ability to analyze financial data, identify business risks, and recommend strategic financial solutions. Strong leadership, decision-making, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accuracy, and professional ethics. . Additional Preferences Experience working with diversified business groups will be an advantage. Exposure to financial markets, investment entities, NBFCs, or family offices will be preferred. Experience in implementing process improvements, automation initiatives, ERP enhancements, and AI-enabled finance solutions. Ability to work closely with promoters, Directors, CXOs, auditors, bankers, and regulatory authorities. . Key Responsibilities A. Financial Leadership & Reporting Lead the overall Finance & Accounts function across the Group. Ensure timely finalization of monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual financial statements. Review financial performance, profitability, cash flow, fund flow, and management reports. Present meaningful financial insights and analytical reports to senior management for strategic decision-making. B. Taxation & Regulatory Compliance Ensure complete compliance with all direct and indirect tax laws, including GST, Income Tax, TDS, and other statutory requirements. Review tax planning strategies, assessments, notices, appeals, and litigations. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities. Keep management updated on regulatory developments and their financial implications. C. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Cost Management Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term business planning. Monitor budget utilization and provide variance analysis with corrective recommendations. Drive cost optimization initiatives across business operations while maintaining financial discipline. Support business expansion, investment evaluation, and capital expenditure planning. D. Treasury & Working Capital Management Manage treasury operations, banking relationships, fund management, and liquidity planning. Monitor working capital, receivables, payables, inventory levels, and cash flow. Coordinate with financial institutions regarding banking facilities, documentation, and compliance. E. Team Leadership & Business Partnering Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Accounts Officers and finance professionals. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Collaborate closely with business heads and functional teams to support commercial decisions. Provide strategic financial advice and support to Directors and senior management to achieve organizational objectives. F. Internal Controls, ERP & Process Improvement Strengthen internal financial controls, accounting policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks. Drive ERP optimization, automation, digital finance initiatives, and AI-enabled reporting processes. Identify opportunities for improving operational efficiency and financial controls. G. Audit, Risk Management & Corporate Governance Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and due diligence assignments. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions. Identify financial and compliance risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
