description:
Job Description Accounts Receivable (E-Commerce) Company: BIBA Fashion Limited
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Location: Gurgaon, Sector 59
 Job Type: Full-Time, Work from Office Job Summary BIBA Fashion Limited is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable professional to manage e-commerce collections, payment reconciliations, marketplace settlements, and outstanding receivables across various online sales channels. The role will involve coordinating with e-commerce marketplaces, payment gateways, internal teams, and finance stakeholders to ensure timely collections, accurate accounting, and effective resolution of payment discrepancies. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounts Receivable Management Manage end-to-end accounts receivable activities for the e-commerce business. Monitor outstanding payments, ageing reports, and pending receivables across various online platforms. Ensure timely follow-ups with marketplaces, aggregators, and other e-commerce partners for pending payments. Maintain accurate customer and marketplace account ledgers. 2. Marketplace & Payment Reconciliation Reconcile marketplace settlements against sales, returns, cancellations, refunds, and credit notes. Verify commission, logistics charges, promotional deductions, penalties, TCS, TDS, and other marketplace deductions. Reconcile payment gateway collections and ensure accurate recording of receipts. Identify short payments, excess deductions, duplicate deductions, and settlement mismatches, and coordinate for timely resolution. 3. E-Commerce Platform Management Handle receivables and reconciliations for platforms such as Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa Fashion, and the company's D2C website, as applicable. Download and analyse settlement reports, sales reports, return reports, and payment statements from marketplace portals. Track orders delivered but not settled and investigate discrepancies in marketplace payment cycles. Ensure proper accounting of COD and prepaid order collections. 4. MIS & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on collections, outstanding receivables, ageing, and reconciliation status. Maintain platform-wise and channel-wise receivables trackers. Highlight overdue payments, unresolved deductions, and potential revenue leakages to the reporting manager. Support month-end closing and provide accurate receivables data for financial reporting. 5. Coordination & Issue Resolution Coordinate with marketplace finance teams, key account managers, and seller support teams to resolve payment issues. Work closely with internal E-Commerce, Sales, Customer Service, and Finance teams to resolve discrepancies related to returns, refunds, and settlements. Maintain supporting documentation for claims, debit notes, credit notes, and payment disputes. Follow up on claims and ensure timely recovery of disputed amounts. 6. Compliance & Process Improvement Ensure accurate accounting and documentation in accordance with company policies. Support GST/TDS/TCS reconciliations and statutory compliance requirements. Assist with internal and statutory audits by providing relevant reconciliations and supporting documents. Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations and improve the efficiency of e-commerce receivables processes. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualification preferred. 6-10 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable, E-Commerce Finance, Marketplace Reconciliation, or Collections. Experience working with e-commerce marketplaces such as Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart, or similar platforms. Strong knowledge of settlement reconciliation, outstanding receivables, payment gateways, and marketplace deductions. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, and reconciliation techniques. Experience with ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar platforms is preferred. Key Skills Strong analytical and numerical skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to investigate discrepancies and drive timely closure. Strong ownership of collections and reconciliation activities. Ability to manage multiple platforms and deadlines simultaneously. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely completion of marketplace and payment gateway reconciliations. Reduction in overdue receivables and outstanding settlement amounts. Timely identification and recovery of short payments and excess deductions. Accuracy of accounts receivable ageing and MIS reports. Timely closure of marketplace claims and payment disputes. Timely completion of month-end reconciliations. Interested candidates with relevant experience in E-Commerce Finance and Marketplace Reconciliation may apply with their updated CV.

title: Sr Executive - Ticketing
description:
About us Holiday Tribe is a Great Place To Work Certified travel-tech company headquartered in Gurugram. Backed by leading VC firms like Powerhouse Ventures and GSF, and having recently raised pre series A funding, we are growing rapidly and setting the stage for the next phase of scale.We specialize in curated leisure travel experiences across 30+ global destinations, combining deep human expertise with a bold vision of building cutting-edge AI and technology that will transform how Indians plan and experience their holidays.Recognized as the Emerging Holiday Tech Company at the India Travel Awards 2023, we ve also partnered with international tourism boards to bring world-class experiences to Indian travelers.At our core, we are a fun, performance-driven workplace on a mission to build the next big thing in travel - making holiday planning faster, smarter, and unforgettable. 
 Role Overview The Ticketing Executive (FIT / Groups) is responsible for sourcing, booking, and issuing air tickets for individual FIT travellers through GDS and B2B portals and airline consolidator systems. This is a high-volume, detail-intensive role requiring strong command of B2B platforms, fare comparison across systems, strong GDS proficiency, and the ability and the discipline to process bookings accurately within cost and timeline constraints set by the internal process. 
 Key responsibilities Search, book, and issue domestic and international air tickets via GDS (Amadeus / Galileo / Sabre) and airline portals, ensuring best available fares within approved budgets. Receive confirmed FIT booking briefs from the sales / ops team and execute air ticket searches across B2B portals to identify the best available fare matching the itinerary routing, travel dates, and class. Compare fares across multiple B2B systems simultaneously to ensure the most cost-effective option is selected without compromising on schedule suitability for the guest. Book and issue tickets on approved B2B portals after internal fare approval; maintain booking within the portal-specified ticket time limit to avoid auto-cancellation. Verify passenger details meticulously - name as per passport, DOB for infants / seniors, passport number and expiry - before issuance to eliminate name mismatch or documentation errors. Track all live PNRs for schedule changes, airline-initiated cancellations, or waitlist clearances; communicate proactively to the ops team and arrange alternatives if needed. Process voluntary changes (date change, routing change, upgrades) and involuntary changes (IRROPs) through the B2B portal or directly with the airline, applying fare rules correctly. Handle refund and reissuance requests through the portal; track credit shell validity and ensure timely utilisation or refund as per airline policy. Reconcile portal wallet / credit balances and flag low-balance alerts to the finance team in advance of high-volume booking periods. Maintain a daily booking log in the internal MIS tracker - covering booking reference, airline, PNR, fare paid, portal used, and ticket status - for QC and accounts reconciliation. Requirements 3-5 years of ticketing experience in a travel agency, OTA, or tour operator environment. Hands-on proficiency in at least one major GDS (Amadeus strongly preferred); IATA certification a plus. Demonstrated experience with major B2B air consolidator platform - TripJack, TBO, My Partner, FD King or equivalent. Sound knowledge of IATA fare construction rules, airline fare families, reissuance penalties, and BSP reporting. Familiarity with both LCC portals (IndiGo, SpiceJet, Air Arabia etc.) and full-service carrier inventory management. Experience handling group ticketing, including name changes, group deposits, and bulk reissuances. Strong attention to detail - zero tolerance for name mismatches, sector errors, or missed time limits. Ability to work under pressure with high accuracy during peak booking seasons and last-minute emergencies. 
 Required Skills Analytics MS EXCEL

title: India Financial Controller
description:
Summary 
 Directs the financial affairs of the India organization and prepares financial analyses of operations, including interim and annual financial statements with supporting schedules, for the guidance of management. The India Financial Controller is responsible for the company's financial reporting, accounting policies, internal controls, tax compliance, statutory reporting, audit coordination, fixed asset management, budgeting, and forecasting activities. The position provides leadership to the accounting function while serving as a key business partner to plant leadership and corporate finance. 
 Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities 
 The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to business needs. Serve as a business partner to the Plant Manager and leadership team. Oversee the Accounting Department to ensure the accurate and timely dissemination of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. Direct the monthly close process and ensure compliance with corporate reporting requirements. Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and financial analyses prepared by accounting staff. Establish and maintain systems and controls that verify the integrity of accounting systems, processes, and financial data. Maintain the integrity of the company's accounting records and financial reporting systems. Coordinate and direct the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections. Analyze operating results and communicate significant variances and business trends to management. Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalization policies, depreciation calculations, and asset verification activities. Lead statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits, and corporate audit requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and regulatory agencies. Ensure compliance with all applicable accounting standards and company policies. Support management with financial modeling, profitability analysis, and strategic decision-making. Participate in special projects and prepare financial analyses as requested by management. 
 India-Specific Statutory and Compliance Responsibilities 
 Ensure compliance with Companies Act requirements applicable to the India entity. Oversee GST compliance, filings, reconciliations, assessments, and refund processes. Ensure timely filing of direct tax returns and compliance with income tax regulations. Review and oversee TDS calculations, filings, payments, and reconciliations. Coordinate transfer pricing documentation and compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with RBI requirements related to foreign transactions, intercompany transactions, and remittances, when applicable. Oversee statutory payroll compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other applicable regulations. Coordinate annual statutory financial statement preparation and local regulatory filings. Monitor changes in Indian tax, labor, and corporate regulations and implement necessary process updates. Maintain relationships with external consultants, auditors, and government authorities. Other Duties and Responsibilities Accomplish all tasks as appropriately assigned or requested. Supervisory Responsibilities Direct and manage the Accounting Department. Directly supervise the Senior Staff Accountant. Provide oversight and support to the Accounts Receivable Accountant. Develop and mentor finance team members. 
 Position Type and Required Hours of Work This is a full-time position. Occasional travel may be required. The position requires regular on-site presence at the assigned facility. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience. Strong knowledge of financial reporting and internal controls. Strong knowledge of Indian direct and indirect tax regulations. Experience managing audits and statutory compliance. Manufacturing accounting experience. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities. 
 Preferred Qualifications Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification. NetSuite experience. Prior experience in a manufacturing environment. Experience working within a multinational organization.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Responsible for managing and growing strategic/key customer accounts by developing strong customer relationships, increasing business opportunities, achieving sales targets, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Key Account Management Manage and develop relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, and large industrial clients. Develop account-wise business plans and strategies for revenue growth. 2. Sales & Business Development Achieve assigned sales, revenue, margin, and business growth targets. title: Embedded Software Engineer BSP Platform
description:
Job Title 
 Embedded Software Engineer BSP Platform Location: Bengaluru 

 Job Summary 
 Who Are We At HyPrix, were building attritable payload delivery systems for autonomy. Things that fly fast, were enabling them with conscious software. Replicating the capabilities of expensive conventional frontline systems, were building the cheapest micro and cruise missile systems on the planet. Built for a war of attrition, built for the era of software-defined warfare, built to cater to the front lines of battlefields where no man should stand in the future. 

 What You'll Do 
 The Embedded Software Engineer II - BSP Platform writes and maintains the low-level platform software on the HyPrix flight computer. This software is the layer between the silicon and the RTOS. Startup code and clocks. Write and maintain the reset path, vector table and stack set-up for each processor. Configure the oscillators, PLLs and bus clock. Memory, MPU and caches. Write the linker scripts and the memory map. Configure the MPU, caches and FPU, and set the cache rules for DMA buffers. Interrupts, timers and multicore. Configure the interrupt controller from the interrupt priority map. Start the secondary cores and configure lockstep on Cortex-R, C2000 processors. Linux BSP. Configure U-Boot, the device trees and the kernel for the Cortex-A processors. Build the root filesystem with Yocto or Buildroot. Board bring-up. Do the first power-on of new and revised boards with the staged bring-up checklist. Test the clocks, memory, flash and each peripheral in turn. Record each result in a bring-up report, and improve the checklist after each board. Board revisions, errata and defects. Port the BSP to each new board revision and processor, and keep the board and software compatibility matrix. Implement a software workaround for each silicon or board erratum. Write clear defect reports for the avionics hardware team. HAL and drivers. Implement the HAL and the drivers for UART, RS-422/485, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, ADC, PWM, timers and DMA. Each driver must be RTOS-independent and use static memory allocation. Bootloader and firmware update. Implement the bootloader, dual-bank (A/B) images and rollback. Make sure that the unit boots after a power cut at any point in an update. Watchdogs, resets and BIT. Configure the hardware watchdogs and record the reset cause at each boot. Write fault handlers that save a fault record before reset. Write the power-on BIT tests for the processor, memory and peripherals. Non-volatile storage. Write the flash and eMMC drivers, and the partitions for images, configuration. Make sure that a power cut during a write does not corrupt data. Time base. Set up the hardware time base and the PPS capture that each timestamp uses. Latency and execution time. Measure the worst-case interrupt latency and the execution time of each driver on the target. Record the results in the driver documentation. Board documents. Keep the memory map, interrupt priority map, DMA channel map, pin map and errata log current and in version control. Test support. Write unit tests for each driver, and the host build and simulation back-ends for SIL tests. Give fault-injection points to the test team for HIL tests. 

 Requirements 
 Minimum Experience (Years): 3 to 4 years of embedded software or firmware development on microcontrollers or SoCs. This includes hands-on bring-up of at least one custom board. HyPrix prefers this experience, but it is not mandatory. Demonstrated capability is more important than years. Embedded C. Strong C for bare-metal and RTOS firmware. Good knowledge of C++. ARM Cortex-M. Hands-on work with startup code, linker scripts, vector tables, NVIC priorities, the MPU and caches. ARM Cortex-R. Hands-on work with Cortex-R5 or Cortex-R52 cores, for example TI Sitara AM64x or the Zynq UltraScale+ RPU. Knowledge of TCM, the GIC or VIM, ECC, lockstep and the Cortex-R MPU. ARM Cortex-A. Worked with Cortex-A53 or similar, for example NXP i.MX 8 or the Zynq UltraScale+ APU. Knowledge of the MMU, exception levels and the boot flow to the kernel. TI C2000 or F29x. Hands-on work with TI C28x or C29x real-time MCUs, their ePWM, eCAP, ADC and CLA peripherals, and C2000Ware. Embedded Linux. Hands-on work on at least one embedded Linux system, with U-Boot, device trees, kernel configuration and Yocto or Buildroot. Drivers. Production drivers for UART, SPI, I2C and CAN, with interrupt and DMA designs. Board bring-up. First power-on with peripheral tests and memory tests. RTOS. Production experience with an RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr or ThreadX. Bare metal. Production firmware without an operating system, with interrupt-driven designs. Hardware literacy. Ability to read schematics and datasheets, and to debug with JTAG or SWD, an oscilloscope and a logic analyser. Tools. Experience with GCC or a vendor toolchain, Make or CMake, Git and Python scripts. Software quality. Knowledge of MISRA C, static analysis, unit tests and code review. A bachelor's degree in electronics, electrical, computer engineering or computer science.

title: Embedded Software Engineer Mission Computer RT linux
description:
Job Summary 
 Embedded Software Engineer - Mission Computer, RT Linux owns the middleware on the Linux mission computer, and the data link between the mission computer and the flight computer. The position holder works to the platform architecture that the Avionics firmware/software team sets. The Linux kernel, the BSP, drivers, payload algorithms, video compression and the air-to-ground link are not in the scope of this role. Job Type: Full time. Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. 

 Responsibilities 
 Process model. Define the process set, the startup order, the systemd units, the cgroup limits, the real-time classes and the CPU affinity on the PREEMPT_RT kernel. Process supervision. Detect crashed or hung processes, restart them with backoff, and report each restart to the health framework. Escalate repeated faults to a defined degraded state. IPC middleware. Select and integrate the middleware for the mission computer: DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh or a shared-memory library. Bridge it to the message model of the flight computer with the same topic definitions. Flight computer link. Design the transport above the link driver, with frames, sequence numbers, integrity checks, rate limits and topic bridges. Add a data dictionary version handshake at each connection. Isolation of the flight computer. Bound the inbound rates and buffers, and detect loss of the mission computer. Prove by test that a flood, a disconnect, a reboot or invalid data from the mission computer does not cause a deadline miss on the flight computer. Onboard message security. Authenticate the messages between processors with message authentication codes and replay protection. Apply an allow-list of the topics and commands that the flight computer accepts from the mission computer. Application sandbox. Run each application as an unprivileged user with minimum capabilities, seccomp filters and a read-only image. Isolate the applications that handle external data from the process that talks to the flight computer. Time, logs and health. Supply the PTP or PPS time-sync client, and report the clock offset as a health item. Supply the event log and the data recorder on Linux, aligned in time with the flight computer. Report CPU, memory, temperature, storage and process health to the flight computer. Integration and test. Help payload, vision and mission engineers put their applications on the platform. Run the platform in SIL and on the HIL bench with the Testing team. Write the mission computer platform specification and the onboard communication security design. 

 Requirements 
 Minimum experience (years): 4 years of Linux systems software or robotics middleware development, with 2 years on embedded Linux targets. This includes middleware or IPC layer in a product. 

 Required Skills 
 Modern C++. Strong C++17 or later on Linux, with unit tests, code review, Git and CI pipelines. Linux systems software. Processes, threads, signals, sockets, shared memory and epoll in user space. Middleware. Production work with at least one of DDS (Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS or RTI Connext), ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, or gRPC with Protobuf. Real-time Linux. systemd, cgroups, real-time classes and CPU affinity on PREEMPT_RT kernels. Embedded Linux targets. Hands-on work with NVIDIA Jetson, AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+, NXP i.MX 8, TI AM6X or similar SoCs. Networks. UDP, TCP and multicast, with packet analysis in Wireshark. Linux security controls. Users and groups, capabilities, seccomp, namespaces and file permissions. Debug and tools. Debug with gdb, strace, perf and system logs. Python for tools and test scripts. A bachelors degree in electronics, electrical, computer engineering or computer science is preferred but not mandatory. 

 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with Rust on Linux. Knowledge of PTP (IEEE 1588), chrony or PPS time synchronisation. Knowledge of HMAC, AES-GCM, and TPM or HSM interfaces. title: Subject Matter Expert (Reinforcement & Detailing -BIM)
description:
Job Description 
 We are looking for an experienced Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Reinforcement and Detailing (BIM) to support the development of AI-powered reinforcement detailing solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in 3D rebar modelling, 2D reinforcement detailing, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) for reinforced concrete (RC) structures. 
 The role involves creating production-ready reinforcement models, reviewing AI-generated outputs, identifying detailing errors, and translating domain expertise into structured rules that can be implemented by the software development team. The candidate should have practical experience working with international reinforcement detailing standards, including UK, European, and Australian codes, and exposure to both precast and in-situ construction. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1 . 3D Reinforcement Modelling Develop accurate, fully reinforced 3D models from unreinforced IFC models, structural drawings, and engineering design briefs. Model reinforcement for walls, slabs, beams, columns, foundations, and structural connection zones. Handle complex detailing conditions, including openings, edge reinforcement, U-bars, trimmer bars, lap zones, hooks, anchorage, starter bars, embeds, and reinforcement congestion. Determine appropriate reinforcement arrangements, including mesh and loose-bar configurations, based on engineering requirements and constructability. Ensure reinforcement models comply with project specifications, applicable codes, and engineering intent. 
 2 . 2D Reinforcement Detailing Prepare reinforcement drawings, sections, callouts, dimensioned views, tags, and bar schedules. Generate accurate Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) and reinforcement details suitable for site execution or precast manufacturing. Apply BS 8666 shape codes and relevant reinforcement detailing conventions for other regions. Ensure consistency between 3D models, 2D drawings, and fabrication requirements. Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, and practical constructability. 
 3. AI Model Review and Validation Review AI-generated reinforcement models and drawings against manually detailed reference models. Identify incorrect bar placements, missing reinforcement, code deviations, and non-buildable detailing. Document discrepancies and provide clear technical explanations and corrective recommendations. Identify complex scenarios and edge cases that may affect automated reinforcement detailing. Establish quality benchmarks for AI-generated reinforcement models and detailing outputs. 
 4 . Rule Definition and Knowledge Transfer Translate reinforcement detailing expertise into structured rules, conditions, exceptions, and outcomes for implementation by the software team. Differentiate between mandatory code requirements and decisions that depend on engineering judgement or project-specific standards. Define the inputs required from structural engineers, including concrete cover, bar diameters, spacing, exposure conditions, openings, and connection requirements. Collaborate with software engineers and AI specialists to improve the accuracy and reliability of automated detailing. Maintain a structured library of detailing rules, correction logs, and technical edge cases. 
 5. Engineering Coordination Interpret structural drawings and design reports to understand reinforcement requirements and engineering intent. Identify inconsistencies between design reports, drawings, dimensions, and model geometry. Work closely with structural engineers and software development teams to resolve technical queries. Participate in regular technical reviews and provide feedback on automation workflows. Support continuous improvement of AI-powered BIM and reinforcement detailing processes. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in reinforcement detailing for reinforced concrete structures. Strong practical experience in 3D rebar modelling using at least one of the following tools:
 Autodesk Revit Tekla Structures Allplan CADS RC Experience preparing 2D reinforcement drawings, sections, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). 
 Knowledge of international reinforcement detailing standards, including:
 BS 8666 and UK National Annex Eurocode 2 (EC2) Australian Standard AS 3600 AS/NZS 4671 Relevant DIN and SIA standards Understanding of both precast and in-situ reinforced concrete construction. Strong knowledge of concrete cover, bar spacing, lap lengths, hooks, bend radii, anchorage, starter bars, edge reinforcement, and opening reinforcement. 
 Ability to read structural drawings and engineering design reports and translate design intent into practical reinforcement detailing. Strong understanding of reinforcement constructability, fabrication requirements, and site execution practices. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills. Ability to explain technical detailing decisions clearly to non-structural engineering teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience working on projects governed by UK, European, or Australian reinforcement detailing standards. Exposure to multiple reinforcement modelling platforms. Experience with IFC models and BIM model exchange workflows. Experience in precast factory detailing or in-situ construction projects. Previous experience in model checking, technical review, or quality assurance of reinforcement drawings. Familiarity with BIM automation, rule-based modelling, computational design, or AI-assisted engineering workflows. Experience identifying discrepancies in structural drawings, design reports, and model inputs. 
 Key Deliverables and Success Metrics Production-ready 3D reinforcement models and 2D detailing outputs. Accurate Bar Bending Schedules aligned with model geometry. Structured review reports documenting AI-generated detailing errors and corrections. A documented reinforcement detailing rules library for AI implementation. Identification and documentation of complex reinforcement detailing scenarios and edge cases. Improved accuracy, consistency, and constructability of AI-generated reinforcement models. Effective collaboration with structural and software engineering teams to continuously improve the automation process.

 ABOUT US Unbox Robotics is a deep-tech robotics company building the worlds most space-efficient warehouse sorting systems. Our swarm robotics platform - UnboxSort - enables e-commerce, retail, and 3PL operators to sort at 3-5 the throughput of conventional systems, in a fraction of the floor space.  ROLE OVERVIEW Own the definition, integration, and validation of a robotic subsystem or an end-to-end function. Your scope could include motion execution, sensing, robot-to-server communication, charging, or fault recovery. You will translate operational needs into specifications, maintain interfaces across engineering teams, and demonstrate that the delivered function meets its performance, reliability, and cost targets. Success in this role means your subsystem has an agreed operational purpose, clear requirements, controlled interfaces, and complete acceptance evidence - with documents and the implemented system staying aligned as changes occur, and manufacturing and field teams able to reproduce expected performance and diagnose failures. 
 ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Operational Definition & Specifications Contribute to the system Concept of Operations (ConOps) and develop detailed scenarios for your scope, including startup, normal operation, shutdown, maintenance, failures, and recovery Author and maintain assigned portions of the System Specification Document (SSD) and the complete specifications for your subsystem or function Define measurable requirements, constraints, assumptions, and acceptance criteria Functional Design & Interfaces Develop functional breakdowns, state machines, sequence diagrams, and subsystem design descriptions with the relevant engineering teams Own Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for your scope, defining applicable mechanical and electrical interfaces, signals, units, coordinate frames, message formats, timing, timeouts, and compatibility requirements Engineering Trade-offs & Integration Analyse accuracy, latency, bandwidth, power, compute, and component-cost requirements, and validate assumptions through calculations and physical measurements Plan bring-up and integration activities, resolve dependencies, and maintain a reproducible configuration across hardware, firmware, and software Verification & Validation Author and execute plans that demonstrate compliance with requirements and suitability for intended operating scenarios Select appropriate simulation, replay, bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and robot tests Failure Behaviour & Change Control Work with domain engineers to define detection, degraded operation, recovery, and diagnostics Lead investigations across hardware and software boundaries and verify corrective actions Assess changes against requirements, interfaces, risks, and existing test evidence; maintain traceability and bring proposed changes through technical review Production & Field Feedback Support calibration procedures, manufacturing acceptance tests, pilot deployments, and improvements based on operational data 
 Engineering Deliverables You Will Own Subsystem specifications and assigned system-level requirements ConOps contributions, functional diagrams, and operating-state descriptions ICDs and subsystem design descriptions Performance budgets and documented trade studies Verification and validation plans, traceability records, and acceptance reports Change-impact assessments and investigation reports 
 REQUIREMENTS Must Have Experience delivering a robotic, embedded, automation, or electromechanical subsystem into real operation Technical depth in at least one discipline, and the ability to reason across mechanics, electronics, controls, firmware, and software Demonstrated ability to write testable requirements and useful interface specifications Experience using calculations, logs, controlled experiments, and instrumentation to identify root causes Python or comparable scripting proficiency, with the ability to understand relevant embedded or robotics software Working knowledge of communication interfaces and timing behaviour in embedded or distributed systems Ability to lead technical reviews and take an ambiguous problem through to a verified outcome 
 Good to Have Mobile robots and fleet coordination Calibration and control-system characterisation Automated testing Failure-mode analysis Manufacturing test Requirements-management tools Industrial deployments 
 ELIGIBLE CANDIDATES Desired Qualification Relevant engineering education or equivalent practical experience

 WE VALUE Ownership - carries a subsystem from definition through to field performance Clarity - writes requirements and interfaces others can build and test against Evidence-Based Decisions - backs trade-offs with calculations, logs, and measurements Cross-Disciplinary Thinking - reasons across mechanics, electronics, controls, firmware, and software Closure on Ambiguity - turns open-ended problems into verified outcomes 
 WHY JOIN US Own a real piece of a robotic platform that runs in live warehouses. Your specifications, interfaces, and acceptance evidence will directly determine how reliably Unbox Robotics fleets perform at customer sites across India, Europe, and the USA. 
 You won t just own a subsystem. You ll own the proof that it works - in the warehouse, at scale.

title: AT&T Databricks - Lead
description:
Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks . The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills . The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 
Responsibilities
 
 

 1. Technical Leadership Solution Design 
 Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions . Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost . Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 

 2. Palantir Foundry Databricks Migration 
 Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks . Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. Develop migration plans covering: Data ingestion Data transformation Data quality Data comparison/reconciliation Data models APIs/integrations Downstream analytics and applications Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 

 3. Databricks Engineering 
 Provide hands-on technical leadership using: Databricks Apache Spark PySpark Spark SQL Python Delta Lake Unity Catalog Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Workflows Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 

 4. Data Architecture Governance 
 Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture . Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. Establish data modelling and data integration standards. Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 

 5. Team Leadership Mentoring 
 Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. Conduct design and code reviews. Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management 
 Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 

 7. Delivery Program Execution 
 Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. Track progress against technical deliverables. Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards . Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 

 8. DevOps Production Engineering 
 Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads. 
Requirements
 
 

 Databricks - Mandatory 
 Strong hands-on experience with Databricks Apache Spark / PySpark Spark SQL Delta Lake Unity Catalog Databricks Workflows / Jobs Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Asset Bundles Databricks performance optimization Medallion Architecture 

 Data Engineering 
 Large-scale data processing ETL/ELT architecture Data modelling Batch and incremental processing CDC SCD Type 1 / Type 2 Data quality and reconciliation Data integration Structured and unstructured data processing 

 Programming 
 Strong Python Strong SQL Good understanding of software engineering principles Experience developing reusable and production-grade frameworks 

 Cloud 
 Strong experience in Azure Cloud Experience with cloud storage, networking, security and cloud data services is preferred. 

 DevOps 
 Git CI/CD Automated testing Databricks deployment automation Infrastructure-as-code concepts Production monitoring and operational support Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry will be strongly preferred because the project involves migration of existing Foundry capabilities.

title: Physical Verification Engineer
description:
Design Rule Checking (DRC): Run DRC checks using industry-standard tools to identify violations of manufacturing design rules. Collaborate with layout designers to resolve DRC issues. Layout vs. Schematic (LVS) Verification: Perform LVS checks to ensure that the physical layout accurately matches the schematic and that there are no electrical connectivity discrepancies. Electrical Rule Checking (ERC): Verify that the layout adheres to electrical constraints and requirements, such as voltage and current limitations, ensuring that the IC functions as intended. Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Collaborate with design and manufacturing teams to optimize the layout for the semiconductor fabrication process. Address lithography and process variation concerns. Process Technology Calibration: Calibrate layout extraction tools and parameters to match the specific process technology used for fabrication. Resolution Enhancement Techniques (RET): Implement RET techniques to improve the printability of layout patterns during the photolithography process. Fill Insertion: Insert fill cells into the layout to improve planarity and reduce manufacturing-related issues, such as wafer warping and stress. Multi-Patterning and Advanced Nodes: Deal with challenges specific to advanced process nodes, including multi-patterning, coloring, and metal stack variations. Hotspot Analysis: Identify and address potential hotspot areas that may lead to manufacturing defects or yield issues. Post-Processing Simulation: Perform post-processing simulations to verify that the layout is compatible with the manufacturing process and does not introduce unwanted parasitics. Process Integration Checks: Collaborate with process integration teams to ensure the smooth integration of the design with the semiconductor fabrication process. Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of verification processes, methodologies, and results.

Interpersonal Skills: Ability to handle customer queries professionally and maintain positive customer relationships. Technical Skills: Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office are preferred. Work Schedule: Comfortable working 6 days a week, with one weekday off. Shift Timing: Flexible to work a 9-hour shift scheduled between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM. Perks & Value Proposition Health Insurance: Company-paid health insurance coverage of 1 lakh per year. Career Growth: Opportunities for internal career progression based on performance. Promotions: Regular performance reviews, with promotions every six months and accelerated opportunities for outstanding performers, as per company policy. Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers. Team-Building Activities: Regular team events and an annual outing. Why NoBroker? At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to grow professionally while delivering exceptional customer experiences. Join a collaborative and fast-paced work environment where your communication skills, customer-focused approach, and problem-solving abilities can make a real difference. Title: Hardware Asset Management Specialist We are seeking a detail-oriented Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Specialist to oversee the lifecycle of our global Multi-Function Device (MFD) and printer fleet. 
 In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for managing MFD procurement, coordinating complex installation schedules, overseeing equipment movements, and optimizing supply chain logistics. Your focus will ensure that our organization maintains an efficient, cost-effective, and fully operational print and imaging infrastructure. 

 Responsibilities: 
 Manage the end-to-end procurement process for MFDs and printers based on business requirements and approved hardware standards. Coordinate with print vendors to obtain quotations, validate device configurations, and ensure compliance with asset lifecycle policies. Conduct regular physical and system audits to ensure asset compliance, eliminate discrepancies, and optimize fleet utilization. Oversee printer consumables and supply management, including toner, maintenance kits, spare parts, and replenishment processes. Monitor inventory levels and support supply optimization initiatives to reduce waste and improve operational efficiency. Prepare asset, inventory, utilization, and lifecycle reports to support operational and financial decision-making. Collaborate with procurement, IT operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure effective management of the global print environment.

Minimum 3 years of experience in Hardware Asset Management, IT Procurement, Asset Management, or Fleet Management. Experience managing printer, MFD, or endpoint hardware lifecycles within enterprise environments. Knowledge of IT Asset Management (ITAM) principles, asset lifecycle processes, and inventory controls. Strong understanding of asset tracking, inventory management, procurement, and vendor management practices. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and reporting functions. title: Systems Engineering Professional
description:
Systems Engineer Robotics & Automation Work Location Pune Work Mode In Campus Department Systems Engineering Employment Type Full-Time Reporting To Head of Systems Engineering Experience 3-6 years 
 ABOUT US Unbox Robotics is a deep-tech robotics company building the worlds most space-efficient warehouse sorting systems. Our swarm robotics platform - UnboxSort - enables e-commerce, retail, and 3PL operators to sort at 3-5 the throughput of conventional systems, in a fraction of the floor space. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Pune, we operate across 20+ sites in 9 countries, serving leading players in e-commerce, retail, CEP, and 3PL across India, Europe, and the USA. Series B funded, we are scaling rapidly toward our next phase of global growth. We believe great robots are built on rigorous engineering - and Systems Engineering is where that rigour begins. 
 ROLE OVERVIEW Own the definition, integration, and validation of a robotic subsystem or an end-to-end function. Your scope could include motion execution, sensing, robot-to-server communication, charging, or fault recovery. You will translate operational needs into specifications, maintain interfaces across engineering teams, and demonstrate that the delivered function meets its performance, reliability, and cost targets. Success in this role means your subsystem has an agreed operational purpose, clear requirements, controlled interfaces, and complete acceptance evidence - with documents and the implemented system staying aligned as changes occur, and manufacturing and field teams able to reproduce expected performance and diagnose failures. 
 ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Operational Definition & Specifications Contribute to the system Concept of Operations (ConOps) and develop detailed scenarios for your scope, including startup, normal operation, shutdown, maintenance, failures, and recovery Author and maintain assigned portions of the System Specification Document (SSD) and the complete specifications for your subsystem or function Define measurable requirements, constraints, assumptions, and acceptance criteria Functional Design & Interfaces Develop functional breakdowns, state machines, sequence diagrams, and subsystem design descriptions with the relevant engineering teams Own Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for your scope, defining applicable mechanical and electrical interfaces, signals, units, coordinate frames, message formats, timing, timeouts, and compatibility requirements Engineering Trade-offs & Integration Analyse accuracy, latency, bandwidth, power, compute, and component-cost requirements, and validate assumptions through calculations and physical measurements Plan bring-up and integration activities, resolve dependencies, and maintain a reproducible configuration across hardware, firmware, and software Verification & Validation Author and execute plans that demonstrate compliance with requirements and suitability for intended operating scenarios Select appropriate simulation, replay, bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and robot tests Failure Behaviour & Change Control Work with domain engineers to define detection, degraded operation, recovery, and diagnostics Lead investigations across hardware and software boundaries and verify corrective actions Assess changes against requirements, interfaces, risks, and existing test evidence; maintain traceability and bring proposed changes through technical review Production & Field Feedback Support calibration procedures, manufacturing acceptance tests, pilot deployments, and improvements based on operational data 
 Engineering Deliverables You Will Own Subsystem specifications and assigned system-level requirements ConOps contributions, functional diagrams, and operating-state descriptions ICDs and subsystem design descriptions Performance budgets and documented trade studies Verification and validation plans, traceability records, and acceptance reports Change-impact assessments and investigation reports 
 REQUIREMENTS Must Have Experience delivering a robotic, embedded, automation, or electromechanical subsystem into real operation Technical depth in at least one discipline, and the ability to reason across mechanics, electronics, controls, firmware, and software Demonstrated ability to write testable requirements and useful interface specifications Experience using calculations, logs, controlled experiments, and instrumentation to identify root causes Python or comparable scripting proficiency, with the ability to understand relevant embedded or robotics software Working knowledge of communication interfaces and timing behaviour in embedded or distributed systems Ability to lead technical reviews and take an ambiguous problem through to a verified outcome 
 Good to Have Mobile robots and fleet coordination Calibration and control-system characterisation Automated testing Failure-mode analysis Manufacturing test Requirements-management tools Industrial deployments 
 ELIGIBLE CANDIDATES Desired Qualification Relevant engineering education or equivalent practical experience 
 Work Experience 3-6 years delivering robotic, embedded, automation, or electromechanical subsystems 
 WE VALUE Ownership - carries a subsystem from definition through to field performance Clarity - writes requirements and interfaces others can build and test against Evidence-Based Decisions - backs trade-offs with calculations, logs, and measurements Cross-Disciplinary Thinking - reasons across mechanics, electronics, controls, firmware, and software Closure on Ambiguity - turns open-ended problems into verified outcomes 
 WHY JOIN US Own a real piece of a robotic platform that runs in live warehouses. Your specifications, interfaces, and acceptance evidence will directly determine how reliably Unbox Robotics fleets perform at customer sites across India, Europe, and the USA. 
 You won t just own a subsystem. You ll own the proof that it works - in the warehouse, at scale.

Project Controls & Reporting Maintain commercial dashboards, action registers, variation logs, claim trackers, and procurement compliance reports. title: Senior Manager - Transformation Management Office
description:
Senior Manager- Transformation Management Office (TMO) About the Role
The Transformation Management Office (TMO) is a dedicated enterprise transformation function within IndiGo's Strategy Office, responsible for driving and coordinating the organization's strategic transformation agenda.
The TMO serves as the central catalyst for execution, governance across cross-functional initiatives that are critical to IndiGo's long-term growth, operational resilience, and strategic priorities. The team works closely with senior leadership, functional heads, and initiative owners across the organization to accelerate delivery, resolve interdependencies, drive accountability, and ensure sustainable adoption of change.
This role offers significant exposure to leadership and opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical transformation programs across the airline. Key Responsibilities
1.    Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery
•    Support the execution and delivery of strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across multiple business functions
•    Act as a thought partner to initiative owners by applying structured problem-solving and an outside-in perspective to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and strengthen project outcomes
•    Track progress against plans, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and resource constraints that may impact delivery 
•    Assess continuity post-implementation and monitor realization of planned benefits and business outcomes
2.    Governance & Performance Management
•    Maintain a single source of truth for transformation initiatives through structured governance, reporting, and portfolio tracking 
•    Develop and manage dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor program performance
•    Run periodic transformation review cadence with initiative owners and ensure timely escalation of risks and decisions
•    Support governance forums including Transformation Steering Committee reviews, Executive Committee updates, and Board-level reporting
3.    Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
•    Coordinate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Network Planning, Engineering, Commercial, Digital, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Safety, and other business functions
•    Facilitate workshops, reviews, decision forums, and governance meetings to drive alignment and execution
•    Manage interdependencies across initiatives and support resolution of competing priorities and execution challenges
4.    Executive Reviews & Change Management
•    Support preparation of leadership presentations, strategic reviews, and decision-making materials for senior executives
•    Synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into concise, executive-ready recommendations and reporting
•    Support change-management, communication, and stakeholder engagement activities necessary for successful transformation adoption
•    Drive a culture of execution excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement across the transformation portfolio Qualifications & Experience
•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Aviation, Business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred
•    8-10 years of relevant professional experience
•    Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, program management, or PMO/TMO environments preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions
•    Exposure to aviation or other complex, operations-intensive industries is advantageous
•    Experience working with senior leadership in fast-paced, high-visibility environments 
Functional Skills
•    Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability
•    Strong business acumen with understanding of operational and commercial interdependencies
•    Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
•    Executive communication and presentation skills
•    Governance, reporting, risk management, and project tracking expertise
•    Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while maintaining attention to detail and accountability
Technical Skills
•    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
•    Experience with project management, reporting, and portfolio-tracking tools
•    Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent platforms is an advantage 
Reporting Structure
The role will be part of the Transformation Management Office and report directly to the Head of TMO, who in turn reports to the Chief Strategy Officer. The position will work closely with initiative owners, functional leaders, and senior management across the organization, providing significant exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide strategic priorities

Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets. Strong vendor coordination and negotiation skills. Good numerical and analytical abilities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage priorities. Proactive approach with strong follow-up skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment.

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career.  How will you make an impact in this role? Utilizing your skills and passion for customer service to help propel your team and its business partners to success. Consistently deliver extraordinary service on a high volume of inbound calls in a fast-paced, structured, customer care environment with a keen focus on driving a Customer First mentality. Consult with Card Members to understand their needs and tailor unique and personal solutions for them, while also reinforcing the benefits of card membership and acknowledging Card Member tenure Add value for our customers through unexpected relevant recommendations of product offers/ benefit enrollments that deepen customer engagement and loyalty. Utilize your service oriented personality to develop key selling skills to optimize and solidify the customer relationship by deepening their loyalty to our brand. Address general and account-specific customer inquiries- statement inquiries, card replacement, make payments, rewards redemption, etc., and update customer account information. Use tools and resources to identify custom solutions and anticipate customer needs, in our commitment to maintain a first point of contact resolution. Meet and exceed performance goals that include, but are not limited to sales rates, quality goals, compliance regulations and productivity targets, & customer performance metrics. 
 Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree. Should not have enrolled in any prior Government Apprenticeship programs. Strong interpersonal skills with attention to detail and accuracy. A willingness/openness to learning & feedback, adapt to new tasks and challenges Solution centric mindset with strong critical thinking. Strong written and communication skills with a natural ability to have authentic and effective conversation with our Card Members which can help deepen relationships and drive Cardmember loyalty. Resilience needed to efficiently manage a steady stream of customer calls, while balancing performance to meet a variety of metrics. title: Lead Sourcing Specialist - Turbine Parts
description:
Job Description Summary 
The Lead Sourcing Specialist 2 will be responsible for leading sourcing and procurement activities for Turbine Parts Procurement. This role requires strong expertise in supplier development, strategic sourcing, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, quality, delivery performance, and compliance with applicable engineering and industry requirements.
The ideal candidate will have significant experience in sourcing engineered components, preferably within industries such as power, oil gas, heavy engineering, static equipment, or related manufacturing environments. The candidate should be capable of working closely with engineering, quality, manufacturing, and project teams to ensure reliable and cost-effective supply of critical pressure-containing components. 

 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities Lead sourcing activities for Turbine Parts Procurement , including supplier identification, qualification, development, and performance management. Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives for cost, quality, delivery, and risk mitigation. Manage supplier relationships for critical engineered components and ensure continuity of supply. Drive supplier negotiations covering pricing, commercial terms, contracts, delivery schedules, and long-term agreements. Partner with engineering and quality teams to ensure suppliers meet technical specifications, regulatory requirements, and quality standards. Support supplier selection and qualification processes for pressure vessel and pressure part manufacturing. Monitor supplier performance through key metrics such as on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness. Identify and implement cost reduction, productivity, and value engineering opportunities without compromising quality or compliance. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineering, project management, manufacturing, quality, and logistics teams. Assess supply market conditions, supplier capabilities, and business risks to proactively address supply constraints. Ensure compliance with company sourcing policies, EHS requirements, and applicable industry codes and standards. Resolve supplier-related issues and drive corrective actions to support business continuity and customer commitments. Maintain accurate sourcing documentation, contracts, and supplier records. Support localization, dual sourcing, and supplier capacity expansion initiatives where applicable. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering , preferably Mechanical Engineering , from an accredited university or college. Minimum 7 years of work experience in sourcing, procurement, supplier development, or supply chain management for Turbine parts. Demonstrated experience in sourcing Turbine parts Strong commercial negotiation and supplier management experience. Knowledge of manufacturing processes related to pressure parts, fabricated components, machined parts, forgings, castings, welding, and heat treatment. Experience working with technical drawings, specifications, and quality requirements for engineered products. 
 Alternate Qualification Diploma in Engineering may also be considered provided the candidate has substantial and relevant experience in sourcing of turbine parts or similar engineered components. 
 Desired Characteristics Strong understanding of turbine part supply base and manufacturing processes. Familiarity with applicable codes, standards, and compliance requirements relevant to pressure-containing components. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to work in a matrixed, cross-functional, and global environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to manage multiple suppliers and sourcing projects simultaneously. Results-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution rigor. Experience in ERP systems and sourcing/procurement tools. 
 Preferred Experience Experience in industries such as related to power generation, or industrial manufacturing . Prior experience with supplier development and qualification for critical pressure-containing components. Knowledge of quality systems, supplier audits, and technical-commercial evaluation processes. Exposure to cost-out programs, should-costing, and strategic sourcing methodologies. 
 Leadership Expectations Demonstrate ownership of sourcing outcomes for assigned commodities/components. Influence internal and external stakeholders to drive business results. Lead with integrity, compliance, and a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery, and cost. Foster collaboration across teams and support continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Eligibility Criteria Willingness to travel as required for supplier visits, audits, development activities, and business reviews. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and regional/global teams. 

 Additional Information

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Job Description Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator Location Noida Employment Type Full-Time About Axiom Design Studio Axiom Design Studio is a premium architecture and luxury interior design firm dedicated to creating timeless homes and meaningful spaces. We believe exceptional design begins with exceptional client experiences. Every interaction with a prospective client reflects our values of professionalism, trust, attention to detail, and thoughtful communication. We are looking for a highly organized, warm, and proactive Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator who will become the custodian of our complete sales journeyfrom the first enquiry to successful project onboarding. Role Summary As the Client Relationship & Sales Coordinator, you will be the first point of contact for all prospective clients. Your role is to ensure that every enquiry is handled promptly, professionally, and thoughtfully. You will own the coordination of our complete sales pipeline, ensuring that no lead is missed, every follow-up happens on time, every proposal reaches the client professionally, and every client enjoys a seamless experience throughout the sales journey. This role is not about aggressive selling. It is about building trust, maintaining relationships, creating organized systems, and ensuring an exceptional client experience. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Management Be the first point of contact for all new enquiries. Respond to enquiries professionally and promptly. Monitor all lead sources including:

 Website WhatsApp Instagram Facebook LinkedIn Google Email Referrals Phone calls Ensure no enquiry or lead is ever missed. Maintain complete lead records in the CRM. 2. Lead Qualification Qualify prospective clients before scheduling meetings by understanding: Project type Project location Budget range Timeline Decision makers Project requirements Overall alignment with Axiom’s services 3. Client Relationship Management Build professional and warm relationships with prospective clients. Maintain regular communication. Follow up consistently without being intrusive. Address client queries promptly. Ensure every interaction reflects Axiom’s premium brand experience. 4. Meeting Coordination Schedule meetings between clients and the Principal Architect. Coordinate calendars and confirmations. Send meeting reminders. Share meeting links when applicable. Ensure clients are well-informed before every meeting. 5. Meeting Preparation Before every meeting, prepare a concise client briefing including: Client background Project requirements Budget Timeline Previous discussions Lead source Key expectations Special notes or concerns 6. Proposal & Documentation Prepare and share proposals. Send company profile and portfolio. Coordinate revisions and updates. Track proposal status. Ensure timely delivery of all client documents. 7. Post-Meeting Coordination Following every meeting: Send meeting summaries. Share promised documents. Coordinate proposal revisions. Schedule next steps. Maintain continuous follow-up until project closure. 8. Sales Operations Maintain the complete Sales Management System. Update CRM daily. Track every stage of the sales funnel. Maintain accurate client records. Generate weekly and monthly sales reports. Monitor pipeline movement and follow-up schedules. Ensure smooth handover to the design team after project confirmation. 9. Marketing & Sales Support Support the Principal Architect by coordinating: Sales presentations Client-facing documents Sales videos Marketing collateral Social media content related to sales Case studies Client testimonials 10. Reporting & Analytics Prepare regular reports including: Total enquiries received Qualified leads Meetings scheduled Proposals shared Projects won Projects lost Reasons for rejection Lead conversion ratios Pending follow-ups Sales pipeline status Skills & Qualifications We are looking for someone who possesses: Excellent spoken and written English Strong Hindi communication skills Outstanding interpersonal skills Professional phone etiquette Excellent follow-up abilities Strong organizational and coordination skills Good email writing skills Attention to detail Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously Confidence in interacting with high-end clients Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Familiarity with CRM software (preferred) Basic Canva or presentation skills (preferred) Understanding of social media platforms Personal Attributes The ideal candidate is: Soft-spoken and courteous Naturally persuasive without being pushy Professional and presentable Highly dependable Honest and trustworthy Proactive Patient and calm under pressure Solution-oriented Quick to learn Positive in attitude Emotionally mature Committed to delivering outstanding client experiences Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Zero missed enquiries First response time Follow-up completion rate Meeting scheduling efficiency Proposal turnaround time CRM accuracy Lead-to-meeting conversion Meeting-to-order conversion support Client satisfaction during the sales process Quality and timeliness of reporting Confidentiality This role involves access to confidential client information, pricing, proposals, business strategies, and internal operations. Maintaining complete confidentiality and professionalism at all times is essential. Our Expectations At Axiom Design Studio, we value ownership over supervision. We are looking for someone who takes responsibility, solves problems proactively, follows through on commitments, and ensures that every client receives an exceptional experience. We believe that every interaction matters. Whether a client chooses to work with us or not, they should leave every conversation with a positive impression of Axiom. Preferred Experience 2–5 years of experience in Client Relations, Sales Coordination, Customer Success, Business Development, or Front Office roles. Experience in architecture, interior design, luxury real estate, construction, hospitality, or premium service industries will be an advantage. Why Join Axiom? At Axiom, you won’t simply coordinate sales—you will shape the first impression of our brand. You’ll work closely with the Principal Architect, contribute to building world-class client experiences, and become an integral part of a studio that values design excellence, professionalism, and meaningful relationships. If you enjoy connecting with people, creating order from complexity, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Personal Shopper & Fashion Stylist
description:
Employment Type: Full-time, work from office, with local travel for customer appointments and events
 Preferred Experience: 13 years in personal shopping, fashion styling, boutique sales or premium fashion retail 
 About Sevora Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience. 
 About the Role We are looking for a customer-focused Personal Shopper & Fashion Stylist who can understand individual preferences, curate suitable outfits and help customers make confident purchase decisions. This role combines styling, personalised service and consultative selling. You will assist customers through in-person appointments, phone or video consultations, WhatsApp and private shopping events, working closely with our Sales Executive and Partnerships & Community Marketing Lead. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Personal Shopping and Styling Understand each customers preferences, size, fit concerns, budget and shopping occasion. Recommend outfits based on the customer’s comfort, personal style and requirements. Curate selections across available brands, categories and price points. Explain fabrics, silhouettes, garment details, care requirements and styling options. Suggest complete looks and complementary products where relevant, within the customer’s budget. Offer respectful, practical advice that helps customers feel comfortable and confident. 2. Consultations and Shopping Appointments Conduct styling consultations in person and through phone, video or WhatsApp. Prepare personalised selections before appointments, checking stock, sizes and prices. Guide customers during trials and help them compare fit, comfort and styling. Support eligible Try at Home appointments in coordination with the sales and operations teams. Record customer preferences, feedback and shortlisted products for future recommendations. 3. Sales and Customer Relationships Convert styling consultations and shopping appointments into purchases through helpful recommendations. Work with the Sales Executive to follow up on selections, suggest alternatives and resolve product-related questions. Build repeat business through relevant new arrivals, occasion-based recommendations and personalised service. Identify opportunities for complementary purchases without pressuring customers. Capture reasons for non-purchase and returns to improve future selections. 4. Events and Community Shopping Support private shopping sessions, residential community events, exhibitions and collection previews. Coordinate with the Partnerships & Community Marketing Lead to understand the audience and prepare suitable looks. Provide styling demonstrations and individual assistance during events. Help interested attendees shortlist products and book follow-up appointments. 5. Product Knowledge and Team Coordination Maintain knowledge of Sevora’s brands, collections, sizing, availability and service policies. Coordinate with merchandising on customer demand, missing sizes and assortment gaps. Share recurring feedback on fit, quality, pricing and product preferences. Keep customer styling notes and appointment outcomes updated in the CRM. Coordinate with operations for accurate product selection and smooth appointment execution. Candidate Requirements Experience in personal shopping, fashion styling, boutique sales or premium fashion retail. Good understanding of fabrics, sizing, fit, colour coordination and outfit styling. Ability to recommend both Indian and Western wear for different occasions. Strong listening, customer service and consultative selling skills. Confidence working with customers who have different tastes, budgets and comfort levels. Clear communication in Bengali and Hindi, with working proficiency in English. Comfort using WhatsApp Business, digital catalogues, spreadsheets and CRM tools. Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled events, including occasional weekends. A qualification in fashion styling, fashion design or a related field is preferred but not essential. Relevant retail experience and strong practical styling ability will also be considered. A portfolio or examples of customer styling work will be an advantage. 
 Key Performance Indicators Styling appointment-to-purchase conversion. Net sales from assisted purchases. Average order value. Repeat purchases from assisted customers. Customer satisfaction and styling feedback. Reduction in avoidable fit or recommendation-related returns. Accurate customer profiles and timely appointment preparation.
