title: Sr Internal Auditor
description:
Job Description INTERNAL AUDITOR POSITION - Europe and Asia/Pacific (based in Ahmedabad) JOB DESCRIPTION The Kraft Heinz Internal Audit Department s vision is to add value by providing objective and innovative assurance and advisory services. When performing our work, we evaluate risks, controls and governance processes. Further, we provide the board of directors, audit committee, and KH senior management reasonable assurance that the financial data used to make business decisions and to communicate to the public is true and accurate. We also identify business improvement opportunities (i.e. efficiency and effectiveness of operations) to make our business better. We accomplish our mission by recruiting and developing talent for the entire corporation, providing high-quality services to support the department s vision. Roles & Responsibilities: The Internal Auditor will execute internal audits under the direction of the Internal Audit Senior Manager and Zone Audit Director. The Senior Internal Auditor based in Ahmedabad will perform audits cross multiple zones, including Europe , Middle East and Africa, Asia pacific , and potentially certain global audits. Key responsibilities include: Support the Internal Audit manager to conduct the audit engagements, including the budgeting and staffing assignments for the different areas of review, ensuring that adequate documentation and timely execution of the tasks to successfully complete each project Lead business process reviews to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls over the business cycles, as well as the efficiency and effectiveness of operations; Lead reviews to assess the accuracy of the financial statements; Lead reviews to evaluate IT applications and the adequacy/efficiency of accounting, financial and operating procedures established for IT control purposes; Determine compliance with established Finance and/or IT policies and Sarbanes Oxley legislation; Prepare reports based upon audit results, audit documentation, and management action plans defined to address observations noted; Maintain business management timely informed on audit progress, including road blocks, and observations via update meetings and closing conferences. Update Audit Manager and Zone Audit Director as needed on audit progress and potential issues in a timely manner. Be part a global Internal Audit Competency Center of selected business process. As such, work closely the Internal Audit Manager responsible for the area of expertise to analyze issues with global/regional/local impacts, develop trend analysis and compile best practices to be shared through the organization for adoption. Assess the efficiency and effectiveness of actions implemented to address audit issues. 
Communication: Communicate effectively verbally and in writing by adopting appropriate communication style to individuals at all levels of the organization and remaining open to disagreement or new ideas. Articulate understanding of business areas under review, and demonstrates thorough test work and solid rationale for potential audit issues. Update Audit Manager and Zone Audit Director as needed on audit progress and potential issues in a timely manner. Leadership: Develop an open and honest working relationship with those being audited and maintain a professional approach at all times. Share best practices, tools and testing methodologies with other team members, and contribute to departmental projects. Will be leading an audit team, and will be the key point of contact with those being audited. Displays leadership and project management skills to complete quality work on time with budgeted resources. Qualifications & Skills: Undergraduate degree in Finance/Business Administration, Accounting and/or in Computer Science, MIS, or other relevant field; 4 plus years of professional experience in an audit related role within a Big-4 accounting firm and/or large corporation s internal audit department preferred. Additional finance experience would be a plus General knowledge of risk/control frameworks (COSO, COBIT) required; A professional accounting/audit certification (CPA, CIA, etc.) or IT (CISA, CIA, CISM, etc.) certification preferred . FMCG/Manufacturing experience preferred; Sarbanes-Oxley experience preferred; US GAAP/IFRS experience preferred; SAP knowledge preferred; Goal-oriented and outgoing with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Ability to think and work analytically; Ability to develop strong and lasting relationships with all levels of management. Willingness to travel (50%); Must fluently speak English (Asian/European languages are plus) The qualified candidate must be able to work with multiple organizations and teams, consistently meet deadlines and work well under time constraints and be able to quickly learn and understands diverse business areas/systems. description:
Job Description: Administration & Compliance Executive 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 1. Administrative & Statutory Compliance Management Manage day-to-day administrative and statutory compliance activities. Maintain records of licenses, registrations, NOCs and statutory certificates. Track expiry dates, renewals and pending approvals. Coordinate with internal departments and consultants for compliance requirements. 
 2. Licensing & Regulatory Coordination Coordinate applications, renewals and amendments for statutory licenses and approvals. Handle documentation for Drug License, FDCA, Factory License, PCB Consent, PESO and other applicable licenses. Liaise with government authorities for approvals, inspections and clarifications. Maintain license trackers and ensure timely submissions. 
 3. EXIM & Export Compliance Support Coordinate documentation related to IEC, DGFT, ICEGATE and export authorizations. Support SCOMET documentation and export compliance, wherever applicable. Coordinate with EXIM, logistics and commercial teams for regulatory documents. Maintain records of export approvals, NOCs and declarations. 
 4. NDPS & Controlled Substances Compliance Coordination Maintain documentation related to NDPS, controlled substances and precursor chemicals, wherever applicable. Coordinate stock registers, movement records and statutory reports with authorized departments. Liaise with NCB, CBN and other relevant authorities for applicable permissions and submissions. Coordinate with Production, Stores, EHS and QA teams for compliance records and inspections. 
 5. Documentation & Record Management Prepare and maintain licenses, applications, NOCs, declarations and official correspondence. Maintain physical and digital records with proper document control. Ensure documents are updated, accurate and readily accessible. Maintain confidentiality of company and regulatory records. 
 6. Government Liaison & Consultant Coordination Coordinate with government offices, licensing authorities and external consultants. Follow up on applications, renewals, approvals and official communications. Schedule regulatory inspections, meetings and official visits. Maintain submission records and escalate delays to management. 
 7. Travel, Visa & Visitor Management Arrange employee business travel, tickets, accommodation and transportation. Coordinate visa applications, invitation letters and supporting documents. Manage visitor arrangements, client visits and official travel records. Support meetings, exhibitions, conferences and official visits. 
 8. Audit & Inspection Support Coordinate preparations for internal audits, external audits and regulatory inspections. Ensure availability of licenses, statutory records and supporting documents. Coordinate document collection and closure of audit observations. Maintain audit records and corrective action trackers. 
 9. MIS Reporting & Compliance Tracking Prepare MIS reports on license status, renewals, pending approvals and administrative activities. Maintain Excel trackers for compliance deadlines, applications and follow-ups. Update management on completed activities, pending matters and potential delays. Maintain records of travel expenses, consultant coordination and administrative activities. 
 10. Cross-Functional Coordination & Problem Solving Coordinate with HR, Finance, QA, QC, Production, R&D, EHS, Supply Chain and EXIM teams. Collect documents required for applications, renewals and compliance activities. Identify documentation gaps and upcoming deadlines and ensure timely follow-up. Resolve routine administrative issues and escalate critical matters to management. 
 Qualification & Experience

title: Team Member - Stores & Logistics
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Stores Logistics Engineer is responsible for managing the receipt, storage, inventory control, handling, and dispatch of raw materials, purchased components, consumables, sub-assemblies, and finished CNC machines. The role ensures uninterrupted material availability for production, accurate inventory records, efficient warehouse operations, and timely logistics coordination to support manufacturing and customer delivery commitments. 
 
 Key Roles Responsibilities 
 
 1. Store Management 
 Manage inward receipt of raw materials, bought-out parts, electrical components, consumables, and production materials. Verify incoming materials against purchase orders, delivery challans, and quality requirements. Ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and preservation of materials. Maintain organized warehouse layouts for efficient material movement and retrieval. Implement FIFO (First-In-First-Out) and inventory control practices. Monitor stock levels and initiate replenishment requests to avoid shortages. 
 
 2. Inventory Control 
 Maintain accurate inventory records in ERP/MRP systems. Perform regular stock verification, cycle counts, and annual physical inventory audits. Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective actions. Track slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory. Generate inventory reports and KPIs for management review. Ensure optimum inventory levels while minimizing carrying costs. 
 
 3. Production Material Coordination 
 Issue materials to production as per work orders and production schedules. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Procurement, and Quality teams to ensure timely material availability. Monitor material consumption and report variances. Support production continuity by ensuring adequate stock of critical machine components. 
 
 4. Logistics Transportation Management 
 Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics activities. Arrange transportation for dispatch of CNC machines, spare parts, and customer orders. Liaise with transporters, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers. Ensure timely shipment scheduling and delivery tracking. Optimize transportation costs and improve logistics efficiency. Manage export and domestic shipment documentation when applicable. 
 
 5. Documentation Compliance 
 Maintain all stores and logistics records accurately. Prepare GRN (Goods Receipt Notes), Material Issue Notes, Delivery Challans, and Dispatch Documents. Ensure compliance with company procedures, inventory standards, and safety regulations. Support internal and external audits by maintaining proper documentation. Ensure adherence to statutory and transportation compliance requirements. 
 
 6. Warehouse Operations Safety 
 Ensure safe handling of machine components, heavy parts, and finished goods. Maintain warehouse cleanliness, housekeeping, and 5S standards. Monitor material handling equipment utilization and maintenance. Implement safety practices related to storage, loading, unloading, and transportation. Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives in stores and logistics processes. 
 
 7. Vendor and Stakeholder Coordination 
 Coordinate with suppliers regarding material deliveries and shortages. Work closely with procurement teams to resolve supply issues. Support customer dispatch requirements and delivery commitments. Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams regarding inventory status and logistics schedules.

title: Fermentation Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 FERMENTATION OPERATIONS Run fermentation plant operations from bench scale to 20 KL at full capacity utilisation, and improve their efficiency. Apply hands-on expertise in wild-type and recombinant microbial fermentation across multiple commercial products. Operate and troubleshoot fully automatic, bulk-scale fermenters, with a working understanding of scale-up to the capacity in the pipeline. Drive process optimisation and standardisation through new protocols and strategies; identify and resolve critical bottlenecks and process gaps. Own contamination control prevention, detection, and corrective action. DOWNSTREAM PROCESSING Own DSP operations end to end — centrifugation, chromatography column purification, membrane separation (UF/MF/TFF), solvent extraction, evaporation and distillation, and crystallisation. Hold DSP to the same rigour, uptime, and compliance discipline as fermentation, from harvest through to final product release. Troubleshoot DSP deviations hands-on, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive action. PROCESS OPTIMISATION & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT Implement cost-effective improvements across manufacturing KPIs — product titre, batch throughput, yield and recovery, and overall equipment effectiveness. Recommend and implement changes to workflow, operations, and equipment that raise production efficiency and reduce cost without compromising quality. Contribute to annual operating budgets and CAPEX planning for facility expansion, equipment procurement, and process improvements. QUALITY, COMPLIANCE & DOCUMENTATION Prepare, validate, and implement SOPs for fermentation, downstream processing, cleaning, and sanitation. Ensure compliance with cGMP, HACCP, and Good Hygiene Practices across all fermentation and DSP operations, keeping records complete and audit-ready. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in regulatory, quality, and customer audits; support drafting and approval of process and quality-system documentation. Serve as an active member of the Food Safety team, supporting HACCP and food-safety system reviews. EQUIPMENT, MAINTENANCE & ASSET MANAGEMENT Monitor and maintain the health of fermenters, DSP equipment, and related systems; plan and run preventive, annual, and breakdown maintenance to maximise reliability. Manage critical and non-critical spares for fermentation and DSP equipment. COLLABORATION & TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER Work with R&D on process scale-up and commercialisation, including adaptation of technology transfers from the JV partner and in-house R&D into plant operations. Coordinate across Quality, Engineering, and Supply Chain for smooth execution of daily operations. TEAM LEADERSHIP Lead, and be hands-on with, a round-the-clock fermentation and DSP team, giving direct guidance and technical mentorship on the floor. Train and develop team members to build technical depth and meet production goals. 
 Basic qualifications Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Life Sciences, Bio-Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on industry experience. 10 + years of hands-on experience in biomanufacturing or fermentation-based operations. Hands-on experience with fully automatic, bulk-scale fermenters of 10 KL and above. This is mandatory. Working knowledge of downstream processing — centrifugation, TFF, chromatography column purification, solvent extraction, evaporation and distillation, and crystallisation. Demonstrated experience operating in a cGMP, HACCP, or food-safety regulated environment, with strong personal ownership of compliance and documentation. Proven ability to lead and work hands-on with round-the-clock production teams. 
 Preferred experience Experience in a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation, including client specifications and on-spec, on-time delivery. Exposure to technology transfer or scale-up from a JV partner’s or external R&D into commercial manufacturing. Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or TQM. Understanding of geography-specific regulatory requirements for biomanufacturing and food-grade ingredients.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Overview Architect and build a scalable, event-driven, AI-enabled full-stack platform with strong ownership across backend, frontend, and system design. Drive systems that are observable, resilient, secure, and production-grade by design, not as afterthoughts. Core Responsibilities 1. Design Event-Driven Systems Build systems using event-first architecture (NATS or similar), not REST-centric design. Define event contracts, schemas, naming conventions, and lifecycle flows. Ensure idempotency for safe reprocessing. Implement retry strategies, including exponential backoff and Dead Letter Queues (DLQs). Ensure failure isolation, recovery, and loose coupling between services. Implement event versioning and backward compatibility strategies. 2. Build Scalable Backend (Spring Boot) Develop domain-driven microservices with clear bounded contexts. Use REST APIs for synchronous UI interactions and events for asynchronous workflows and orchestration. Ensure high throughput, low latency, and secure service-to-service communication. Apply clean architecture principles, including layered or hexagonal architecture where applicable. Implement caching, connection pooling, and performance tuning. 3. Integrate AI Agents (Python Services) Treat AI as a decoupled, event-driven service layer. Design asynchronous execution through events. Implement timeouts, retries, and circuit breakers. Develop fallback strategies for degraded AI responses. Handle non-deterministic AI outputs safely. Work with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Amazon Bedrock. Implement prompt versioning, traceability, and response auditing. 4. Build Modern Frontend (Angular) Develop responsive Single Page Applications (SPAs) using Angular. Visualize real-time workflow execution and system state. Implement efficient state management and reactive programming using RxJS. Optimize performance through lazy loading and appropriate change detection strategies. Integrate event streams and WebSockets for live updates. 5. Identity & Security (SSO) Implement and integrate SAML, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, and CAS. Ensure secure token propagation across services. Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC). Ensure secure secrets management. Address zero-trust architecture and service authentication patterns. 6. Data & System Design Use PostgreSQL or similar RDBMS technologies with strong schema design discipline. Avoid tight coupling across services and shared database anti-patterns. Ensure data consistency, including eventual consistency where required. Maintain auditability and traceability. Design systems for multi-tenancy, high availability, data partitioning, and scalability. 7. Observability & Reliability Build first-class observability into every component. Implement structured logging with correlation IDs and trace IDs. Monitor metrics such as latency, throughput, error rates, and queue depth. Implement distributed tracing using OpenTelemetry or similar tools. Define and monitor SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Implement health checks and readiness probes. Configure alerting and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools. Enable end-to-end traceability across event-driven workflows and AI calls. 8. DevOps & Platform Engineering Work in Linux environments with strong command-line proficiency. Use Git, Maven, and CI/CD pipelines. Build continuously deployable systems using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation. Ensure environment parity across development, staging, and production. Implement rollback strategies and safe deployment practices. Non-Functional Requirements (Explicit Ownership) The candidate will be responsible for designing systems that meet the following requirements: Scalability: Horizontal scaling and event throughput handling. Reliability: Fault tolerance and graceful degradation. Performance: Low-latency APIs and efficient asynchronous processing. Security: End-to-end secure architecture. Observability: Full system visibility and traceability. Maintainability: Clean code and modular design. Extensibility: Plug-and-play connectors and workflows. Cost Efficiency: Optimized infrastructure and compute usage. Compliance Readiness: Audit logs and access tracking. Required Skills Must-Have Skills 10+ years of experience in enterprise application development. Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot. Strong experience with event-driven architecture using NATS, Kafka, or similar technologies. Strong Angular expertise, with at least 3+ years of SPA development experience. Experience with microservices architecture. Strong knowledge of SQL and Hibernate. Experience in distributed systems design. Good-to-Have Skills AI/LLM integration experience. IAM and SSO systems, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and CAS. Cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Workflow and orchestration systems. Experience with observability stacks such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Key Skills: Java,Spring Boot,Technical Architecture,Angular,Microservices,AWS,Spring,Boot

 Department: Human Resources

 Reports To: Portfolio HR Director 
 Travel Requirement: Frequent inter-property travel across assigned hotels About Holiday Inn Express At Holiday Inn Express, we believe in making travel simple and smart. We focus on delivering a comfortable stay, friendly service and the essentials that matter most to our guests. As part of IHG Hotels Resorts, we are committed to creating True Hospitality for everyone. We are looking for a people-oriented HR professional who can support our hotel teams, strengthen employee engagement and drive consistent HR practices across our multi-property portfolio. Role Overview - What Is the Job The Cluster Assistant HR Manager will support and drive the Human Resources function across assigned Holiday Inn Express hotels in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai. The role will be responsible for implementing HR policies and procedures, talent acquisition, employee engagement, learning and development, performance management, employee relations, payroll coordination and statutory compliance. The position will work closely with General Managers, Hotel Managers, Department Heads and the Portfolio HR Director to build a positive workplace culture, ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and support business performance through effective people management. This is a multi-property role requiring strong execution, stakeholder management, analytical skills and the ability to travel regularly across assigned hotel locations. Key Responsibilities 1. Human Resources Operations Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR operations across assigned hotel properties, ensuring consistency in HR processes and adherence to company policies. Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, attendance and employee lifecycle data. Coordinate onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, employee separations and full-and-final settlement inputs. Support the implementation and effective utilisation of HRMS and recruitment systems. Ensure timely preparation of HR reports, manpower updates, organisational structures and other management reports. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and HR records. 2. Talent Acquisition and Manpower Planning Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including manpower requisitions, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, selection coordination and offer management. Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely recruitment. Monitor vacancies, recruitment turnaround time, joining ratios and manpower availability across the assigned hotels. Ensure recruitment practices comply with IHG standards, company policies and applicable employment requirements. Support effective manpower planning, internal career progression and talent development initiatives. 3. Payroll, Compensation Benefits Coordinate monthly attendance, payroll inputs, employee master updates, leave data, incentives and other salary-related information with the respective stakeholders and payroll team. Review payroll inputs for completeness and accuracy and facilitate timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate employee benefits, salary revisions, reimbursements and other compensation-related processes as applicable. Monitor employee costs and manpower expenses against approved budgets. Support preparation and validation of payroll reports, employee cost analysis and related management information. 4. Statutory Compliance and Employee Documentation Ensure timely coordination and monitoring of applicable statutory compliances, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity and other applicable employment requirements. Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, vendors and relevant stakeholders for statutory calculations, payments, returns, registers and documentation. Monitor applicable central and state employment laws, statutory deadlines, regulatory changes and establishment-specific requirements. Maintain compliance records, licences, registers, notices and other prescribed documentation as applicable. Conduct periodic HR compliance reviews and support internal and external audits. Track compliance gaps, facilitate corrective actions and escalate material risks to the Portfolio HR Director and relevant management. 5. Employee Engagement, Relations Retention Promote the IHG Winning Ways culture and create a positive, inclusive and engaging work environment. Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, recognition programmes, celebrations and team-building initiatives. Support employee satisfaction surveys and develop action plans based on feedback. Address employee queries, grievances and workplace concerns promptly, fairly and confidentially. Conduct exit interviews, analyse attrition and absenteeism trends, and recommend appropriate retention initiatives. Build effective relationships with employees, Department Heads and hotel leadership teams. 6. Learning, Development Performance Management Coordinate new-joiner induction, HR orientation and employee awareness programmes. Support training needs identification and the implementation of learning and development initiatives. Guide managers on HR policies, performance management, employee development and people-related matters. Monitor performance appraisal cycles, probation reviews and confirmation processes. Support succession planning, talent development and internal career opportunities. Encourage continuous learning and reinforce the service culture expected at Holiday Inn Express. 7. Employee Welfare, POSH Workplace Standards Support implementation of employee welfare initiatives and workplace policies. Coordinate awareness programmes relating to the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) and other applicable workplace requirements. Support the appropriate handling and escalation of workplace complaints in accordance with company policy and applicable law. Promote respectful workplace behaviour, equal opportunity and a culture of inclusion. Ensure employee-related departmental SOPs and HR standards are communicated and followed. 8. Business Partnership Guest Experience Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to align HR initiatives with hotel business objectives and guest service standards. Support service standards audits and communicate relevant people-related observations and improvement opportunities. Develop initiatives to motivate employees and improve service delivery, productivity and guest satisfaction. Monitor staffing levels, employee productivity and labour costs to support operational efficiency. Contribute to regional and portfolio-level HR initiatives, projects and special assignments as directed by the Portfolio HR Director. 9. HR Reporting, Analytics Continuous Improvement Prepare periodic HR dashboards and reports covering manpower, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, employee movements, payroll costs and other key HR metrics. Analyse workforce trends and provide actionable insights to hotel leadership. Maintain accurate and timely HR data across all assigned properties. Identify opportunities to simplify HR processes, improve employee experience and strengthen operational controls. title: Sr Manager - HR Business Partner
description:
About us 
 Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences. We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. The result: new materials go from molecule to commercial scale in months, not years. Scimplify operates offices and teams across 5 countries with 1,000+ innovator customers in 40+ countries. We are backed by investors such as Accel, Bertelsmann, Omnivore, Hitachi Ventures and 3one4 Capital, having raised over $80M. 
 Role overview 
 We are looking for a Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP) to work closely with the Founders and senior leadership in building and strengthening Scimplifys people practices, HR processes, policies, and organizational capabilities. This is a strategic yet hands-on role for an HR professional who understands how a business operates and can translate business priorities into effective people practices. The individual will partner with the Founders to understand the business in depth, identify organizational and people-related challenges, and build scalable HR frameworks that support business growth. The role will have significant ownership in establishing SOPs, designing and implementing HR policies, strengthening organizational effectiveness, and partnering with business leaders on workforce planning, performance management, leadership development, employee relations, and talent retention. We are looking for someone who has previously built and implemented HR processes and policies from the ground up , ideally in a high-growth startup or evolving business environment, and can operate with ownership, sound judgment, and minimal supervision. 
 Key responsibilities 1. Strategic Business Partnering Work closely with the Founders and business leaders to understand Scimplifys business model, growth plans, operating structure, and organizational priorities. Develop a deep understanding of business functions, their operational challenges, talent requirements, and people-related risks. Partner with business leaders to translate business objectives into people strategies and actionable HR initiatives. Provide data-driven insights and recommendations on organizational effectiveness, workforce productivity, employee retention, and leadership effectiveness. Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on people decisions, organizational design, team structures, and workforce planning. Proactively identify people-related challenges and develop practical solutions aligned with business priorities. 2. HR Process & Policy Development Build, review, and implement HR policies, SOPs, guidelines, and frameworks aligned with Scimplifys evolving business requirements. Establish standardized HR processes across the employee lifecycle, ensuring consistency, clarity, and accountability. Identify gaps in existing HR practices and introduce scalable processes to support organizational growth. Develop clear policy documentation, process workflows, approval matrices, and governance mechanisms. Ensure policies are practical, business-friendly, and consistently implemented across teams and locations. Periodically review policies and processes to improve efficiency, employee experience, and compliance. 3. Organization Design & Workforce Planning Partner with Founders and business leaders on organization structure, role clarity, reporting relationships, and manpower planning. Support headcount planning, workforce budgeting, resource allocation, and organizational capability assessment. Identify skill gaps, critical roles, succession requirements, and opportunities to improve team effectiveness. Help build scalable organizational structures as the business expands into new functions, markets, and geographies. 4. Performance Management & Talent Development Design and strengthen performance management frameworks, including goal setting, KPIs, performance reviews, and feedback mechanisms. Work with leaders to improve performance accountability and establish a high-performance culture. Identify high-potential employees and critical talent; develop retention and career progression strategies. Support leadership development, manager capability building, and succession planning. Partner with business leaders to address performance gaps and make informed talent decisions. 5. Employee Relations & Culture Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on workplace matters, employee concerns, and organizational challenges. Establish structured mechanisms for employee feedback, grievance resolution, and conflict management. Help build a culture of ownership, accountability, transparency, and collaboration. Drive initiatives to strengthen employee engagement, manager effectiveness, and retention. Support change management initiatives and help teams navigate organizational growth and evolving ways of working. 6. HR Operations, Governance & Compliance Work closely with HR and relevant business teams to strengthen onboarding, employee documentation, exit management, HR systems, and employee lifecycle processes.  Job Title: Maintenance Assistant Department: Maintenance Reporting to: Assistant Manager Projects Maintenance 

 Responsibilities 
 Assemble, install, test, and maintain electrical or electronic wiring, equipment, appliances, apparatus, and fixtures, using hand tools and power tools. Plan layout and installation of electrical wiring, equipment and fixtures, based on job specifications and local codes. Direct and train workers to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Prepare sketches or follow blueprints to determine the location of wiring and equipment and to ensure conformance to building and safety codes. Use a variety of tools and equipment such as power construction equipment, measuring devices, power tools, and testing equipment including oscilloscopes, ammeters, and test lamps. Install ground leads and connect power cables to equipment, such as motors. Perform business management duties such as maintaining records and files, preparing reports and ordering supplies and equipment. Repair or replace wiring, equipment, and fixtures, using hand tools and power tools. Work from ladders, scaffolds, and roofs to install, maintain or repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Place conduit (pipes or tubing) inside designated partitions, walls, or other concealed areas, and pull insulated wires or cables through the conduit to complete circuits between boxes. Construct and fabricate parts, using hand tools and specifications. Fasten small metal or plastic boxes to walls to house electrical switches or outlets. Perform physically demanding tasks, such as digging trenches to lay conduit and moving and lifting heavy objects. Provide preliminary sketches and cost estimates for materials and services. title: HR Executive (Recruitment, Payroll & Administration)
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and proactive HR Executive to manage end-to-end recruitment, frame HR policies, employee records, payroll processing, attendance and leave management, and day-to-day HR operations. The ideal candidate should have good communication and interpersonal skills, a strong understanding of HR processes, and excellent numerical and analytical abilities. Candidates with an Accounts background will be preferred due to the payroll processing and salary reconciliation responsibilities associated with this role. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment activities, including job postings, resume screening, candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, and follow-ups. Coordinate with hiring managers to understand staffing requirements and identify suitable candidates. Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers. Ensure timely closure of open positions through effective recruitment strategies. Coordinate candidate selection, offer communication, and joining formalities. 2. Payroll Processing and Salary Administration Process monthly employee payroll accurately and within the defined timelines. Calculate salaries based on attendance, paid leaves, loss of pay, and other applicable components. Verify salary inputs and reconcile payroll data before processing. Maintain payroll records, salary statements, and employee compensation details. Coordinate salary disbursement with the Accounts or Finance team. Assist with payroll-related statutory requirements, including applicable PF, ESI, TDS, and professional tax compliance, as relevant to the organization. 3. Attendance and Leave Management Monitor daily employee attendance, late arrivals, early departures, and absenteeism. Maintain attendance records and prepare monthly attendance summaries. Manage employee leave applications, approvals, leave balances, and leave records. Coordinate with department heads to verify attendance and leave discrepancies before payroll processing. Ensure accurate attendance and leave data is considered during monthly salary calculations. 4. Employee Records and HR Documentation Develop, maintain, and regularly update employee records and HR databases. Manage employee joining documentation, personal information, appointment letters, and other employment-related documents. Maintain employee files, payroll records, attendance registers, and leave records with appropriate confidentiality. Coordinate onboarding and induction activities for new employees. Support employee separation formalities, full and final settlement documentation, and exit procedures. 5. Employee Relations and HR Support Act as a point of contact for employees regarding HR policies, payroll queries, leave matters, attendance, and other employment-related concerns. Foster positive relationships between employees, management, and other stakeholders. Assist in resolving employee grievances and workplace issues professionally and fairly. Communicate HR policies, procedures, and organizational updates to employees. Support employee engagement and workplace initiatives. 6. HR Compliance and Administration Ensure HR processes comply with applicable labor laws, employment regulations, and company policies. Maintain records and documentation required for HR audits and statutory compliance. Assist in preparing HR reports, employee headcount reports, payroll summaries, and other management reports. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR policies and procedures. Handle employee information and sensitive HR data with strict confidentiality. Required Skills and Competencies Good understanding of HR operations, recruitment, and employee administration. Knowledge of payroll processing, salary calculations, and attendance management. Strong numerical, analytical, and reconciliation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to maintain confidential employee records. Problem-solving skills and the ability to handle employee concerns professionally. Ability to manage multiple HR activities and meet deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Graduate in any discipline Prior experience in payroll processing, salary administration, or accounting will be an advantage. Familiarity with HRMS, payroll software, attendance systems, or biometric attendance devices is desirable. Basic knowledge of applicable Indian labor laws and statutory payroll deductions is preferred.

 About UGX.AI 
UGX.AI helps manufacturing organizations accelerate their Industry 4.0 journey through Industrial IoT (IIoT), Smart Factory Solutions, Digital Production Monitoring, AI-driven Analytics, and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
As a Customer Success Executive, you will play a critical role in ensuring customers derive maximum value from UGX.AI solutions after implementation. You will be responsible for customer onboarding, user training, adoption, support, issue resolution coordination, and long-term customer engagement.

 Position Summary 
The Customer Success Executive will serve as the primary post-implementation contact for customers. The role focuses on ensuring smooth user adoption, conducting training programs, handling support requests, monitoring platform usage, and coordinating with technical teams for issue resolution.
The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, patience, problem-solving ability, and a strong customer-centric mindset.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Onboarding & Training 
 Conduct onboarding sessions for new customers. Train plant managers, production teams, supervisors, operators, and management users on UGX.AI solutions. Develop role-based training plans for different user groups. Conduct online and onsite training sessions. Create user manuals, SOPs, training videos, and knowledge base content. Ensure users become self-sufficient in using the platform. 
 Customer Support 
 Serve as the first point of contact for customer queries and issues. Log, classify, and prioritize support tickets. Troubleshoot application and process-related issues. Coordinate with Product, Development, and TechOps teams for technical issue resolution. Follow up until issues are fully resolved. Maintain SLA compliance. 
 Customer Adoption & Engagement 
 Monitor customer usage and platform adoption. Identify underutilized features and drive adoption campaigns. Conduct periodic customer review meetings. Share best practices and product updates. Ensure customers achieve expected business outcomes from the solution. 
 Issue Management & Escalation 
 Track customer issues from reporting to closure. Maintain issue trackers and support dashboards. Escalate critical issues to appropriate stakeholders. Communicate resolution timelines to customers. Ensure transparent and timely communication. 
 Documentation & Reporting 
 Prepare training reports and attendance records. Maintain customer interaction logs. Update CRM and ticketing systems. Generate periodic customer health reports. Capture customer feedback and improvement suggestions. 
 Customer Retention & Satisfaction 
 Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders. Act as the voice of the customer within UGX.AI. Improve customer satisfaction and retention. Identify opportunities for upselling additional modules and services. Support account management teams during renewals. 
 Required Skills 
 Communication Skills 
 Excellent verbal communication. Professional email writing. Presentation and training skills. Ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical users. Strong listening and relationship-building capability. 
 Customer Success Skills 
 Customer onboarding. User training. Customer engagement. Support ticket management. Issue escalation handling. Customer satisfaction management. 
 Technical Skills 
Basic understanding of:
 Industry 4.0 concepts Industrial IoT (IIoT) Manufacturing processes Production monitoring systems ERP/MES software Mobile and web applications Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Preferred:
 CRM tools Ticketing systems SQL basics Reporting and dashboard interpretation 
 Desired Behavioral Competencies 
 Customer First Mindset 
 Passionate about helping customers succeed. Focused on delivering exceptional customer experience. Patience & Empathy 
 Able to handle customer concerns professionally. Comfortable dealing with users having varying technical expertise. Ownership 
 Takes responsibility for customer issues until closure. Follows through on commitments. Proactive Approach 
 Identifies potential customer challenges before they become escalations. Drives adoption and engagement initiatives. Learning Orientation 
 Willing to continuously learn manufacturing and Industry 4.0 technologies. 
 Experience Requirements 
 Mandatory 
 15 years experience in: Customer Support Customer Success Software Training Technical Support SaaS Operations Preferred 
Experience in:
 Manufacturing software ERP solutions Industrial Automation Industry 4.0 solutions MES platforms Industrial IoT solutions 
 Travel Requirements 
 Willingness to travel to customer sites for onboarding and training. Travel approximately 2030% of the time. Comfortable conducting both onsite and remote training sessions. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) Training Completion Rate Product Adoption Rate Ticket Resolution Time SLA Compliance Customer Retention Rate Renewal Support Success Escalation Reduction Rate Number of Users Trained Customer Health Score

description:
Job Description Accounts Payable - Sr. Coordinator Department: Finance / Accounting - Accounts Payable Reports To: Accounts Payable Manager / Supervisor Job Level: Staff (Individual Contributor) Location: Greater Bangalore Area / hybrid remote Job Summary The Accounts Payable Sr. Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of the organizations payables, including invoice review, PO matching, and payment processing, along with vendor account reconciliation and reporting. This role has a substantial understanding of accounts payable practices and applies that knowledge and skill set to complete a wide range of AP and general accounting tasks. Work assignments are moderately difficult and require the incumbent to use judgment to resolve discrepancies, research issues, and recommend process improvements. The AP Staff Accountant works closely with the AP team and will escalate non-routine or higher-risk issues to the Senior AP Manager. Key Responsibilities Process a full range of accounts payable transactions, including three-way matching of purchase orders, receipts, and invoices, ensuring accurate general ledger coding and appropriate approvals. Review, research, and resolve moderately complex invoice discrepancies, coding errors, and vendor disputes, exercising judgment in determining root cause and appropriate resolution. Reconcile vendor statements and AP subledger to the general ledger; investigate and resolve variances. Maintain vendor master data, including W-9 collection, TIN verification, and setup/updates in the ERP system. Support month-end close activities, including AP aging analysis and preparation of supporting schedules. Assist with 1099 reporting and other year-end tax filing support related to vendor payments. Respond to internal and vendor inquiries regarding invoice and payment status in a timely, professional manner. Identify opportunities to improve AP workflows and controls, and recommend process or system enhancements to the Senior AP Manager. Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls (e.g., SOX where applicable), and relevant accounting standards. Support special projects, system implementations, or process transitions as assigned. Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications Education Associates or Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Experience Minimum of 2-3 years of related accounts payable or general accounting experience. Experience working within an ERP or accounting system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics) required. Prior experience in a mid-size or larger organization, or shared services environment, is a plus. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Substantial working knowledge of accounts payable processes, general accounting principles, and internal controls. Demonstrated ability to apply judgment in resolving moderately complex issues and making recommendations without extensive oversight. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in high-volume transaction processing. Proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas); comfortable working with large data sets. Strong English written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with vendors and internal stakeholders across departments. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-based accounting function. Working Conditions remote/hybrid/on-site - Bangalore Office Occasional extended hours may be required during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close. Primarily sedentary work involving extended computer use.

title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

description:
Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition Location: Mumbai
 Experience: 4–8 Years
 Function: Talent Acquisition / Human Resources
 Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition to join our Talent Acquisition team. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in end-to-end recruitment, stakeholder management and Leadership hiring , with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 
 The role will involve managing hiring mandates across multiple business functions, partnering closely with business stakeholders, driving recruitment closures within defined TATs and ensuring a strong candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities Own and manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle from sourcing to onboarding. Understand business requirements and translate them into effective hiring strategies. Manage multiple open positions across functions, levels and locations simultaneously. Partner closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand manpower requirements, profiles and hiring priorities. Ensure timely closure of positions in line with defined TATs and hiring targets . Source candidates through multiple channels including job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, consultants, databases and other recruitment channels. Conduct initial screening and assess candidates based on experience, skills, communication and role fit. Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and stakeholders and ensure timely feedback. Manage the candidate pipeline from sourcing screening interview selection offer joining . Drive offer negotiations and ensure a smooth offer-to-join conversion. Maintain accurate recruitment data, trackers and dashboards and provide regular hiring updates to stakeholders. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external recruitment partners. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and proactively implement solutions to improve hiring efficiency. Support recruitment strategy, process improvements and initiatives to improve quality of hire, TAT and offer-to-join ratio . Work effectively in a target-driven and performance-oriented environment with clearly defined hiring goals. Mentor and guide junior members of the TA team wherever required. 
 Key Requirements 4–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions and levels. Excellent verbal and written communication skills . Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills. Experience in working closely with business leaders, hiring managers and clients/stakeholders . Proven ability to work in a target-driven / high-volume recruitment environment . Strong sourcing and candidate assessment skills. Ability to manage multiple positions and priorities simultaneously. Strong follow-up, coordination and negotiation skills. Good understanding of recruitment metrics such as TAT, source mix, conversion ratios, offer-to-join ratio and closure targets . Strong ownership, accountability and ability to work independently. Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment/ATS platforms. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is someone who is highly driven, hands-on and delivery-focused , with the ability to independently manage hiring mandates while effectively coordinating with multiple stakeholders. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with aggressive hiring targets , and should have a strong sense of urgency, problem-solving ability and ownership for closures. Key Competencies End-to-End Recruitment Stakeholder Management Client/Business Coordination Sourcing & Headhunting Interview Coordination Offer Negotiation Target & TAT Management Candidate Experience Data & Recruitment Analytics Team Collaboration Problem Solving Strong Communication & Interpersonal Skills

Process Optimization & System Maintenance: Continuously improve after-sales financial accounting processes and internal controls; drive functional improvements and upgrades of financial software (Tally/SAP); responsible for team software training and guidance. 7. Team Management: Manage 2 Accounts Executives; responsible for daily task allocation, performance evaluation, skill development, and career guidance; build an efficient and collaborative finance team. 9. Cross-Department Collaboration: Establish efficient collaboration mechanisms with Service Center Operations and Warehouse Management (which handles after-sales procurement); drive cross-department issue resolution and efficiency improvement in purchase-sales-inventory processes. 10. Risk Management: Identify, assess and control financial risks in the after-sales module (accounting risk, inventory risk, tax risk, information security risk); establish risk early warning and response mechanisms. 11. title: Key Account Manager - C&SP Segment
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Overview The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a senior technical sales leadership role responsible for managing and growing relationships with nominated Global Strategic Accounts across India. This position requires deep expertise in the Data Centre, Hyperscale, and Colocation segments, with the ability to influence key stakeholders-up to the C-Suite-within customer organizations, as well as ecosystem partners such as consultants, specifiers, and contractors. The KAM will drive Schneider Electric's complete portfolio across business units, acting as the opportunity leader for complex, multi-country pursuits and ensuring seamless collaboration between Secure Power and other divisions. This is a highly strategic role requiring business acumen, technical competency, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to execute global strategy at a country level. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the country owner for assigned global strategic accounts and translate global strategy into local execution. Build strong multi-level customer relationships including C-level, influencers, and operational teams. Develop, manage, and execute Strategic Account Plans across the region. Identify, shape, and drive opportunities for the One Schneider Electric portfolio, including Secure Power, Digital Energy, Industrial Automation, Power Systems, Power Products, and Services. Lead complex, large-scale pursuits as the opportunity leader, mobilizing virtual teams across countries and divisions. Develop and grow Data Centre-related business (hyperscale and colocation) across electrical, cooling, software, automation, and services offerings. Build strong working relationships with Country Leadership, Divisions, and Regional Teams to define and execute winning strategies. Engage with and influence the broader ecosystem of consultants, specifiers, and contractors involved in data centre construction and expansion. Ensure cross-functional alignment across Sales, Pre-Sales, Tendering, and Execution teams. Deliver on orders, revenue, margin, and ensure forecast accuracy. Maintain strong compliance with Customer Project Process (CPP) and uphold CRM discipline and data quality. Conduct feasibility analysis of bids, tenders, and contracting documents for all key opportunities. 
 
 Experience and Requirements 
 
 Commercial Technical Experience Requirements 
 Deep technical sales experience in Data Centre Solutions including power, cooling, electrical distribution, automation, and associated services. Proven capability to manage and grow large strategic/global accounts. Strong understanding of account management principles, sales channels, and partner ecosystems. Demonstrated capability to uncover and articulate customer pain points and propose high-value, integrated solutions. Experience selling within a matrix organization and managing multi-stakeholder environments. 
 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Ability to lead virtual, cross-functional, and remote teams across geographies. Strong capability to navigate complex matrix organizations in a multicultural environment. High initiative, strong ownership mindset, and excellent organizational skills. Ability to influence and align diverse internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Communication Interpersonal Skills 
 Strong executive presence with the ability to engage at C-Level. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear, compelling business language. High emotional intelligence, resilience, and collaborative mindset. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in engineering; MBA preferred. 10-15+ years of experience in Key Account Management or similar roles within the Data Centre ecosystem. Experience working with Hyperscalers, Global Cloud Providers, or Colocation Operators preferred. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Willingness to travel (domestic/international as required). Ability to collaborate and operate across multiple time zones.

title: Sr Manager, Fund Accounting
description:
Overview The Senior Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services across multiple client portfolios. The role provides leadership across NAV processing, investor reporting, capital calls, distributions, management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, and other fund operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality service delivery. Acting as a senior client contact, the Senior Manager manages relationships with clients, auditors, banks, custodians, brokers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and service level commitments. The role also drives process improvements, technology initiatives, risk management, and team development to support operational excellence and business growth. 
 Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities Strategic Focus Provide strategic leadership and oversight of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client expectations, and operational priorities. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients, auditors, custodians, banks, brokers, and other strategic stakeholders, fostering long-term partnerships and service excellence. Drive operational excellence across NAV production, investor servicing, custody operations, financial reporting, and fund administration activities to ensure consistent, high-quality client outcomes. Oversee complex fund structures, transactions, and reporting requirements, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, capital calls, and distributions. Champion operational transformation through process optimization, technology enablement, automation, and scalable service delivery models. Provide strategic oversight of compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and internal control frameworks across client portfolios. Contribute to business growth, strategic initiatives, organizational development, and continuous enhancement of the operating model to support long-term success. Direct resource planning, capacity management, and organizational alignment to support efficient service delivery, business growth, and evolving client requirements. Lead and develop managers, team leaders, and fund accounting teams to drive high performance, service excellence, and achievement of operational and client delivery objectives. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients and strategic stakeholders across the broader client portfolio. Operational Management Provide oversight of end-to-end private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring the accurate, timely, and consistent delivery of client commitments across multiple portfolios. Oversee NAV production, investor allocations, capital calls, distributions, fund expense payments, custody activities, and related fund operations to ensure quality and operational effectiveness. Lead operational execution through effective resource planning, workload management, capacity optimization, and performance oversight across teams. Ensure the consistent achievement of service level agreements (SLAs), client deadlines, and quality standards across all client engagements. Review and approve key fund accounting deliverables, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, and other complex fund accounting outputs. description:

You will run end-to-end reporting deliverables, strengthen controls, and drive lasting fixes to recurring issues. You will partner closely with operations, treasury, product, technology, and change teams to deliver accurate outcomes in a high-control, time-sensitive environment.

As a Associate in India Branch Regulatory Reporting & Treasury Markets Operations, you will own non-financial regulatory reporting delivery and related operations processes. You will interpret requirements, ensure data quality and reconciliations, manage exceptions through closure, and maintain audit-ready evidence. You will also drive process improvements, including automation and control enhancements, and support change delivery for regulatory and business initiatives. This role requires strong treasury product knowledge, sound judgement, and the ability to influence across teams. Job responsibilities Own end-to-end preparation, review, and submission of non-financial regulatory reports, including PDR, GPB, FTD, SFR, FSU, CRILC, reporting to Credit Information Companies, IBS, Return on Connected Exposure/Intra-group Exposure, and RBS, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Interpret regulations and internal policies, documenting key judgements, assumptions, and reporting methodologies to support consistency and auditability. Lead data quality and reconciliation routines, including reasonability checks, variance analysis, break investigation, and exception resolution with upstream data owners. Drive ledger and system reconciliations, prioritising ageing items, coordinating ownership, and ensuring timely closure of breaks. Support funding and liquidity-related operational activities by resolving issues impacting settlements, positions, and reporting through effective cross-team coordination. Manage daily operational and reporting queries with clear ownership and escalation discipline, highlighting risks early and driving closure. Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventive actions to reduce repeat breaks and manual rework. Deliver process improvements across reporting and reconciliations, including automation opportunities, control enhancements, and standardisation of procedures. Support change delivery for regulatory updates, policy changes, product changes, process redesign, and system migrations, including impact assessment, testing, and go-live readiness. Maintain strong risk and control discipline through structured issue management, timely remediation, and audit readiness.
 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Bachelor s degree. Minimum 10 years of experience in treasury markets operations and/or non-financial regulatory reporting. Strong knowledge of treasury products, including government securities, corporate bonds, certificates of deposit, pass-through certificates, foreign exchange (cash, TOM, spot, forwards, cancellations, options), interest rate swaps, cross-currency interest rate swaps, forward rate agreements, repurchase agreements, and call money borrowing and lending. Demonstrated ability to lead reconciliations and investigations end-to-end, including prioritisation, stakeholder coordination, and closure of breaks and exceptions. Strong controls mindset with experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, evidence standards, and remediation follow-through. Strong data orientation, with comfort using reporting, analytics, and automation tools such as Tableau, Alteryx, or UiPath. Proven ability to partner with product, technology, and change teams to deliver enhancements and manage change. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels. Strong judgement under time pressure, with clear escalation decisions and disciplined execution.
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Master of Business Administration, Chartered Accountant, or Chartered Financial Analyst qualification. Experience supporting fixed income, money markets, and over-the-counter foreign exchange and derivatives operations. Familiarity with trade lifecycle controls and operational control frameworks. Familiarity with cross-border payments, foreign exchange, and global custody concepts. Experience using intelligent automation tools to improve operational workflows.

title: B2B SaaS Sales Manager | Cybersecurity / IAM | Startups & SMB | India
description:
About the Product We are building a modern Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform designed to help organizations securely manage users, applications, roles, permissions, authentication, and access policies from a centralized platform. Our goal is to provide startups and small-to-medium organizations with enterprise-grade identity management capabilities without the cost and complexity associated with large enterprise IAM solutions. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and results-driven B2B SaaS Sales Manager to lead customer acquisition and help build our sales presence in India. 
 Role Overview You will be responsible for identifying prospective customers, generating qualified leads, demonstrating the product, managing the sales pipeline, and converting startups and SMBs into paying customers. This is an early-stage sales role and is ideal for someone who enjoys building a sales process rather than simply working an existing list of accounts. You will work closely with the founders/product team and play an important role in shaping our go-to-market strategy. 
 Key Responsibilities Identify and target startups and small-to-medium businesses that could benefit from our Identity & Access Management platform. Develop outbound sales campaigns using LinkedIn, email, phone calls, industry communities, startup networks, and other channels. Build relationships with founders, CTOs, CIOs, IT Managers, Security Managers, and other technology decision-makers. Conduct product demonstrations and clearly communicate the business value of the platform. Understand customer requirements relating to authentication, authorization, user management, role management, application access, and identity security. Manage the complete B2B sales cycle from prospecting through product demonstrations, proposal, negotiation, and closing. Maintain and manage a structured pipeline of leads and opportunities using CRM tools. Follow up consistently with prospects and nurture longer-term opportunities. Work with the product and technical teams to communicate customer requirements, objections, and market feedback. Help develop sales presentations, product positioning, pricing strategies, case studies, and other sales collateral. Identify partnership opportunities with IT service providers, MSPs, cloud consultants, cybersecurity firms, and technology implementation partners. Track sales metrics including leads generated, demos conducted, conversion rates, sales pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue. Help establish a repeatable sales process as the company grows. 
 Required Skills & Experience 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B Sales, IT Sales, or enterprise software sales . Demonstrated experience selling software or technology solutions to businesses. Experience with SMB and startup customers is strongly preferred. Strong outbound prospecting and lead-generation skills. Ability to identify and reach decision-makers through LinkedIn, email, networking, and cold outreach. Experience conducting software product demonstrations. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Comfortable discussing technology with CTOs, IT teams, and security professionals. Ability to understand customer problems and translate technical product capabilities into business benefits. Experience managing opportunities through a structured sales pipeline. Experience working with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Freshsales, or similar platforms. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in an early-stage environment. 
 Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who combines sales ability with enough technical curiosity to understand cybersecurity and identity management . You may currently be working as a: SaaS Sales Manager Business Development Manager Account Executive Cybersecurity Sales Manager Enterprise Software Sales Executive Cloud Solutions Sales Manager IAM / Security Software Sales Executive You should be comfortable working in an environment where the sales organization is still being built. Rather than receiving an established territory and a large inbound pipeline, you should enjoy finding prospects, experimenting with outreach strategies, and developing new customer relationships. 
 What Success Looks Like During the first several months, success will include: Developing a well-defined list of target customer segments. Building a consistent pipeline of qualified startup and SMB prospects. Scheduling regular product demonstrations with technology decision-makers. Identifying the strongest customer use cases and purchasing motivations. Closing initial customers and developing reference accounts. Establishing a repeatable sales process that can eventually be expanded into a larger sales team. 
 Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join an early-stage technology product and help shape its commercial strategy from the beginning. The person joining this role will have significant influence over: Go-to-market strategy Customer segmentation Sales processes Pricing feedback Partnerships Customer acquisition strategy Future development of the sales organization For someone interested in SaaS, cybersecurity, identity management, and building businesses, this role offers considerably more ownership than a traditional sales position.

Key Skills: Identity Access Management,IT Sales,International Sales,SaaS Sales,B2B Sales,Software Sales,Software Solution Sales,Solution sales

Maintain day-to-day accounts, including cash receipts, payments, expenses and journal entries. Manage daily cashbook, bankbook, petty cash and cash reconciliation. Maintain accounts using Zoho Books, Microsoft Excel and other accounting software. Reconcile bank statements, identify discrepancies and ensure accurate transaction classification. Maintain supplier, transporter, employee and labour payment records. Assist with payroll calculations, salary payments, incentives and employee advances. Maintain proper vouchers, invoices, supporting documents and expense records. Assist auditors with GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory compliance. Coordinate with management and head office for financial reconciliations and settlements. Identify accounting discrepancies, report irregularities and maintain proper financial controls. Ensure confidentiality of all business, customer and financial information. 
 Preferred candidate profile Education: B.Com, M.Com or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance. Experience: 25 years of practical accounting experience preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, ledger maintenance and bank reconciliation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and data reconciliation.  About Us 
Accenture is a leading technology consulting firm specializing in data center transformation and infrastructure optimization. We partner with hyperscalers, enterprises, and colocation providers to design scalable, efficient data center networks that support AI workloads, edge computing, and sustainable operations. Job Summary 
The Data Center Strategy Manager will lead end-to-end consulting services for clients' data center portfolios, guiding them through capacity forecasting, site selection, and expansion strategies. You will optimize client designs for power efficiency and sustainability while directing cross-functional teams to deliver multi-year execution roadmaps. This role requires a visionary leader blending technical expertise with business acumen to ensure clients achieve strategic superiority and excellence. 
Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end consulting engagements from ideation to delivery, spanning strategy, operational transformation, and digital change management. Lead evaluations for new technologies like liquid cooling, 800G networking, and modular DC designs to support AI/GPU workloads. Collaborate with clients' finance, operations, and engineering teams to create CapEx/OpEx models, ROI analyses, and vendor RFPs for DC builds and upgrades. Oversee sustainability initiatives, targeting PUE reductions, renewable energy integration, and compliance with global carbon regulations. Manage a team of strategic consultants and analysts, mentoring on DC best practices and fostering innovation in edge and hyperscale environments. Conduct risk assessments for supply chain, geopolitics, and resilience, recommending strategies for multi-region redundancy. Present strategies to executive leadership and board, translating technical roadmaps into business impacts like TCO savings and uptime guarantees. Mentor, coach, and develop future consultants through hiring, training, and upskilling efforts, building and inspiring high-performing diverse teams. Contribute to Accenture's knowledge assets, white papers, and represent the practice at key events and industry bodies as a thought leader. Preferred Skills Proven track record managing DC portfolios valued at $500M+ in assets. Deep expertise in DC metrics (PUE, WUE), architectures (spine-leaf, DCI), and tools (DCIM like Nlyte, Sunbird).
