title: Cards Product Management
description:
Role Purpose Own the lifecycle, strategic direction and commercial performance of consumer and business/corporate card products. Lead product design, feasibility, delivery and optimization of prepaid, debit, payroll/WPS, virtual and commercial card programs and associated electronic money services, subject to applicable authorization. Product Strategy & Portfolio Development Set and implement multi-year product strategies and roadmaps for Consumer Cards and Business / Corporate Cards, aligning customer propositions with commercial and regulatory objectives. Design, enhance and launch card products and features from concept through feasibility, requirements, testing, commercialization and post-launch review. Lead customer and market segmentation, competitor benchmarking, product positioning and prioritization of product enhancements. Develop products and propositions for prepaid cards, debit cards, virtual cards, payroll/WPS cards, corporate expense cards and electronic money-linked payment solutions. Design and improve cashback, loyalty, rewards, benefits, digital servicing and other value-added programs, including their financial viability. Pricing, Planning & Financial Performance Develop and periodically update business plans, card portfolio strategy, product budgets and annual financial targets. Prepare feasibility studies, business cases, cost and revenue models, transaction forecasts and commercial recommendations for new initiatives. Own product-level pricing, fee structures, unit economics, revenue optimization and profitability analysis in coordination with Finance. Monitor card issuance, activation, active usage, load values, transaction volumes, portfolio mix, cost-to-serve and retention for both segments. Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports, product P&L reviews, budgets, forecasts and management presentations; recommend corrective actions. Visa, Mastercard & Product Governance Work directly with BOTH Visa and Mastercard product and scheme teams on product eligibility, market initiatives, product rules, new programs and feature rollouts. Own product requirements and coordinate scheme approvals, product configuration, BIN/product setup, certifications and mandate-driven changes with Operations and Technology. Coordinate product-related scheme reporting, portfolio analysis and periodic Visa / Mastercard submissions with accountable operational and compliance teams. Support product-related regulatory applications, feasibility submissions, explanatory letters and launch approvals through the Compliance / Regulatory Affairs function. Partner with Risk, AML/CFT, Finance, Operations, Security and Technology to embed controls, customer disclosures and scheme/regulatory requirements in product design. Go-to-Market & Customer Experience Work with Business Development and Marketing on propositions, campaigns, cardholder activation, retention and portfolio engagement. Own the product customer journey for both consumer and business cardholders, including digital onboarding, card controls, servicing and user experience. Review customer feedback, complaints themes, analytics and service-performance data to improve products and eliminate friction. Coordinate with partners, processors and internal delivery teams to meet product launch milestones and improve existing services. Mandatory Qualifications & Experience Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in card issuing, banking card businesses, or issuer-side payment services. This is a non-negotiable requirement. Documented, direct, hands-on working experience with BOTH Visa and Mastercard, with demonstrable engagement with their respective scheme teams (not solely through third-party providers). Proven experience across BOTH Consumer Cards and Business / Corporate Cards, with an understanding of the distinct product, operational, servicing, and commercial needs of each segment. Previous hands-on experience at an issuing bank, licensed issuer, or directly responsible issuer-side payment institution. Proven ownership of card product strategy, financial feasibility, pricing, launches and portfolio management in both consumer and commercial card products; practical knowledge of scheme product frameworks. Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Technology, or a relevant discipline (aligned to the role). Candidates whose experience is limited to merchant acquiring, POS, or payment gateways, without issuer-side card experience, do not meet the minimum criteria. Preferred Experience & Skills Direct involvement in Visa and Mastercard card program launches, product upgrades, BIN/product configurations and regional scheme initiatives. Knowledge of GCC card markets, Qatars regulatory environment, payroll products, prepaid programs and card-linked digital services. Strong business-case modelling, analytical, stakeholder management, communication and product governance skills. Key Performance Indicators On-time, compliant card product launches and enhancements. Consumer and corporate portfolio growth, card activation and transaction usage. Product revenue, contribution margin, pricing performance and budget achievement. Product adoption, retention and customer experience improvements. Role Boundaries & Governance Accountable for product strategy and economics; not the approver of AML/KYC decisions, transaction monitoring alerts, operational settlement release, or independent control exceptions.

It is building a financial ecosystem that enables the mid-income group and the underserved segments to fulfil their financial aspirations. Fibe offers a range of financial products, including cash loans, long-term personal loans, and Impact loans for sectors like Healthcare, Education, Green Finance, Loan Against Mutual Funds, making affordability more accessible. Fibe has grown multifold over the years and emerged as a market leader in providing financial assistance to young middle-income and underserved groups in India. Due to its scalable business model, Fibe has recently been upgraded to A- by CARE Ratings and has access to debt lines from leading banks, NBFCs and wholesale debt markets. It has been certified with ISO/IEC 27001 for its Information Security Management System (ISMS).  Role Overview The AVP Cash Risk will be responsible for end-to-end portfolio risk management across the cash lending business, ensuring portfolio quality, profitability, and adherence to the organization's risk appetite. The role will drive portfolio performance through continuous KPI monitoring, credit cost management, partner risk oversight, co-lending portfolio governance, and implementation of portfolio optimization strategies such as swap-in/swap-out of risk segments. The incumbent will work closely with Business, Credit, Product, Analytics, Collections, Finance, Operations, and Lending Partners to monitor portfolio health, identify emerging risks, recommend corrective actions, and support sustainable business growth while maintaining prudent risk standards. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Portfolio Risk Management Own the overall risk performance of the Cash Loan portfolio across customer segments, channels, and lending partners. Continuously monitor portfolio KPIs including approval rates, disbursement trends, delinquency, roll rates, bounce rates, PAR, NPA, recoveries, vintage performance, and credit cost. Identify emerging portfolio risks through trend analysis and recommend timely corrective actions. Drive portfolio optimization initiatives while ensuring alignment with the organization's risk appetite. 2. KPI Monitoring & Portfolio Analytics Develop and monitor portfolio risk dashboards covering key business and risk metrics. Analyze portfolio performance across customer cohorts, geographies, risk bands, acquisition channels, and products. Track early warning indicators (EWI) and recommend preventive interventions. Generate actionable MIS and management reports for leadership reviews. 3. Portfolio Optimization (Swap-In / Swap-Out Strategy) Recommend inclusion (Swap-In) of profitable customer segments based on portfolio performance and risk-return analysis. Identify and recommend exclusion or tightening (Swap-Out) of underperforming or high-risk customer segments. Evaluate the impact of policy changes on portfolio growth, profitability, and asset quality. Support implementation and monitoring of segment-level risk strategies. 4. Partner Risk Management Monitor portfolio performance across lending partners, banks, and co-lending arrangements. Manage periodic partner performance reviews covering portfolio quality, underwriting effectiveness, operational compliance, and collection efficiency. Recommend risk mitigation actions based on partner performance trends. Coordinate with partner teams to ensure adherence to agreed risk policies and SLAs . 6. Credit Cost Management Monitor monthly credit cost against budget and business plans. Analyze drivers of credit losses and recommend strategies to optimize portfolio profitability. Partner with Collections, Finance, and Business teams to improve recovery performance and reduce portfolio losses. Support forecasting of portfolio losses and provisioning requirements. 7. Risk Governance & Stakeholder Reviews Conduct monthly portfolio review meetings with Business, Credit, Collections, Product, Finance, Analytics, and senior leadership. Present portfolio performance, emerging risks, KPI trends, policy effectiveness, and recommended action plans. Track closure of agreed action items and ensure timely implementation. Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and governance forums. 8. Policy & Risk Framework Management Support development, implementation, and periodic review of credit risk policies and portfolio management frameworks. Recommend policy changes based on portfolio performance, customer behavior, market trends, and regulatory expectations. Ensure consistent implementation of approved risk policies across products and partners. Drive continuous improvement in portfolio monitoring, risk reporting, and governance processes. 
 Experience 8+ years in Credit Risk, Portfolio Risk, or Cash Risk within retail lending, fintech, NBFCs, or banking. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. MBA / CA / CFA / FRM or equivalent qualification will be preferred. Experience in unsecured lending, portfolio monitoring, credit cost, and risk policy management. Exposure to co-lending and partner risk management is preferred. Strong knowledge of retail lending, portfolio analytics, and risk management. Proficiency in portfolio KPIs, risk metrics, and analytical tools (Excel, SQL, Power BI/Tableau). Familiarity with RBI regulations and digital lending frameworks. Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. description:
The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst at NIQ enhances the Indirect Tax team within the Global Finance Operations. This position involves performing the day-to-day activities across global indirect tax compliance, indirect tax provisions, and coordinating with external advisors and tax authorities to ensure compliance with applicable indirect tax laws and regulations. The Indirect Tax Senior Analyst is instrumental in maintaining the highest standards of efficiency and effectiveness for indirect tax activities and adhering to clear service level agreements (SLAs) with internal stakeholders. Reporting to the Indirect Tax Manager, this role is pivotal in upholding our company's compliance and operational excellence in the realm of indirect taxation.  Key Responsibilities:  Indirect Tax Reporting: Execute day-to-day operations related to global indirect tax reporting, ensuring accurate and timely filings.  Compliance: Ensure all global indirect tax activities comply with local, regional, and international tax regulations, mitigating risks associated with non-compliance.  Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with third-party outsourced providers to ensure the efficient delivery of global indirect tax filings, maintaining quality and accuracy standards.  SLA Management: Develop and maintain clear SLAs with internal stakeholders to ensure indirect tax activities align with organizational expectations and standards.  Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements within the indirect tax function to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.  Regulatory Monitoring: Stay abreast of changes in indirect tax laws and regulations, ensuring NIQ's tax practices remain compliant and up to date.  Collaboration: Work closely with the Indirect Tax Manager and other finance team members to support broader tax strategy and compliance efforts.  Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field. A professional certification in taxation or accounting (e.g., CA, CPA, CMA) is mandatory.  Minimum of 5 years of experience in indirect tax, preferably within finance operations environment or multinational corporation.  Tax Knowledge: Knowledge of indirect tax regulations and reporting requirements across various jurisdictions.  Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical skills with a keen attention to detail, capable of analyzing complex tax data and identifying compliance issues.  Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to effectively collaborate with team members, third-party providers, and internal stakeholders.  Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality or accuracy.  Technical Proficiency: Proficient with tax software and ERP systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite,

 JOB DESCRIPTION Vice President Collections, Loan Recovery & BPO Operations
 Designation: Vice President – Collections & Recovery
 Department: Collections, Recovery & Operations
 Location: As per business requirement
 Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer / Senior Management Role Overview The Vice President – Collections, Loan Recovery & BPO Operations will be responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the company's collections and recovery business across India. The role will focus on driving collection efficiency, maximizing loan recovery, improving portfolio performance, managing large-scale BPO operations, and ensuring optimal utilization of manpower and operational resources. The incumbent will oversee end-to-end collections across early, mid and late delinquency buckets, including field collections, tele-collections, hard-bucket recovery and legal recovery coordination. The position will also be responsible for strengthening client relationships with banks, NBFCs and financial institutions, expanding business operations, improving productivity, and building a performance-driven workforce. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Collections & Loan Recovery Management Develop and execute collection and recovery strategies for secured and unsecured loan portfolios across different delinquency buckets. Drive end-to-end recovery operations, including early-stage collections, overdue EMI recovery, hard-bucket collections, NPA accounts and legal recovery coordination. Establish collection targets, recovery benchmarks and portfolio-level performance metrics in line with client expectations. Monitor collection efficiency, roll-forward and roll-back rates, delinquency trends, recovery rates and resolution of overdue accounts. Design differentiated recovery strategies based on portfolio risk, customer profiles, geography and delinquency stages. Strengthen tele-collection, field collection and hybrid collection models to maximize productivity and recovery outcomes. Develop escalation mechanisms and specialized recovery strategies for high-value, chronic delinquent and difficult-to-recover accounts. 2. BPO & Business Operations Management Lead large-scale, multi-location BPO operations covering tele-collections, field recovery, customer engagement and associated process management. Manage operational delivery across multiple branches, collection hubs and client accounts. Establish standardized SOPs, operating procedures, productivity benchmarks and performance monitoring mechanisms. Ensure achievement of client-defined SLAs, turnaround times, collection targets and service quality standards. Drive process optimization, operational efficiency, cost control and continuous improvement initiatives. Leverage technology, CRM platforms, dialers, analytics and performance dashboards to enhance operational effectiveness. Build scalable operating models to support business expansion, new client onboarding and increasing portfolio volumes. 3. Manpower Planning & Workforce Management Lead large-scale manpower planning, recruitment, deployment and allocation of telecallers, field collection executives, team leaders, managers and regional heads. Ensure adequate manpower availability in line with business volumes, collection targets, client requirements and geographical coverage. Develop workforce productivity benchmarks, incentive structures, performance-linked targets and accountability mechanisms. Monitor attendance, attrition, absenteeism, employee productivity and manpower utilization. Build effective leadership pipelines through training, capability development, succession planning and performance management. Drive employee engagement, retention, discipline and productivity across geographically distributed teams. Establish clear reporting structures, review mechanisms and accountability at every level of operations. 4. Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management Manage strategic relationships with banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and other financial institutions. Act as the senior escalation point for key clients, ensuring timely resolution of operational challenges and service concerns. Conduct periodic business reviews with clients to evaluate performance, recovery trends, operational gaps and improvement opportunities. Develop account-specific collection strategies in alignment with client policies, business objectives and portfolio requirements. Support client retention, account growth, new portfolio acquisition and expansion of existing mandates. Coordinate with client collection, risk, operations, compliance and legal teams to improve recovery performance. 5. Financial Performance & Business Growth Own collection business performance against agreed revenue, profitability, recovery and productivity targets. Prepare annual operating plans, budgets, manpower cost projections and resource allocation plans. Monitor cost per collection, cost per account, revenue per employee, productivity and contribution margins. Identify opportunities to improve operating leverage, optimize manpower costs and enhance business profitability. Partner with the business development team to support new client acquisition, proposals, commercial negotiations and operational feasibility assessments. Drive expansion into new geographies, portfolios and collection service offerings. 6. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Ensure collections and recovery activities adhere to applicable RBI requirements, client mandates, contractual obligations and internal policies. Promote ethical and customer-sensitive recovery practices, including appropriate communication, confidentiality and protection of customer information. Ensure proper governance of field visits, tele-calling practices, customer interactions, complaint handling and recovery documentation. Implement quality audits, call monitoring, field audits, process controls and corrective action plans. Maintain accurate collection records, management reports, client documentation and audit trails. Coordinate with legal and compliance teams on escalated recovery cases, disputes, fraud indicators and legal proceedings. Establish controls to prevent misconduct, unauthorized practices, data breaches and operational losses. 7. MIS, Analytics & Performance Management Review daily, weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering collection efficiency, recovery rates, delinquency buckets, productivity and manpower performance. Use data analytics to identify underperforming portfolios, low-productivity locations and operational bottlenecks. Drive structured performance reviews with regional, zonal and process heads. Develop early-warning indicators and corrective action plans to improve collection outcomes. Present periodic business performance reports, forecasts, risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior management. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Collection efficiency and recovery rate against assigned targets. Reduction in overdue accounts and improvement in delinquency resolution. Performance across early, mid and late collection buckets. Achievement of client SLAs and service delivery standards. Manpower productivity, utilization and cost optimization. Employee attrition, absenteeism and workforce stability. Client satisfaction, retention and account growth. Revenue growth, operating profitability and cost per collection. Audit scores, compliance adherence and customer grievance resolution. Successful implementation of process improvements and technology-led initiatives. Educational Qualification MBA / PGDM in Finance, Operations, Business Administration or a related discipline preferred. A graduate degree is essential; relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage. Experience & Desired Profile Extensive senior-level experience in collections, loan recovery, debt management or financial services operations. Strong exposure to large-scale BPO operations, tele-collections and field recovery management. Demonstrated experience in managing large, geographically distributed manpower and multi-location operations. Proven track record of delivering collection targets, improving recovery efficiency and managing operational costs. Experience handling banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and institutional clients. Strong understanding of collection processes across secured and unsecured lending portfolios, delinquency buckets and legal recovery coordination. Experience in client relationship management, operational reviews, business planning and profitability management. Core Competencies Strategic leadership and business ownership. Strong analytical, commercial and financial acumen. Large-scale manpower and multi-location operations management. Negotiation, stakeholder management and client relationship building. Data-driven decision-making and problem-solving. Process excellence, governance and compliance orientation. Strong communication, leadership development and execution capabilities. Ideal Candidate Profile A results-oriented senior leader with a strong combination of loan recovery expertise, collections strategy, BPO operations management and large-scale workforce leadership . The ideal candidate should be capable of managing complex, multi-location operations, delivering measurable recovery outcomes, strengthening institutional client relationships and driving sustainable business growth and profitability.

title: Manager (Planning & Operations), Telecom Safety Training
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a highly organized and proactive MANAGER PLANNING & OPERATIONS to lead the coordination of our Safety Training programs (specifically Work at Heights, Tower Climbing, and RF Safety) for major Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and Telecom Infrastructure Providers (InfraCos). The ideal candidate must have a strong background in the TELECOM SECTOR and understand the unique operational challenges of tower sites, field teams, and safety compliance. You will be the central hub connecting our clients, our safety trainers, and our logistics team to ensure seamless training delivery. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Training Planning & Scheduling Manage the end-to-end booking process for safety training sessions requested by Telecom clients (MNOs, Tower Companies, ISP). Coordinate with the clients L&D or Safety heads to understand training requirements (Work at Heights, Confined Space, First Aid, etc.) and batch sizes. Allocate Safety Trainers to specific sessions based on their certifications, location, and availability. Create and publish monthly training calendars, ensuring optimal utilization of trainer bandwidth and training equipment. 2. Proposal Management & Client Coordination Prepare and submit detailed training proposals and commercial quotations to clients based on their specific requirements. Follow up rigorously on submitted proposals to close bookings and confirm schedules. Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding scheduling changes, cancellations, or urgent training needs. 3. Trainer Logistics & Travel Management Monitor and manage the complete travel lifecycle of Safety Trainers: flight/train bookings, hotel accommodations, and local ground transport. Ensure trainers are mobilized to remote tower sites or training centers on time. Handle last-minute logistical challenges (e.g., weather delays, site access issues) and re-plan schedules accordingly. 4. Operations Maintain a centralized database of all training records, attendance sheets, and trainer feedback. Ensure all training delivery complies with industry safety standards and client-specific SOPs. 
 KEY COMPETENCIES Telecom Domain Knowledge : Understanding of tower sites, field engineering roles, and the safety risks associated with working at heights in the telecom industry. Crisis Management : Ability to handle last-minute operational disruptions calmly and efficiently. Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with senior telecom clients and field trainers. Attention to Detail : Ensuring zero errors in logistics bookings and training certifications. Education : Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or Engineering. Certification in Project Management (PMP) or Safety (NEBOSH/IOSH) is a plus. 
 Mandatory Experience : Prior experience in the Telecom sector (working with or for Mobile Network Operators, Tower Infra companies, or Telecom EPC contractors). Experience in scheduling field operations or technical training is highly preferred. 
 Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Advanced Excel is a must). Experience with CRM software and Training Management Systems (TMS). Understanding of Geo-mapping tools for logistics planning is an advantage.

Responsibilities include managing, executing and administrating the strategy and operations for this department, as well as driving efficient practices to optimize and streamline processes and monitor/measure activity to ensure customer service levels are meeting business unit objectives. title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
description:
Job Summary: Technical specialist and primary customer support contact to diagnose and execute complex repairs to engine products at the customer s site. Key Responsibilities: Establishes and continually develops productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete complex repairs at customer site. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engines and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists or supervisor. Coaches and develops technicians and/or apprentices and transfers knowledge and experience to others; may provide work direction; may review repair plans, parts lists, etc. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor. Coordinate with dealership/sales team to generate Panel leads. 
2. Ensure visit to sites and convince customer with technical solution. 
3. Visit proactively to customers to generate Panel related leads. 
4. Customer acceptance on Technical solution along with SLD and solution proposed. No of technical solution report to customer 100% within 72 hours
5. Monthly meetings across all the zones to track the progress monitoring and support. 
6. Tracking and closure of all the leads/ projects under progress, following up with Zonal & external teams 
7. Selection & develop suitable vendor around all Divisional office & Area office Competencies: 
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. 

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization s goals. 

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. 

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. 

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels. 

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace. 

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking. 

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution. 

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc. ) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair. 

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition. 

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done. 

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner. 

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. 

 Education, Licenses, Certifications: 
Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)
Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution
Locally valid driving permit
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. 

 Experience: 
Significant field service work experience
Expert level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
Customer service experience
Experience providing technical advice and coaching to more junior technicians (preferred)

title: Personal Shopper & Fashion Stylist
description:
Employment Type: Full-time, work from office, with local travel for customer appointments and events
 Preferred Experience: 13 years in personal shopping, fashion styling, boutique sales or premium fashion retail 
 About Sevora Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience. 
 About the Role We are looking for a customer-focused Personal Shopper & Fashion Stylist who can understand individual preferences, curate suitable outfits and help customers make confident purchase decisions. This role combines styling, personalised service and consultative selling. You will assist customers through in-person appointments, phone or video consultations, WhatsApp and private shopping events, working closely with our Sales Executive and Partnerships & Community Marketing Lead. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Personal Shopping and Styling Understand each customers preferences, size, fit concerns, budget and shopping occasion. Recommend outfits based on the customer’s comfort, personal style and requirements. Curate selections across available brands, categories and price points. Explain fabrics, silhouettes, garment details, care requirements and styling options. Suggest complete looks and complementary products where relevant, within the customer’s budget. Offer respectful, practical advice that helps customers feel comfortable and confident. 2. Consultations and Shopping Appointments Conduct styling consultations in person and through phone, video or WhatsApp. Prepare personalised selections before appointments, checking stock, sizes and prices. Guide customers during trials and help them compare fit, comfort and styling. Support eligible Try at Home appointments in coordination with the sales and operations teams. Record customer preferences, feedback and shortlisted products for future recommendations. 3. Sales and Customer Relationships Convert styling consultations and shopping appointments into purchases through helpful recommendations. Work with the Sales Executive to follow up on selections, suggest alternatives and resolve product-related questions. Build repeat business through relevant new arrivals, occasion-based recommendations and personalised service. Identify opportunities for complementary purchases without pressuring customers. Capture reasons for non-purchase and returns to improve future selections. 4. Events and Community Shopping Support private shopping sessions, residential community events, exhibitions and collection previews. Coordinate with the Partnerships & Community Marketing Lead to understand the audience and prepare suitable looks. Provide styling demonstrations and individual assistance during events. Help interested attendees shortlist products and book follow-up appointments. 5. Product Knowledge and Team Coordination Maintain knowledge of Sevora’s brands, collections, sizing, availability and service policies. Coordinate with merchandising on customer demand, missing sizes and assortment gaps. Share recurring feedback on fit, quality, pricing and product preferences. Keep customer styling notes and appointment outcomes updated in the CRM. Coordinate with operations for accurate product selection and smooth appointment execution. Candidate Requirements Experience in personal shopping, fashion styling, boutique sales or premium fashion retail. Good understanding of fabrics, sizing, fit, colour coordination and outfit styling. Ability to recommend both Indian and Western wear for different occasions. Strong listening, customer service and consultative selling skills. Confidence working with customers who have different tastes, budgets and comfort levels. Clear communication in Bengali and Hindi, with working proficiency in English. Comfort using WhatsApp Business, digital catalogues, spreadsheets and CRM tools. Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled events, including occasional weekends. A qualification in fashion styling, fashion design or a related field is preferred but not essential. Relevant retail experience and strong practical styling ability will also be considered. A portfolio or examples of customer styling work will be an advantage. 
 Key Performance Indicators Styling appointment-to-purchase conversion. Net sales from assisted purchases. Average order value. Repeat purchases from assisted customers. Customer satisfaction and styling feedback. Reduction in avoidable fit or recommendation-related returns. Accurate customer profiles and timely appointment preparation.
